heading.en: Use one pressure to reveal different priorities

body.zh:
**虚构场景**：晚上十点，六辆车还未检修。主角打算不吃饭继续做，希望所有人都留下帮忙。

> 小陶把第三辆车推到自己台前。“这辆我做，你最后复查。”
> 许姐没有坐下。“我十一点要收店。台子给你，货架上的东西别动。”
> 阿民看了看明天的名单，划掉两辆备用车。“先保四辆上场的。缺哪一步，直接告诉我。”

三个人都与主角合作，但合作的条件不同。小陶争取能力证明，许姐维护自己的营业边界，阿民改变交付优先级。主角仍要决定检修顺序并承担结果；配角提供新条件，不替他把全部难题解决。

三个人都关心主角并不等于功能重叠。若只有同一句安慰、没有不同信息或体验，再查是否需要合并或补独立目标；也可以保留共同照料的场景，不为制造区分而强加争执。

本例由罗宁负责最终维修复查，阿民选择车队先接收哪些已通过的车，两种职责分别成立。罗宁实际回应：“四辆优先，小陶做基础项目，我逐辆复查；借台到十一点，原货架不动。”许姐答应他按时归还工作台。此时只完成分工确认，不能提前写成四辆已验收、学徒已能独立签字或工作台已归还。
body.en:
**Fictional scene:** at ten at night, six bikes remain unchecked. The protagonist plans to skip dinner and wants everyone to stay.

> Tao rolled the third bike to his bench. “I’ll do this one. You give it the final check.”
> Xu stayed standing. “I close at eleven. Use the bench. Leave the stock on the shelves.”
> Min crossed two spare bikes off tomorrow’s list. “The four race bikes first. Tell me exactly what’s missing.”

All three cooperate on different terms: Tao seeks responsibility, Xu protects her business, Min changes the delivery priority. The protagonist still chooses the repair order and bears the result.

Shared concern does not itself make functions overlap. If there is only repeated reassurance without distinct information or experience, consider combining roles or developing independent aims. Shared care can also be the scene’s purpose, without adding conflict merely to distinguish people.

In this example Luo owns the final repair check, while Min selects which cleared bikes the team receives first. Luo replies: “Four first. Tao handles the basic work; I recheck each bike. The bench until eleven, and no touching the stock.” Xu agrees to that return time. This establishes the work arrangement, not four completed inspections, independent sign-off by Tao, or a returned bench.

heading.zh: 标志特征可以重复，选择不能原地打转
heading.en: Repeat a trait while changing what it costs

body.zh:
小陶总写检修记录，是一个辨认点。第一次可以被主角嫌慢；发现漏项时成为有用证据；后来独立负责车子时，他自己要为签字负责。重复的是行为，变化的是意义和责任。

不要每次出场都复述同一句口头禅，也不用用夸张外貌代替性格。先定一两项稳定特征，再让不同压力揭出其矛盾：许姐重视明算账，但可以主动给困难学生免一笔工钱；她自己作出的例外，比作者宣布“其实她很善良”更有分量。

主要配角的关系要能承接已有经历；相处与稳定陪伴也可以保留，不要求每次出场都产生新冲突。偶尔出现的支线人物，围绕一个鲜明目标或执念写清即可。篇幅与其实际作用相称。
body.en:
Tao’s habit of recording repairs is a recognition cue. At first the mechanic thinks it slows him down; later the notes reveal an omission; finally Tao must take responsibility for his own signed checks. The behavior repeats, but its meaning and cost change.

Do not repeat a catchphrase at every entrance or substitute extravagant appearance for character. Choose one or two stable traits, then expose tension within them: Xu values clear accounts but may waive a fee for a student. Her chosen exception carries more weight than “She was kind underneath.”

Recurring characters should inherit the relationship’s history; ordinary companionship can remain without a new conflict at each entrance. A brief visitor may need only a clear goal and a memorable choice. Give them space proportionate to their function.

heading.zh: 写清去向，处理抢戏与遗忘
heading.en: Plan departures and repair attention problems

body.zh:
| 人物或问题 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 配角突然知道所有答案 | 先查: 信息从哪里来; 改法: 给他合理来源与知识边界，不让情报凭空出现 |
| 配角比主角更能决定主线 | 先查: 谁作关键选择、承担成本; 改法: 把主线决定交回主角，保留配角自己的局部决定 |
| 新人物越来越多 | 先查: 是否承担相同作用; 改法: 合并功能相近者，保留不同目标带来的必要分歧 |
| 配角后半本消失 | 先查: 已承诺的事情是否结束; 改法: 安排交接、完成、失败或有原因的离开 |

出场前能回答“为什么是这个人”；退场时能回答“他这段要做的事怎样了”。不必给所有人一个长结局，但不要留下无意遗忘的承诺。
body.en:
| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| A supporting character suddenly knows every answer | Check: Where the information came from; Repair: Establish a source and a knowledge boundary |
| They control the main story more than the protagonist | Check: Who chooses and pays; Repair: Return the main decision to the protagonist while keeping local choices theirs |
| The cast grows without need | Check: Who performs the same function; Repair: Merge overlapping roles; preserve necessary differences in goals |
| Someone vanishes halfway through | Check: Which promises remain open; Repair: Show completion, failure, handover or a reason for leaving |

At the entrance, answer “Why this person?” At the exit, answer “What happened to their task?” Everyone need not receive a long epilogue, but accidental disappearance leaves a promise unpaid.

q.zh: 配角需要完整人物弧光吗？
q.en: Does every supporting character need a complete arc?

a.zh: 不需要。经常出现并影响主线的人，应有能持续发展的目标与关系；只承担一场作用的人，清楚的选择、特征与去向就够。
a.en: No. A recurring, consequential character needs developing goals and relationships. A one-scene character may only need a clear choice, trait and departure.

q.zh: 配角太多，优先删谁？
q.en: Which character should I cut from an overcrowded cast?

a.zh: 先看功能重叠和关系重叠。删掉后没有任何决定、信息或后果改变的角色，优先合并；不要仅凭台词少就删掉唯一能完成重要行动的人。
a.en: Check duplicated functions and relationships. Merge someone whose removal changes no decision, information or consequence; do not cut the only person able to perform an important action merely because they speak little.

text.zh: 对 story-long-write 说：“先只做配角方案。每人填主线作用、自己的目标、与主角的分歧、标志行为和退场方式；指出可合并的人物，不写章节。”
text.en: Ask story-long-write for a supporting-cast plan only: each person’s function, own goal, disagreement with the protagonist, recognizable behavior and exit. Request suggestions for overlapping roles without drafting chapters.

title.zh: 小说对白提示语怎么写：说话标签、动作和停顿的取舍
title.en: Dialogue Tags and Action Beats: When to Use Each

seo_title.zh: 小说对白提示语怎么写：说话标签、动作和停顿的取舍
seo_title.en: Dialogue Tags and Action Beats: When to Use Each

description.zh: 什么时候保留“他说”，什么时候省略或改成动作？用原创改前改后对照，处理说话者不明、动作堆砌与节奏机械。
description.en: Use tags to identify speakers and action beats to change the scene. Original before-and-after examples address unclear attribution and repetitive gestures.

answer.zh: “他说”先负责让读者知道谁在说话，不需要每次换一个华丽动词。说话者清楚时可以省略；动作改变物件、关系或决定时才值得插入。停顿要对应人物正在考虑、等待或拒绝的事，不必给每句对白配表情。
answer.en: A dialogue tag first identifies the speaker; it need not use a different ornate verb each time. Omit it when attribution is clear. Add an action beat when it changes a possession, relationship or decision. Let pauses belong to a real hesitation, wait or refusal rather than decorating every line.

heading.zh: 先判断这句旁白需要完成什么
heading.en: Choose the form by its job

body.zh:
Oh Story 的行文方法明确保留普通“说”，需要处理的是机械重复和高频公式化标签；对话方法也指出，句句配动作会让行文机械。可以按下表判断：

| 需要 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 不知道谁在说 | 优先选择: 简单说话标签或姓名; 示例: “钥匙留下。”许姐说。 |
| 两人交替很清楚 | 优先选择: 直接对白; 示例: “明早几点？”“七点。” |
| 控制权改变 | 优先选择: 有后果的动作; 示例: 她把钥匙收进口袋。“明早我开门。” |
| 人物暂不答应 | 优先选择: 等待、具体动作或沉默; 示例: 阿民没有伸手接单。“刹车试过了吗？” |
| 普通一问一答 | 优先选择: 不补多余表演; 示例: 不必在每句后写抬眼、皱眉或点头 |

动作可以顺带标明说话者，但角色做动作并不自动等于他在说。多人在场时，若可能误读，直接点明名字。
body.en:
Oh Story’s prose method keeps ordinary “said” and targets mechanical repetition. Its dialogue method warns that attaching a gesture to every line makes the rhythm mechanical. Choose by the missing information:

| Need | Record |
|---|---|
| Speaker identity | Use: A simple tag or name; Example: “Leave the key,” Xu said. |
| Nothing: two speakers alternate clearly | Use: Bare dialogue; Example: “What time?” “Seven.” |
| A change in control | Use: A consequential action; Example: She pocketed the key. “I’ll open tomorrow.” |
| Acceptance is uncertain | Use: A meaningful wait or refusal; Example: Min did not take the invoice. “Have you tested the brakes?” |
| An ordinary exchange | Use: No added performance; Example: Do not attach a nod or frown to every answer |

An action can help identify a speaker, but movement alone does not always make attribution clear. In a group scene, name the speaker when needed.

heading.zh: 改前改后：删表情，保留局面变化
heading.en: Before and after: keep changes, remove decorative gestures

body.zh:
以下修车店对话为原创。

**改前：**

> “四辆都能交吗？”阿民皱着眉问道。
> “还差最后一辆。”罗宁深吸一口气回答。
> “那先给我三辆。”阿民点了点头说道。
> “不行，要先试车。”罗宁抬起眼，坚定地说道。

四次动作都在强调已能从台词读出的态度，没有改变交车条件。

**改后：**

> “四辆都能交吗？”阿民问。
> “还差最后一辆。”
> 阿民把三辆车的钥匙从台上拢过来。“先给我这三辆。”
> 罗宁压住最外面那把。“试过再走。”

第一句点清说话者，第二句在双人交流中可以省标签。后两个动作改变钥匙控制权，把“着急交车”和“先保证安全”的分歧落到同一件物品上。不是因为“压住”比“说道”更高级，而是这个动作确实影响下一步。

这里的钥匙动作使交车在这场停下来，不表示车或钥匙的所有权改变，也不证明已经完成检修。对照表是作者的行文选择卡，不是 skill 原生对白格式；简单标签、无标签对白和动作按归属与场景用途取舍，不以数量决定质量。
body.en:
This bike-shop exchange is original.

**Before:**

> “Are all four ready?” Min asked with a frown.
> “One left,” Luo replied, taking a deep breath.
> “I’ll take three.” Min nodded.
> “Not before a test ride,” Luo said firmly, lifting his eyes.

Every gesture repeats an attitude already present in the words. None changes the delivery terms.

**After:**

> “Are all four ready?” Min asked.
> “One left.”
> Min gathered three keys from the bench. “I’ll take these.”
> Luo pinned the nearest key under his hand. “Test rides first.”

The first tag establishes the exchange; the next line needs none. Gathering and stopping the keys alter control and make the disagreement physical. The action earns its place because it affects what happens next.

The key action pauses the handover within this scene; it does not transfer ownership or establish a completed repair. The comparison is an editorial prose card, not a native dialogue format. Choose a simple tag, no tag, or an action by attribution and scene function rather than by a count.

heading.zh: 长对白与多人场景怎么安排停顿
heading.en: Handle long speeches and group exchanges

body.zh:
长台词里可以插入对方拒绝、物品被拿走、声音打断或人物自己改口。若动作没有改变说话条件，只是“喝了口水继续说”，不必按固定间隔塞进去。说明性内容读者已经知道时，可以用一句叙述带过；关键谈判仍应保留双方的拉扯。

多人场景每次换发言对象时重新确认归属。比如许姐从门口插话，先写“许姐在门口说”，比连写三句无标签对白后让读者倒回去猜更顺。动作和对白的相邻位置也要清楚，别把一个人的动作写在另一个人的台词后面，却没有说明是谁在动。

停顿的长短由场景决定。钥匙被压住后，阿民要衡量比赛时间；这段等待有内容。普通报时中插入反复沉默，只会延迟信息。
body.en:
Interrupt a long speech when the listener refuses, an object changes hands, a sound intervenes or the speaker revises their position. Do not insert a drink or glance at fixed intervals merely to break the paragraph. Summarize explanations the reader already knows; keep the negotiation that changes terms.

In a group scene, re-establish attribution when a new person enters the exchange. “Xu called from the doorway” is easier to follow than several untagged lines that make readers guess. Keep the ownership of nearby actions clear too.

Let the pause have content. After Luo stops the key, Min weighs the race schedule. Repeated silence during a simple request for the time only delays information.

heading.zh: 一遍修改只查归属、作用与密度
heading.en: Revise attribution, purpose and repetition

body.zh:
1. 只读对白，标出不知道谁说的地方，补最短的必要标签。
2. 圈出所有动作，问它是否改变了注意、关系、物件或选择；只是翻译语气的重复动作优先删。
3. 看剩下的标签是否连续用同一种公式；保留自然的“说”，把真正重要的转折写具体。
4. 正常速度朗读整段，确认停顿没有打散一句完整意图，也没有把关键反应删掉。

“说”出现多不自动等于差，少也不自动等于好。改完应更容易知道谁在争什么，而不只是标签数量变少。
body.en:
1. Read only the dialogue and mark uncertain speakers. Add the shortest necessary attribution.
2. Circle actions. Keep those that change attention, relationships, objects or choices; remove gestures that only translate the tone.
3. Check for a repeated tagging formula. Keep natural “said” and make meaningful turns specific.
4. Read the passage aloud at normal pace. Ensure pauses do not fragment an intention or erase a necessary response.

Many instances of “said” are not automatically bad; few are not automatically good. The revision should make it easier to follow who wants what, not merely reduce a count.

q.zh: “他说”是不是都要删？
q.en: Should I delete every “said”?

a.zh: 不用。归属不清时保留最简单的标签。优先删机械重复、重复解释语气的部分，不拿动作强行替换每个“说”。
a.en: No. Keep a simple tag when attribution needs it. Remove mechanical repetition and redundant descriptions of tone without replacing every tag with a gesture.

q.zh: 每句对白都加动作会更有画面吗？
q.en: Does a gesture after every line make dialogue more visual?

a.zh: 通常会机械。动作应有场景作用，比如收回钥匙、拒绝签字、退出门口；其他地方让对白和必要的上下文自己推进。
a.en: Usually it makes the passage mechanical. Give actions a scene function—taking back a key, refusing a signature or leaving the doorway—and let dialogue carry the rest.

text.zh: 把原段交给 story-long-write，并限定：“只改这一段对白的归属提示和重复动作，不改台词事实、人物决定或场景结果；改后指出保留动作的作用。”
text.en: Give story-long-write the passage and limit the request to attribution and repetitive action beats. Preserve dialogue facts, decisions and the scene outcome; ask it to explain the purpose of retained actions.

title.zh: 不可靠叙述者怎么写：事实、误判与隐瞒要分清
title.en: How to Write an Unreliable Narrator With Fair Clues

seo_title.zh: 不可靠叙述者怎么写：事实、误判与隐瞒要分清
seo_title.en: How to Write an Unreliable Narrator With Fair Clues

description.zh: 区分真诚误判与有意隐瞒动机，给可疑叙述建立事实表。附原创两种版本、揭示步骤与公平性自查。
description.en: Separate mistaken interpretation from withheld motives. Use a fact ledger, two original versions and a reveal that survives rereading.

answer.zh: 先决定叙述者哪里不可靠：他看见了事实却解释错，还是如实叙述行动却没有说出动机。把客观事实、人物解释和最终真相分别记下，关键线索提前让读者见到。揭示后改变的是旧事实的意义，不能把此前明确写出的事实临时推翻。
answer.en: Decide whether the narrator misinterprets what they witness or truthfully reports actions while withholding a motive. Track fact, interpretation and truth separately. Show important clues before the reveal; change their meaning rather than overturning previously established facts.

heading.zh: 先选不可靠的方式，别在中途换规则
heading.en: Choose the kind of unreliability before drafting

body.zh:
Oh Story 的短篇视角反转以“叙述者真诚相信自己的判断”为方法；悬疑题材卡另允许凶手或共谋叙述者如实记录动作、暂不解释动机。这是两种不同安排，不能把第一种的误判写到结尾才改成第二种的装傻。

| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 真诚误判 | 正文应给什么: 看到或听到的事实，以及人物当时的判断; 可以保留什么: 尚未接触的信息; 需要避免: 人物早就知道真相却装不知道 |
| 隐瞒动机 | 正文应给什么: 真实发生的动作与可回查的细节; 可以保留什么: 行动背后的目的; 需要避免: 明确否认自己确实做过的事 |

本篇采用这两种 skill 支持的方法。它们不代表所有文学作品的不可靠叙述规则；这里的目标是让反转在回看时仍成立。
body.en:
Oh Story’s viewpoint-reversal method uses a narrator who sincerely believes their interpretation. Its suspense genre card separately permits a culprit or accomplice to report actions truthfully while withholding motive. Do not draft sincere ignorance and abruptly reveal that it was a deliberate performance all along.

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Sincere misjudgment | Give readers: Observed facts and the narrator’s interpretation; May withhold: Information they have not encountered; Avoid: Pretending not to know an established truth |
| Withheld motive | Give readers: Real actions and details that can be rechecked; May withhold: Why those actions were taken; Avoid: Explicitly denying something they actually did |

These are the two methods supported by the cited skill, not universal rules for every literary use of unreliable narration. The aim here is a reveal that holds up on rereading.

heading.zh: 原创示例：同一组事实的两种叙述
heading.en: Original example: two narrators, one set of facts

body.zh:
虚构故事里，咖啡店收银员只看见一份投诉的开头，没有通读，认为经理正在找理由辞退自己。经理收走了排班表，又约她关店后谈话。

| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 投诉信没有写员工姓名 | 误判版本的解释: “一定是在说我”; 最终证据: 原信投诉的是店里坏掉的报警器 |
| 经理收走排班表 | 误判版本的解释: “他在删我的班”; 最终证据: 表上标记的是谁愿意临时值守等维修工 |
| 关店后才谈 | 误判版本的解释: “不想当着同事辞退我”; 最终证据: 经理先前让她等维修预约结果 |

**真诚误判版：**“他把排班表折起来，我的名字留在折痕边上。我只盯着那一行，就认定他要删掉我的班。”这是当时看见的事实和推断；她没有看见的纸角内容不在这一刻由第一人称报出。后来经理摊开同一张表，请她通读先前原信；她这才读到‘等维修回电’和报警器故障，经理说明关店后商量的是愿意等待维修的人，回电确认预约后再定。

**隐瞒动机版**可另选一名叙述者：收银员的同事确实递交了报警器投诉，却希望迫使经理推迟开店，好让自己完成一场面试。他可以写“我把信放到办公室门缝下”，不解释动机；不能写“我没有交过投诉”。前文应出现面试预约和他打听维修时长的行为，结尾再连起目的。

两个版本不能混成一个角色忽而无知、忽而全知。选定后，把其知识边界维持到底。

同事的面试是他希望推动延期的动机，不等于经理已经接受延期或面试已经完成；报警器有故障也不自动使他的全部说法可信。两版分别选定后，都沿已写动作和实际回复展开。
body.en:
In this fictional café story, a cashier reads only the beginning of a complaint and fears it is an excuse to fire her. The manager removes the rota and asks to speak after closing.

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| The complaint names no employee | Mistaken interpretation: “It must mean me”; Later evidence: The original concerns a broken alarm |
| The manager takes the rota | Mistaken interpretation: “He is cutting my shifts”; Later evidence: It records who can wait for the repair visit |
| The talk is after closing | Mistaken interpretation: “He wants to fire me privately”; Later evidence: He is waiting for the appointment to be confirmed |

**Sincere version:** “He folded the rota. My name stayed at the edge of the crease. I watched that line and decided he meant to remove my shifts.” This reports what she saw and inferred, without first-person knowledge of an unseen corner. Later the manager unfolds the same rota and asks her to read the earlier letter fully. She then reads “Await repair callback” and the alarm fault. He explains that the closing-time discussion concerns who is willing to wait for a repairer, with the appointment to be settled after the callback.

**Withheld-motive version:** choose a different narrator, the coworker who submitted the alarm complaint to delay opening and attend an interview. They can say “I slipped the letter under the office door” without explaining why. They cannot say “I never submitted a complaint.” An interview appointment and questions about repair times should appear before the motive is connected.

Do not combine the versions into a person who alternates between sincere ignorance and complete knowledge. Maintain the chosen knowledge boundary.

The coworker’s interview motivates the hoped-for delay; it does not establish that the manager delayed opening or that the interview occurred. An actual alarm fault also does not validate every claim. Develop either chosen version through its written actions and replies.

heading.zh: 揭示要有证据，也要迫使人物行动
heading.en: Make the reveal supply evidence and force a response

body.zh:
先让误判或隐瞒参与一次重要决定：指责、承诺、离开或错误合作。随后用已存在的人、物件或证词纠正解释。最后让人物处理自己造成的后果。

收银员看见原信后，不能只用一句“原来我误会了”收尾。本例可以继续写她在群聊撤回指责，贴出已读的故障条目；维修方回电确定时间后，经理问谁愿意留下，两名同事实际答应，经理再发等待安排。若选择信任受损线，就写经理明确告诉她：这次维修通知由经理发；她接受这个当次安排。误判的后果由已发生的行为决定，不要求每个故事都加一项惩罚，也不能把道歉写成大家已经原谅。

隐瞒动机的同事也不能凭解释获得自动原谅：报警器确实需要修，目的里却有个人算计。结尾可以保留他对自己“做了好事”的辩解，同时让读者看见别人如何评价。事实与自我解释仍分开。
body.en:
Let the misunderstanding or concealment influence an important accusation, promise, departure or alliance. Correct the interpretation with an existing person, object or testimony. Then make the narrator handle the consequences.

The cashier should do more than say “I was mistaken.” The example can continue with her retracting the accusation in the group chat and posting the fault passage she has read. After the repairer confirms a time, the manager asks for volunteers; two coworkers agree, and he issues the waiting arrangement. If choosing a damaged-trust thread, have him explicitly say that he will send this repair notice, and have her accept that immediate arrangement. Consequences follow actual behavior rather than mandatory punishment, and an apology does not establish forgiveness.

The coworker’s explanation should not produce automatic forgiveness either. The alarm needs repair, but personal calculation shaped the complaint. They may still insist they did a good thing while readers see how others judge it. Keep fact and self-justification separate.

heading.zh: 回看检查：读者有没有被作者作弊
heading.en: Check whether the reveal cheats the reader

body.zh:
- 把所有“肯定”“从来没有”“我知道”圈出来，核对是否把推测写成硬事实。
- 给每条关键消息标注亲见、转述、推断或隐瞒动机，检查叙述者能否在当时获得它。
- 用真相重读早期场景，动作和物件应能对上，不只靠结尾解释补漏洞。
- 如果真相必须新增此前完全不存在的人或记录，优先提前铺设必要证据。
- 删掉结尾说明，再看读者是否能从已出现的线索拼出核心真相；太含糊就补线索，不把谜底全部提前说破。

不可靠来自这个人的认知或议程，不来自作者随时改事实。
body.en:
- Circle absolutes such as “definitely,” “never” and “I knew.” Check that inference has not become hard fact.
- Mark each key statement as witnessed, reported, inferred or motive withheld. Could the narrator access it then?
- Reread early scenes with the truth in mind. Actions and objects should fit without a final speech repairing holes.
- If the truth needs a previously nonexistent person or record, establish the necessary evidence earlier.
- Remove the final explanation. Readers should still be able to connect the core truth from clues already present; add evidence if needed without announcing the solution.

Unreliability belongs to the person’s perception or agenda, not to facts the author changes at will.

q.zh: 不可靠叙述者一定是坏人吗？
q.en: Must an unreliable narrator be a villain?

a.zh: 不一定。恐惧、愿望、有限经验都可能造成真诚误判。要写清其盲区如何影响观察和选择，不把判断错直接等同于恶意。
a.en: No. Fear, desire and limited experience can produce sincere mistakes. Show how the blind spot shapes observation and choice without equating error with malice.

q.zh: 可以一直藏到最后才给关键线索吗？
q.en: Can I save every key clue for the final reveal?

a.zh: 若真相完全依赖最后新增的证据，回看很难成立。关键事实提前出现，先容许另一种解释，结尾再用已有证据改变意义。
a.en: A truth that depends entirely on new final evidence rarely rewards rereading. Present important facts earlier under a plausible interpretation, then change their meaning with established evidence.

text.zh: 对 story-short-write 说：“只设计叙述方案，不写正文。分别列客观事实、叙述者当时知道什么、他的解释和最终真相；选择真诚误判或隐瞒动机，给出提前出现的公平线索。”
text.en: Ask story-short-write for a narration plan only: objective fact, knowledge at the time, interpretation and eventual truth. Choose sincere misjudgment or withheld motive and identify fair clues that appear before the reveal.

label.zh: 悬疑叙述者的动机隐瞒

title.zh: AI写小说提示词怎么写：任务、细纲与知识边界
title.en: How to Prompt AI to Write a Novel Chapter

seo_title.zh: AI写小说提示词怎么写：任务、细纲与知识边界
seo_title.en: How to Prompt AI to Write a Novel Chapter

description.zh: 把任务范围、章节情节点、人物状态和禁止提前揭示的信息交清楚。附可复制提示词、填写范例和有针对性的返修写法。
description.en: Give the AI a defined task, chapter beats, current character state and limits on what may be revealed. Includes a filled prompt and focused revision requests.

answer.zh: 先说清要规划、写正文还是改一段，再给这次必须发生的情节点、人物当前状态、上一段停点和不能提前透露的信息。文风用短样本说明，缺的故事事实让 AI 列出待补项。提示词应把作者已定内容和可自由发挥的细节分开，避免一句“写得精彩”让模型自行改剧情。
answer.en: State whether you want planning, prose or a local revision. Supply required beats, current character state, the previous stopping point and information that must remain unrevealed. Use a short style sample and ask for missing facts to be identified. Separate settled story decisions from details the model may invent.

heading.zh: 先定任务，再给本次用得上的材料
heading.en: Define the task before assembling relevant material

body.zh:
Oh Story 的单章写作方法先检查细纲、读取相关人物与设定、承接上一章结尾，再明确本章意图。手动组装方法也把任务范围放在最前，而不是先堆一长串“你是一位知名作家”的角色要求。

| 材料 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 任务 | 需要回答的问题: 规划还是正文？哪一章或哪一段？停在哪里？; 不必默认塞入: 与这次无关的全书任务 |
| 情节点 | 需要回答的问题: 哪些事必须发生？顺序和结果定了吗？; 不必默认塞入: 未批准的新支线 |
| 当前状态 | 需要回答的问题: 谁在场、知道什么、手里有什么？; 不必默认塞入: 每个人物完整生平 |
| 衔接 | 需要回答的问题: 上一段最后发生了什么？; 不必默认塞入: 整本旧稿全文 |
| 信息边界 | 需要回答的问题: 哪个真相现在不能揭示？; 不必默认塞入: 后文全部结局细节 |
| 表达 | 需要回答的问题: 视角、节奏、短样本、字数范围; 不必默认塞入: 相互矛盾的泛用风格口号 |

材料少而准确，通常比很多互相冲突的要求更可执行；如果某条旧设定会影响本章，仍必须给到，不能为了短就省略。
body.en:
Oh Story’s chapter workflow checks the outline, reads relevant characters and setting, connects to the previous ending, and defines the chapter’s purpose. Its manual assembly method puts the task and scope first rather than beginning with elaborate role praise.

| Material | Record |
|---|---|
| Task | Question to answer: Planning or prose? Which chapter or passage? Where must it stop?; Do not include by default: Unrelated whole-book tasks |
| Beats | Question to answer: What must happen, in what order, with what outcome?; Do not include by default: Unapproved subplots |
| Current state | Question to answer: Who is present, what do they know and hold?; Do not include by default: Every character’s full biography |
| Connection | Question to answer: What happened at the previous stopping point?; Do not include by default: The entire earlier manuscript |
| Knowledge limit | Question to answer: What truth must remain unrevealed?; Do not include by default: Every later ending detail |
| Expression | Question to answer: POV, rhythm, a short sample and length range; Do not include by default: Conflicting general style slogans |

Relevant, accurate material is easier to execute than a long contradictory brief. Brevity does not justify omitting an old fact that affects the scene.

heading.zh: 可复制提示词：把作者已定和可发挥分开
heading.en: A filled prompt that separates decisions from freedom

body.zh:
以下故事为原创示例；字数范围是作者的本次要求，不是通用标准。

> 本次只写第 4 章正文，中文 1800—2200 字，不接着写第 5 章。视角跟随修车师傅罗宁。
>
> 上一章停点：阿民提出先交三辆车，罗宁压住钥匙，要求试车后再走。
>
> 必须发生：阿民解释比赛开场时间；罗宁让学徒先做已安排的基础检查，发现第二辆刹车线松动，尚不安排它试骑；首辆与第三辆通过基础检查后，罗宁亲自复查并完成上一章要求的试车，确认本例已设交付条件满足；他说明延误原因，阿民实际接受先交这两辆。不要改变这个结果。
>
> 人物状态：罗宁知道修不完会失去部分工钱，但不肯放走不安全的车；小陶会做基础检查，尚不能独立签最终验收；阿民知道比赛安排，不知道罗宁旧事故。钥匙仍在柜台上，三辆车尚未交付。
>
> 暂不揭示：不要在本章说出罗宁旧事故的完整经过，也不要让阿民突然知道它。
>
> 可以补：基础检查与已允许试车中的短动作、与检修有关的一次性物件细节。新增长期人物、改事故真相或改交付结果，先列建议，不写进正文。
>
> 文风参考：附上我自己写的短段。保留对话的自然语气，不给每句配动作，也不用结尾感悟替人物收场。章尾停在阿民准备带走两辆车时，接到比赛地点临时更改的电话。
>
> 交付后对照必发生事项逐项指出落点；缺必要事实时先列待补项。

在能读取文件的工作区，提供真实文件路径并明确要读取；在普通聊天里，贴相关摘录。路径名本身不能代替内容，也不要假定模型看过未提供的文件。

本例检查顺序是作者已选情节，不是自行车维修教程。学徒发现问题不自动获得最终验收能力；阿民接收意愿也不替代罗宁实际复查与已要求的试车；第二辆未修好、未通过检查时不让它进入试骑。章尾仍停在准备带走两辆、接到地点变更电话，不提前宣布已经骑到新地点。
body.en:
This is an original story example. The length range is this author’s request, not a universal standard.

> Write chapter 4 only, in 900–1,200 English words, following bicycle mechanic Luo Ning. Do not continue into chapter 5.
>
> Previous stopping point: Min asked to take three bikes. Luo stopped the keys and required test rides first.
>
> Required events: Min explains the race start time; Luo has the apprentice perform the arranged basic checks, identifying a loose brake cable on the second bike before any ride of that bike; after the first and third pass their basic checks, Luo personally rechecks them and carries out the test rides required in the previous chapter against the example’s established delivery conditions; he explains the delay, and Min actually accepts those two first. Preserve this outcome.
>
> Current state: Luo risks losing part of his fee but will not release an unsafe bike. Tao can perform basic checks but cannot sign final acceptance alone. Min knows the race arrangements, not Luo’s old accident. The keys remain on the counter; no bike has been delivered.
>
> Do not reveal: the complete old accident or knowledge of it that Min does not have.
>
> May invent: brief actions in the basic checks or already authorized tests, plus one-use repair details. Suggest, rather than silently add, recurring characters, a changed accident truth or a different delivery outcome.
>
> Style: use my attached original sample. Keep natural dialogue; do not attach gestures to every line or end with a moral summary. Stop as Min prepares to take two bikes and receives a call changing the race venue.
>
> After the draft, identify where each required event appears. List missing necessary facts before drafting if needed.

In a workspace with file access, supply real paths and ask for them to be read. In ordinary chat, supply relevant excerpts. A path name alone does not give access to its contents.

This check order is an author’s plot choice, not a bicycle repair tutorial. Finding a fault does not give the apprentice final acceptance capability, and Min’s willingness does not replace Luo’s recheck or the required rides; the second bike does not enter a ride before its fault is repaired and checks are passed. The ending remains at preparation to take two bikes and the venue-change call, without declaring arrival at the new venue.

heading.zh: 返修提示词指出缺在哪里，不只说“再精彩些”
heading.en: Use revision requests that name the actual defect

body.zh:
| 成稿问题 | 更具体的返修要求 |
|---|---|
| 学徒突然成了检修专家 | “小陶只能基础检查。只改超出其能力的动作，把最终验收交回罗宁。” |
| 旧事故提前说破 | “删除完整事故解释，保留罗宁不放车的选择；不要新增替代秘密。” |
| 每段都在感叹压力 | “合并重复说明租金压力的段落，保留一次明确代价；不删基础检查发现。” |
| 字数不足但情节点完整 | “先指出哪处场景还没展开，不新增主线事件；我选定后再补写。” |
| 结尾接着写下一章 | “停在比赛地点变更的电话，不展开新地点。删去越过停点的部分。” |

返修时给原文和范围，说明哪些台词事实、选择与结果要保留。若缺的是细纲里的必要事件，先补遗漏；若只是想增加字数，不让模型用新剧情填满。
body.en:
| Draft problem | Focused request |
|---|---|
| The apprentice becomes an expert | “Tao only performs basic checks. Revise actions beyond that ability and return final acceptance to Luo.” |
| The accident is revealed early | “Remove the full accident account but keep Luo’s refusal. Do not invent a replacement secret.” |
| Every paragraph repeats the pressure | “Merge repeated rent explanations, keep one clear cost, and preserve the basic-check discovery.” |
| The draft is short but covers the beats | “Identify underdeveloped scene work without adding a main event. Wait for my choice before expanding.” |
| The ending continues into the next chapter | “Stop at the venue-change call. Remove the new-location sequence.” |

Supply the original passage and revision boundaries. Preserve settled facts, choices and outcomes. Restore missing required events first; do not fill a length target by inventing plot.

heading.zh: 用 skill 时说明创作意图，不手动复刻内部流程
heading.en: Use the skill through an author-facing request

body.zh:
在已经配置好的 Oh Story 工作区，可以直接说：“用已有细纲写第 4 章，只写这一章；按本书文风，停在比赛地点变更的电话。”技能会按自己的写前与检查流程处理材料。本页模板用来帮助作者交清事实和边界，不要求作者复制技能内部的字段或脚本步骤。

第一次使用时，先确认工作区里确实有本书的设定、细纲和续写状态。缺材料就先补规划，不在不知道上一章结果时强行续写。交稿后至少检查必发生事项、人物知识和停点；格式或检测结果不能替代这三项阅读判断。

本页是面向作者的简报，不是 `writer_prompt.md` 的完整原生组装格式。所引 `writer-prompt-fallback.md` 仅在组装脚本不可运行或作者明确不用脚本时使用；数据错误应先修复，不能靠复制本页绕过。普通聊天里的提示词也不能代替项目部署、实际读取或追踪提交。
body.en:
In a configured Oh Story workspace, an author-facing request can be brief: “Use the existing outline to write chapter 4 only, in this book’s style; stop at the venue-change call.” The skill handles its own preparation and checks. This template helps communicate facts and boundaries; it does not require authors to reproduce internal fields or scripts.

Confirm that the workspace contains the book’s setting, outline and continuation state. Supply missing planning material before continuing. After delivery, check required events, character knowledge and the stopping point; formatting and automated checks cannot replace that reading judgment.

This page is an author’s brief, not the complete native writer_prompt.md assembly format. The cited writer-prompt-fallback.md applies only when the assembly script cannot run or the author expressly chooses not to use it; data errors require repair rather than bypass through this template. A chat prompt likewise does not establish project deployment, file reading, or tracking commit.

q.zh: 提示词越长越好吗？
q.en: Are longer prompts better?

a.zh: 不是。优先提供本次写错就会影响剧情的事实，删去互相冲突的风格要求。相关旧设定不能省，无关整本资料不必全部贴。
a.en: No. Prioritize facts that would change the scene if misunderstood and remove conflicting style requirements. Keep relevant old constraints without pasting all unrelated material.

q.zh: 一句“不要有AI味”够吗？
q.en: Is “avoid AI-sounding prose” enough?

a.zh: 太笼统。附自己写的短样本，点名实际问题，例如重复解释动机、每句插动作或章尾感悟；返修限定段落和必须保留的事件。
a.en: It is too vague. Supply your own short sample and identify the actual issue: repeated motive explanations, gestures after every line or a moralizing ending. Specify the revision range and events to preserve.

text.zh: 对 story-long-write 直接交代作者已定的范围、必发生事项和停点。想先讨论提示词，就明确说“只帮我整理写作简报，不写正文”，材料齐全后再请求指定章节。
text.en: Give story-long-write your settled scope, required events and stopping point. To discuss the prompt first, request a writing brief only and stop before prose. Ask for the chapter once the materials are ready.

title.zh: AI视频场景不一致怎么办：固定布局，再换机位
title.en: How to Keep Locations Consistent Across AI Video Shots

seo_title.zh: AI视频场景不一致怎么办：固定布局，再换机位
seo_title.en: How to Keep Locations Consistent Across AI Video Shots

description.zh: 区分固定房间布局、观察方向与临时状态，用空场参考图固定门窗、路线和光源。附原创场景模板与正反方向示例。
description.en: Keep room layout, viewing direction and temporary states separate. Use location references to preserve doors, routes and light sources, with filled examples.

answer.zh: 先确定同一场景里不会随镜头变化的入口、路线和固定物件，再为不同观察方向准备参考图。换机位只改变观众从哪里看，不让门窗和柜台跟着换位置；时间、天气和开灯变化则另记一版状态，并同步所有需要剪在一起的镜头。
answer.en: Establish entrances, routes and fixed structures before making reference images for different viewing directions. A new camera position changes the view, not the room. Record time, weather and lighting changes separately and apply them consistently to shots that will be edited together.

heading.zh: 把场景布局、观察方向和状态分开
heading.en: Separate layout, view and temporary state

body.zh:
drama-skills 的场景空镜方法先保持地理与固定锚点，再选择观察方向。问题常出在把“同一间店，反向镜头”写成一段全新装饰提示词，模型就会重新设计房间。

以下修车店是原创制作示例，不是实测生成结果。

| 要固定的层次 | 示例 | 换镜时能否改变 |
|---|---|---|
| 场景布局 | 入口通向中间通道，工作台沿东墙，唯一后门在北墙，窗在西墙 | 不随机位改动 |
| 观察方向 | 从入口向北看；从后门向南看 | 可以换，但相对布局要能对上 |
| 临时状态 | 傍晚、窗外下雨、台灯开启、两辆车停在通道边 | 有剧情原因时变化，需前后衔接 |
| 构图 | 中景、低机位、竖屏 | 可调整，不借此搬门窗 |

先使用房间自身的东、西、入口与后门确定关系，再转换成某一视角的画面左右。否则“左边有窗”换个机位后容易被误当成另一个左边。
body.en:
drama-skills’ location-reference method preserves geography and fixed anchors before choosing a view. A common failure is to describe the reverse angle as a fresh decorative scene, effectively asking for a new room.

This bike shop is an original production example, not a measured generation result.

| Layer | Example | Can it change between shots? |
|---|---|---|
| Layout | Entrance opens onto a central aisle; bench on east wall; one rear door on north wall; window on west wall | Not merely because the camera moves |
| View | From entrance facing north; from rear door facing south | Yes, while preserving the room |
| State | Rainy evening, desk lamp on, two bikes beside the aisle | With a story reason and continuity |
| Framing | Medium shot, low camera, vertical frame | Yes, without relocating structures |

Use room-relative directions and named anchors first, then translate them into screen directions for each view. “Window on the left” alone becomes ambiguous when the camera turns.

heading.zh: 空场参考图提示词：两种方向共享一间店
heading.en: Two reference prompts for the same room

body.zh:
**从入口朝里看：**

> 小型修车店的空场参考图，从南侧入口向北观察。中央通道连接入口和北墙唯一后门，工作台沿东墙延伸，西墙只有一扇横窗。保留中央通道宽度和后门位置，固定家具不移位。傍晚雨天，窗外冷光来自西侧，工作台暖色台灯已开启。没有剧情人物，也不添加临时围观者。材质与色彩沿用已确定的视觉参考。

**从后门朝外看：**

> 同一修车店，从北侧后门向南观察入口。东墙工作台在这一观察方向的画面左侧，西墙横窗在画面右侧，中央通道直通南侧入口。保持前一参考图的门窗、工作台长度和通道关系。仍是同一傍晚雨天，冷光来自西墙窗户，台灯位置和开关状态不变。画面为空场，不重新增加柜台或出口。

固定物件优先保留，次要装饰可以概括。两个视角不必长得一样：一个可能顺光，一个可能逆光；差异必须能由同一个光源和不同观察方向解释。

完成后并排看入口、后门、工作台、窗与光向，不只分别挑“最好看”的两张。
body.en:
**From entrance looking in:**

> Empty reference image of a small bicycle repair shop, viewed north from the south entrance. A central aisle connects the entrance to the single rear door on the north wall. The bench runs along the east wall; one horizontal window is on the west wall. Preserve aisle width, rear-door position and fixed furniture. Rainy evening: cool light enters from the west window, with a warm desk lamp already on at the bench. No story characters or added crowd. Use the accepted material and color reference.

**From rear door looking out:**

> The same shop viewed south from the north rear door. The east-wall bench appears screen-left, the west-wall window screen-right, and the central aisle leads to the south entrance. Keep the same doors, bench length and aisle relationships. It is the same rainy evening; cool light still comes from the west window, and the desk lamp remains in place and on. Empty space; do not add a new counter or exit.

Prioritize fixed structures and simplify secondary decoration. The views may differ in brightness or backlighting, but the difference must follow from one light setup and different directions. Compare them side by side rather than independently choosing two attractive images.

heading.zh: 人物进出、夜景与开灯怎样接续
heading.en: Track entrances and lighting changes

body.zh:
人物从入口走到后门时，先让路线在场景参考里成立，再安排镜头的起止位置。别用一张漂亮但没有通道的参考图，要求人物穿过柜台。

从傍晚变夜晚，变化的是时间与光线状态：窗外冷光减弱，台灯仍亮；若另开顶灯，正反方向的参考和后续镜头都要知道顶灯已开。只改其中一镜，剪在一起就可能像突然换了房间。

| 变化 | 需要同步的内容 |
|---|---|
| 镜头转向 | 观察方向、可见锚点和画面左右 |
| 开顶灯 | 灯具开关、光源主次和相邻镜头 |
| 道具移位 | 移动由谁完成、从哪到哪、后镜的新位置 |
| 时间推进 | 窗外亮度、天气是否变化、人物是否仍在同一行动中 |

不要为了营造“危险感”额外封住出口或发明损坏物；气氛用已确定空间的光线、材质与构图表达。
body.en:
Before a character crosses from entrance to rear door, establish a usable route and record start and end positions. A beautiful reference without an aisle cannot support walking through the bench.

When evening becomes night, change the time and lighting state: window light weakens while the desk lamp stays on. If a ceiling light is switched on, every relevant view and following shot must inherit that fact.

| Change | Update |
|---|---|
| Camera turns | View direction, visible anchors and screen directions |
| Ceiling light turns on | Switch state, light hierarchy and neighboring shots |
| Prop moves | Who moves it, from where to where, and its next position |
| Time advances | Exterior brightness, weather and continuity of the action |

Do not seal an exit or invent damage merely to make a location feel dangerous. Express mood through accepted light, material and framing choices.

heading.zh: 场景错了，先修参考，不急着生成视频
heading.en: Fix the reference before generating motion

body.zh:
- **门窗换边**：回到房间布局和观察方向，判断是正常反向观察还是固定结构被搬动。
- **每个镜头都加新家具**：删无功能装饰，保留少量可辨认的固定锚点。
- **正反镜冷暖不一致**：核对同一窗和灯是否仍承担相同光源作用，记录能解释的视角差异。
- **人物无路可走**：先修改参考图或调度，别用运动提示词要求穿模。
- **风格统一但空间不同**：色调与画风一致不能证明布局一致，逐项检查入口和路线。

先确认参考图之间的空间关系，再做关键帧和视频。文字提示能限制目标，但是否保住布局仍要查看生成画面与剪接结果。
body.en:
- **Doors and windows swap:** check whether this is a valid reverse view or a relocated structure.
- **New furniture in every shot:** remove nonfunctional decoration and retain a few recognizable anchors.
- **Reverse angles have incompatible color:** confirm the same window and lamp still serve the same roles; record explainable view differences.
- **No route for the actor:** revise the reference or blocking rather than asking motion to pass through furniture.
- **Matching style, different space:** a shared palette does not establish geography; inspect entrances and routes.

Confirm relationships between reference images before making keyframes and motion. Prompt instructions describe the target; generated images and cuts still require visual review.

q.zh: 换一个角度要重做一间场景吗？
q.en: Does a new camera angle require a new location?

a.zh: 通常是同一场景的新观察方向。沿用入口、边界和固定结构，补充这个方向能看见的关系；不要从零装饰出另一间房。
a.en: Usually it is a new view of the same location. Keep entrances, boundaries and fixed structures, and specify the relationships visible from that direction.

q.zh: 空场参考图一定不能有人吗？
q.en: Must a location reference always be empty?

a.zh: 默认空场便于复用。确需尺度参照或已确定的占用状态时可以有相应人物，但要明确目的，避免临时演员遮住地理或混入剧情。
a.en: An empty space is easier to reuse. A deliberate scale reference or established occupancy may include people, but specify the purpose and avoid obscuring geography or inventing events.

text.zh: 用 short-drama-image-prompts 请求：“为已确定的修车店布局写入口向内、后门向外两种空场参考提示词；保持门窗、路线和同一时段光源，并列出需要核对的差异。”
text.en: Ask short-drama-image-prompts for entrance-inward and rear-door-outward reference prompts based on the accepted layout. Preserve doors, routes and the same lighting state, and list differences to verify.

label.zh: 场景地理与跨视角光线
label.en: Location geography and lighting across views

title.zh: AI视频口型对不上怎么办：先查说话人、声音类型与时长
title.en: AI Video Lip Sync Problems: Check Speaker, Audio Role and Timing

seo_title.zh: AI视频口型对不上怎么办：先查说话人、声音类型与时长
seo_title.en: AI Video Lip Sync: Speaker, Audio Role and Timing

description.zh: 分清画内对白、画外说话和旁白，再核台词是否装得进镜头。附原创双人场景提示词与四类失败的处理方法。
description.en: Separate visible dialogue, off-screen speech and voiceover, then budget time for the full line. Includes a two-person example and a repair table.

answer.zh: 先核对声音属于谁、这个人此时是否应在画面里开口，再检查完整台词与动作是否装得进镜头。旁白不等于画内对白，听者也不应跟着动嘴。写清声源和时序后仍要回听、查看口部；如果持续失败，调整分镜或生成方案，单靠“口型精准同步”不能代替检查。
answer.en: Check who owns the voice and whether that person should visibly speak. Then verify that the complete line and required actions fit the shot. Voiceover is not visible dialogue, and listeners should not mouth another person’s words. Review the generated sound and mouth movement; a phrase such as “perfect lip sync” is not evidence of success.

heading.zh: 先分清三种容易混淆的声音
heading.en: Distinguish three different audio roles

body.zh:
drama-skills 的声音方法分别处理画内对白、画外声和旁白。提示词里只写“她说”，却同时要求她闭嘴思考，可能给出互相冲突的目标。

| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 画内对白 | 画面需要什么：对应人物的开口、表演和完整台词；例子：店主面对客户说“试车后再交钥匙” |
| 画外说话 | 画面需要什么：声音来自不在画面或口部不可见的人，方向与场景一致；例子：镜头拍店主，客户在对面画外提问 |
| 旁白或内心独白 | 画面需要什么：不要求画中人物用嘴说出这一句；例子：店主看钥匙，听见其回忆旁白 |

同一句话跨镜时，注明在哪一镜开始、下一镜是画外继续还是已经结束。不要前镜写“说完”，后镜又让这句从头出现。

声音登记还包括每句实际语种与逐字原文，不能从提示词正文语言推断。若音频本身说错语言或改了句子，先看[发声语种与台词检查](/drama-skills/fix-wrong-spoken-language-in-ai-video)，再做本页口型核对。
body.en:
drama-skills handles visible dialogue, off-screen speech and voiceover separately. “She says” conflicts with an instruction that she silently thinks with her lips closed.

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| Visible dialogue | Visual requirement: The right person speaks and performs the complete line; Example: The mechanic faces the customer and says the keys follow the test ride |
| Off-screen speech | Visual requirement: Voice belongs to someone outside the frame or with mouth unseen; spatial direction remains coherent; Example: The camera stays on the mechanic while the customer asks from opposite them |
| Voiceover or inner thought | Visual requirement: The visible person need not mouth the line; Example: The mechanic looks at a key under recollection voiceover |

For a line continuing across shots, specify where it starts, where it continues off-screen and where it ends. Do not finish it in one prompt and restart it in the next.

Record each line’s actual language and verbatim wording rather than inferring them from instruction language. If the audio uses the wrong language or changes the line, first use the [language and dialogue check](/drama-skills/fix-wrong-spoken-language-in-ai-video), then inspect lip sync here.

heading.zh: 先测完整台词，再安排开口和反应
heading.en: Budget the complete line, preparation and response

body.zh:
有同句、同表演的录音，优先用实际发声时长；没有录音，标明只是文本估计，不假称已经试听。镜头还要容纳开口前的等待、不能同时进行的动作和末尾反应。

下面只是预算示例：假设镜头共 7 秒，等待和收尾各需约半秒，发声窗口只剩 6 秒。若你录下的完整台词需要 8 秒，把提示词写成“0—7 秒说完”并不会使它装得下。可以延长镜头，或在语义合适处拆镜；若要精简台词，先修订剧本，再同步提示词与音频。

| 可以调整 | 应保住 |
|---|---|
| 无必要的抬手、走动和复杂运镜 | 完整台词与正确说话人 |
| 能自然同时进行的简单动作 | 必须先后发生的因果动作 |
| 镜头时长或合理拆镜 | 结尾能看懂的回应 |

不同语言、声音和情绪的语速不同，不用一个固定每秒字数当所有模型的容量保证。
body.en:
Use the actual speaking duration when you have the same line recorded in the same performance. Without audio, label the duration a text estimate rather than claiming it was measured. Also allow for preparation, actions that cannot overlap speech and the final response.

This is a budgeting example: a seven-second shot with half a second before and after leaves six seconds for speech. If your full recording lasts eight seconds, writing “finish within seven seconds” does not make it fit. Extend the shot or split at a meaningful boundary. If shortening the line, revise the script first and update the prompt and audio together.

| May adjust | Preserve |
|---|---|
| Unnecessary gestures, walking and complex camera motion | Complete words and the correct speaker |
| Simple actions that can naturally overlap | Actions that must occur in sequence |
| Duration or a meaningful shot split | A readable response at the end |

Speech rate varies by language, voice and emotion. A fixed characters-per-second estimate is not a capacity guarantee for every model.

heading.zh: 双人场景提示词：说话与听话各有职责
heading.en: A two-person prompt with distinct speaking and listening roles

body.zh:
以下是原创场景设计，生成后仍需检查。

> 保持已确定的店内机位，店主在画面左侧，客户在右侧。客户先停手看向店主，不说话。店主面向客户，完整说出：“试车后再交钥匙。”发声属于店主的画内对白，口部表演与这一句对应；客户听完才将手从钥匙旁移开，不跟说、不重复台词。店主说完后保留客户撤手的反应，钥匙仍在台上。不要增加旁白或新台词。镜头时长按完整录音和反应时间安排。

若同框听者总跟着张嘴，分镜允许时可改成店主单人近景，客户的撤手另拍反应；若坚持同框，明确听者不发声、嘴唇闭合，并核生成结果。

**内心独白版**不能只把同一句改标“旁白”而保留开口动作。可以拍手与钥匙，听见内心旁白；若必须正脸，明确嘴唇闭合并检查。skill 中的小样本观察说明文字限制有时仍会失败，因此不要把“写了闭嘴”当成已经解决。
body.en:
This is an original shot design that still requires output review.

> Keep the accepted shop camera position: mechanic screen-left, customer screen-right. The customer stops reaching and looks at the mechanic without speaking. Facing the customer, the mechanic says the full line: “Keys after the test ride.” This is the mechanic’s visible dialogue. The customer listens, then withdraws their hand; they do not repeat or mouth the line. Keep the withdrawal after the mechanic finishes, with the keys still on the bench. Add no voiceover or new words. Set duration from the full recording and required response.

If a visible listener repeatedly mouths the words, a permitted storyboard revision can isolate the speaker and show the hand withdrawal separately. If keeping both people visible, specify the silent listener and check the result.

For an **inner-voice version**, do not merely relabel the audio while keeping the speaking action. Show hands and keys under voiceover, or require closed lips when a face must remain visible. The skill’s small-sample observations show that textual restrictions can still fail; writing “mouth closed” does not prove the output obeyed it.

heading.zh: 四类失败，分别修
heading.en: Match the repair to the failure

body.zh:
| 项目 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 错的人在动嘴 | 优先核对：说话人归属、同框人物与台词顺序；处理：写清声源，必要时改取景 |
| 旁白时人物张嘴 | 优先核对：是否把旁白误写成对白；处理：调整分镜或注明闭嘴，再看实际画面 |
| 台词尾巴没说完 | 优先核对：完整发声时长是否超窗口；处理：延长、拆镜或先修剧本，不悄悄删字 |
| 台词重复跨两个镜头 | 优先核对：前后镜开始、延续与结束关系；处理：对齐相邻提示词和剪辑声音段 |

回听完整台词，再按正常速度看画内开口与声音是否对应，检查切镜处有没有多说、少说或声源跳变。仅检查提示词、字幕文本或一张截图，都不能证明口型同步。
body.en:
| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| The wrong person mouths the line | Check first: Speaker ownership and visible cast; Repair: Clarify the source; revise framing if needed |
| A face speaks during voiceover | Check first: Voiceover mislabeled as dialogue; Repair: Revise the shot or specify closed lips, then inspect output |
| The last words disappear | Check first: Full speech duration versus available window; Repair: Extend, split or revise the script without silently dropping words |
| A line repeats in two shots | Check first: Start, continuation and ending across prompts; Repair: Align prompts and the edited audio |

Listen to the full line, then watch at normal speed for mouth/audio correspondence and extra or missing words at cuts. Prompt text, subtitles and a still image cannot establish synchronization.

q.zh: 写“口型精准同步”能保证成功吗？
q.en: Does “perfect lip sync” guarantee success?

a.zh: 不能。先给正确声源、完整台词和合理时长，再检查实际输出；失败时根据说话人、旁白处理或容量问题分别调整。
a.en: No. Specify the right voice source, full line and feasible duration, then inspect the output. Repair speaker ownership, voiceover staging or capacity as appropriate.

q.zh: 可以直接把难同步的对白改成旁白吗？
q.en: Can I change difficult dialogue into voiceover?

a.zh: 这会改变表现方式，可能也改变剧情。先确认场景能否这样讲，再修剧本与分镜，不能只在视频提示词里悄悄转换。
a.en: That changes presentation and may change the story. Confirm the scene can work that way, then revise script and storyboard rather than silently converting it inside a motion prompt.

text.zh: 用 short-drama-video-prompts 请求：“根据这段剧本和分镜写声音与表演提示，标清说话人、完整台词、画内/画外/旁白关系；检查发声窗口，超时先提出延长或拆镜方案，不改台词。”
text.en: Ask short-drama-video-prompts to preserve the script and storyboard while specifying speaker, full line and visible/off-screen/voiceover role. Check the speaking window and propose extension or splitting when needed, without changing dialogue.

label.zh: 完整台词与动作的时长预算

title.zh: 视频剪辑闪帧怎么修：找出残留短镜头，回源调整剪点
title.en: How to Fix Flash Frames and Stray Shots in an Edit

seo_title.zh: 视频剪辑闪帧怎么修：找出残留短镜头，回源调整剪点
seo_title.en: How to Fix Flash Frames and Stray Shots in an Edit

description.zh: 区分无关残镜、有效快切、曝光变化和取景跳动，检查实际导出视频，再回源修入出点。附原创接点示例与复查表。
description.en: Distinguish stray frames from useful fast cuts, exposure changes and crop jumps. Inspect the rendered video, repair source boundaries and review the result.

answer.zh: 先在实际导出的视频里定位一闪而过的画面，再连前后正常播放，确认是无关残镜还是有效的短反应。回原片核对镜头与截取边界：无关残镜删完整，相关反应扩回真实素材；不要用定格、闪白或极端放大掩盖。修后用相同检查条件对照，再正常速度观看。
answer.en: Locate the fleeting image in the rendered video and watch it with its neighbors. Decide whether it is a stray shot or a useful brief response. Check the source and edit boundaries: remove an unrelated shot entirely or restore a relevant reaction from real footage. Review the repair under the same detection settings and at normal speed.

heading.zh: 短镜头不一定是闪帧问题
heading.en: A short shot is not automatically a mistake

body.zh:
video-cut 的镜头检查检查实际渲染文件，因为一个计划中很长的截取区间，仍可能带着原片内部几个帧的反打。报告里的短镜头和密集切点是待看候选，不是自动删除清单。

| 看到的现象 | 可能原因 | 先做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 接点夹着陌生人物一闪 | 截取带入前后无关镜头 | 回原片确认完整镜头范围 |
| 手势只露半截就切走 | 反应或动作被截短 | 找真实动作开始与完成位置 |
| 画面忽亮一下 | 曝光、闪光或动效 | 不只凭切点检测认定换镜 |
| 同一人突然变大或移位 | 取景范围在接点附近跳动 | 比较原片与输出取景 |
| 一连串短镜推动动作 | 有意快切 | 正常播放判断每镜是否可读 |

闪帧修复针对无意残留或丢失的信息。保留有作用的快切，不为统一镜长把整片放慢。
body.en:
video-cut reviews the actual rendered file because even a long planned source interval can contain a few frames of an internal reverse shot. Short-shot and dense-cut reports provide candidates to inspect, not a deletion list.

| Symptom | Possible cause | First check |
|---|---|---|
| An unrelated face flashes at a join | A neighboring source shot was included | Complete shot boundaries in the source |
| A hand action appears only halfway | A reaction or action was truncated | Its real beginning and completion |
| The image briefly brightens | Exposure, flash or effect | Whether there was an actual cut |
| A person abruptly enlarges or shifts | The crop changes near the join | Source shot versus output framing |
| Rapid shots advance an action | Deliberate fast cutting | Readability at normal speed |

Repair unintended leftovers or missing information. Keep useful fast cuts rather than slowing everything to a uniform duration.

heading.zh: 原创接点示例：删残镜和补反应是两种修法
heading.en: Original join example: removing a stray shot versus restoring a reaction

body.zh:
下面是虚构剪辑计划，用于说明判断方法，没有声称实际检测过素材。

原片顺序：客户指向账单 → 店主解释费用 → 路过者两帧插镜 → 客户收回账单并点头。你的成片只想保留费用说明与客户接受。

| 版本 | 修法 | 需要检查 |
|---|---|---|
| 路过者两帧被误带入 | 回源找到完整插镜边界，在剪辑计划中去掉整段无关镜头 | 说明尾句完整，后镜仍从客户收账单的真实状态开始 |
| 客户反应只剩两帧 | 从原片扩回客户收账单到点头的完整动作 | 这个反应确实发生在该句之后，没拼错时间 |
| 两帧其实是窗外闪光 | 保留原动作，核对是否确为闪光 | 不把曝光变化误删成镜头 |

无关镜头删掉，不相关的人脸无需定格加长。相关反应需要从真实源素材恢复，而不是把两帧拉成一秒，制造原片没有的停顿。
body.en:
This fictional edit plan illustrates the decision; it is not a claim that footage was analyzed.

Source order: customer points at invoice → mechanic explains the fee → two-frame passerby insert → customer takes back the invoice and nods. The intended edit keeps the explanation and acceptance.

| Version | Repair | Verify |
|---|---|---|
| The passerby was accidentally included | Find the complete insert boundary and remove it in the edit plan | Keep the final words and the customer’s real next state |
| The customer’s response was cut to two frames | Restore the complete take-and-nod action from source | Confirm it belongs after this line, not a different exchange |
| The bright frames were a window flash | Preserve the action and confirm the cause | Do not remove exposure change as if it were a stray shot |

Remove an unrelated insert; do not freeze it to make it longer. Restore a useful response from real source footage rather than stretching two frames into a pause that never occurred.

heading.zh: 定位、回源、改计划、再播放
heading.en: Locate, compare source, revise the plan and play again

body.zh:
1. 检查本轮实际导出文件，记录候选时间附近的前后画面，不只看剪辑计划中的段落长度。
2. 连同前后片段正常播放，检查动作、台词和反应。逐帧查看可以定位边界，但不能替代正常速度判断。
3. 回原片核对是否本来就有短镜，或本次截取、取景造成残留。无法证明来源时先保留待确认，不猜是原片问题。
4. 在剪辑计划里修完整边界，再重新导出；不要只改导出文件而留下旧计划。
5. 用同样画面范围和检测参数对照修前修后，再听台词、看字幕、核动作和速度。

若黑边、花字或标题影响检测，可检查主画面范围，同时保留全画面或较大范围作对照。不能靠缩小检查区域把问题排除掉后宣布成功。
body.en:
1. Inspect this run’s actual export and record the candidate with surrounding pictures. Planned interval length is not enough.
2. Play the neighborhood at normal speed to assess action, dialogue and response. Frame stepping locates boundaries but cannot establish viewing comfort.
3. Compare the source: was the short shot already there, or did the edit or crop create it? Keep uncertain origin unconfirmed.
4. Repair the complete boundary in the edit plan and export again; do not repair only the rendered file while leaving an obsolete plan.
5. Compare before and after using the same picture region and detection parameters, then check words, subtitles, actions and playback speed.

If borders or titles affect detection, inspect the main picture while retaining a full-frame or broader comparison. Shrinking the inspected region to hide a defect is not a repair.

heading.zh: 检测数减少，不等于接点已修好
heading.en: Fewer detected candidates do not prove a good repair

body.zh:
| 容易误用的办法 | 为什么不可靠 | 更合适的处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 插闪白或溶解 | 可能遮住没解决的动作跳跃 | 回源对齐有因果的入出点 |
| 将两帧定格补长 | 新造停顿，未恢复真实表演 | 恢复源片中完整反应 |
| 接点突然大幅放大 | 可能压低检测差异，却裁掉手和表情 | 给每个原生镜头连续、可读的取景 |
| 调高阈值直到零报告 | 只变成少报，不证明问题消失 | 保留检查条件与人工播放证据 |

最后确认：台词不被截断；同一动作没有完成两次；关键表情与物件仍可读；字幕与声音未因重导出漂移。检测只是帮助找位置，最终判断来自实际播放。
body.en:
| Tempting shortcut | Why it is unreliable | Better repair |
|---|---|---|
| Flash or dissolve over the join | Hides an unresolved action jump | Align causal source boundaries |
| Freeze two frames to extend them | Invents a pause rather than restoring performance | Recover the actual response |
| Extreme zoom at the join | May reduce a detection score while cropping hands or faces | Keep coherent, readable framing within each source shot |
| Raise the threshold until no report appears | Reduces recall without proving a fix | Keep comparable settings and playback evidence |

Confirm complete words, no duplicated action, readable expressions and objects, and no subtitle/audio drift after rendering. Detection locates candidates; actual playback determines the result.

q.zh: 检测报告没有候选，就没有闪帧吗？
q.en: Does a report with no candidates prove there are no flash frames?

a.zh: 不能。阈值、黑边、画面反差和包装都可能影响召回。用已知问题片段核对检查条件，仍需正常播放实际成片。
a.en: No. Threshold, borders, contrast and overlays affect recall. Check the settings against a known problem passage and still play the rendered video normally.

q.zh: 所有一秒以内的镜头都应该删吗？
q.en: Should every shot shorter than one second be removed?

a.zh: 不应该。短镜可以承担反应、细节或快切节奏。看它是否提供可读的信息，是否完整属于当前事件，再决定保留、回源扩完整或删除。
a.en: No. A short shot may carry a response, detail or fast-cut rhythm. Judge its readable information and relation to the event before keeping, restoring or removing it.

text.zh: 对 video-cut 提出：“检查这次实际输出里的短残镜与密集切点，先只给候选；回源核对原因，给保留、恢复完整或删除的建议，不自动改剪点。修后按相同条件复查。”
text.en: Ask video-cut to inspect the actual output for short or dense-cut candidates first. Compare source evidence and recommend keeping, restoring or removing shots without automatically moving cut points. Recheck under the same conditions after repair.

label.zh: 实际成片短镜检查与修复

title.zh: 小说三幕结构怎么用：用转折改变人物的行动
title.en: How to Use Three-Act Structure for a Novel

seo_title.zh: 小说三幕结构怎么用：用转折改变人物的行动
seo_title.en: How to Use Three-Act Structure for a Novel

description.zh: 按建立目标、持续对抗和最终解决组织小说，不用机械字数比例。附原创三幕表、中段转折与连载单卷的用法。
description.en: Plan setup, confrontation and resolution around changing choices. Includes a filled three-act outline, a middle turn and use within a serial volume.

answer.zh: 把三幕看成三种任务：第一幕让主角进入必须处理的问题，第二幕让行动遭遇反制并改变旧办法，第三幕让主角用前面的经历完成最后选择。每幕之间的转折要改变目标、条件或风险，不能只是换地点。先写因果，再按需要分章，不把固定篇幅比例当作规则。
answer.en: Treat the acts as jobs: bring the protagonist into a problem, let their actions meet resistance that changes the old approach, then resolve the problem through a final choice earned by those experiences. Act transitions must change goals, conditions or risks. Establish causality before dividing chapters; fixed length percentages are not the rule.

heading.zh: 三幕分别解决什么写作问题
heading.en: The three acts have different jobs

body.zh:
Oh Story 的结构方法用“冲突开始、对抗、解决”概括三幕。本文用这三个任务检查故事进展；章数和长度随作品安排，不把方法文件里的题材偏好当作三幕适用范围的硬规则。

以下是原创图书馆故事。林月要在闭馆检修前找回旧画册：系统有归还扫描，架上却没有实物。此时不能确定画册在哪里，更不能从空书架推定读者应赔偿。本例设定林月可以登记待查，最终盘点更正由负责人确认。

| 幕 | 记录 |
|---|---|
| 第一幕：建立问题 | 任务：建立目标、阻力与期限。例子：归还扫描与实物不一致，同事想尽快结清盘点。变化：林月登记待查，询问读者并核查归还流程。 |
| 第二幕：对抗与调整 | 任务：让尝试改变下一步。例子：读者提供还书时间，扫描与搬箱时间重叠；录像只拍到还书箱，不能识别画册。值班员说那批箱子移到库房。变化：继续问读者不能补上馆内流向，她转查那批即将搬走的箱子；比对标签与箱内书目，发现混装。 |
| 第三幕：解决 | 任务：用已铺的线索和行动回应核心问题。例子：林月在待修箱找到画册，核对条码与归还扫描；负责人查看记录和实物后更正盘点，林月向读者发出更正说明，收到“已收到，但之前那次催问让我很不舒服”的回复。结果：画册与记录问题解决，信任和流转流程仍有后续。 |

第一幕不必先写大量日常，第二幕不靠不相干的麻烦填长度，第三幕不突然增加藏书地点。每幕承接前面发生的事。两列表是作者检查卡，不是原生卷纲格式。
body.en:
Oh Story summarizes three acts as conflict beginning, confrontation, and resolution. Use these jobs to check development, allowing the work to determine chapter count and length. The source’s genre preferences are not universal limits on three-act structure.

This is an original library story. Lin Yue must locate an old art book before maintenance closure. A return scan exists, but the shelf is empty. Neither fact identifies the book’s location or establishes that the borrower owes a charge. In this fictional arrangement, Lin can mark an item for investigation; the supervisor confirms final inventory corrections.

| Act | Record |
|---|---|
| Setup | Job: establish objective, resistance, and deadline. Example: the scan and physical inventory disagree; a colleague wants to close the inventory. Change: Lin marks the case unresolved, asks the borrower, and checks return handling. |
| Confrontation | Job: let attempts shape the next move. Example: the borrower gives a time overlapping the scan and box movement. Footage shows the return box, without identifying the book. The duty worker says that batch went to storage. Change: more questions to the borrower cannot fill the internal handling gap; Lin checks the departing boxes and finds mixed contents by comparing labels and inventories. |
| Resolution | Job: answer the central problem through established clues and action. Example: Lin finds the art book in repair stock and matches its barcode to the return scan. The supervisor checks the book and records, then corrects the inventory. Lin sends an explanation and receives: “Received, but that earlier call was upsetting.” Result: the book and record are settled; trust and handling procedures retain an aftermath. |

Setup need not contain extensive routine. Confrontation need not fill its length with unrelated trouble. Resolution must not invent a hiding place. Each act inherits preceding events. This two-column card is an editorial check, not the native volume-outline format.

heading.zh: 转折改变做法，不只是换场景
heading.en: A turn changes the approach, not merely the location

body.zh:
“林月来到库房”只写位置变化。“馆内流向未查明，箱子又即将搬走，她必须改变调查重点”，才说明这一步为什么重要。

转折可以填三行：

> 原计划：从最后一位读者和借阅记录核对归还情况。
>
> 新依据：读者提供的时间与归还扫描、搬箱记录重叠；值班员确认那批箱子进了库房。录像看不清书，仍不能单凭它确认画册在箱里。
>
> 新选择：暂停重复催问，先检查馆内那批箱子，并向同事说明先前只盯读者的判断不充分。

新依据不必一次证明全部真相，只要足以支持下一步。混装是入库房检查后才发现的结果，不能在进库房前就让林月知道标签错在哪里。

中段转折可以来自证据、失败、关系变化，也可以是成功打开新办法。若几个访谈都只重复“不知道”，压缩重复；保留改变调查路线、理解或合作条件的内容。提前铺设搬箱安排、标签格式和接触箱子的人，结尾便能利用它们，而不临时增加秘密库房。
body.en:
“Lin enters storage” gives a location change. “Internal handling remains unknown, and the boxes are about to move, so she changes the investigation’s focus” explains the significance.

Write three lines for the turn:

> Old plan: check the last borrower and lending record for the return.
>
> New basis: the borrower’s reported time overlaps the return scan and box movement. The duty worker confirms that batch went to storage. Footage cannot identify the book and does not itself establish that it was in the box.
>
> New choice: stop repeating the same questions, inspect the internal batch first, and tell the colleague that focusing only on the borrower was insufficient.

A clue need not prove the whole solution; it must support the next action. Lin discovers mixed contents during the storage check, rather than knowing the labeling fault before she gets there.

A middle turn can arise from evidence, failure, a changed relationship, or success opening another approach. Compress interviews repeating “I don’t know”; retain changes to the route, understanding, or cooperation. Establish box handling, label conventions, and access beforehand so the ending can use them without inventing a secret storeroom.

heading.zh: 长篇连载怎么用：单卷结算，全书继续
heading.en: Use acts within a serial volume

body.zh:
长篇可以让一卷完成一个主要问题，同时保留全书目标。图书馆这一卷找回画册、处理错误记录；下一卷可以围绕已提前出现的档案整理计划展开，而不是发现画册后立刻重置成同一场丢书调查。

不要要求每章都塞完三幕。调查的一章可以只完成新线索与决定，下一章才处理后果。单章也可以着重等待、陪伴或理解，不必每章发现新线索；看它在整卷里的作用，而不是把每章变成独立短篇。

如果第二幕特别长，拆成几个彼此有因果的阶段：查借阅与归还扫描、搬箱记录和证人指向库房、箱内实物核对发现标签问题。每阶段有自己的小结果，并把新条件送给下一阶段。
body.en:
A serial volume can settle one major problem while the whole-book goal continues. This volume finds the book and corrects the record; a later volume may pursue an archive project established earlier. Do not reset immediately into the same missing-book investigation.

Every chapter need not contain all three acts. One chapter can uncover a clue and establish a decision; another handles the result. A chapter may emphasize waiting, companionship, or understanding without finding a new clue. Judge its role within the volume rather than turning every chapter into a standalone short story.

For a long confrontation, use causal stages: lending and return scans, handling records and a witness pointing to storage, then contents checks exposing the labeling fault. Each stage pays off locally and supplies conditions for the next.

heading.zh: 三幕都有了，仍然不好读，先查这些
heading.en: Repair an outline that has three acts but little progress

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修订方向 |
|---|---|
| 第一幕只有背景 | 把必须处理的异常或冲突提前，相关背景随行动交代 |
| 第二幕一直拖到期限 | 检查尝试怎样影响后续，压缩无作用的重复；不必每次都新增损失 |
| 转折靠巧合送答案 | 让人物的调查、选择或对手行动产生新条件 |
| 第三幕突然新增办法 | 提前铺设工具、知识或合作，结尾实际使用；既定代价有发生时再交代 |
| 结尾解决了另一个问题 | 对照第一幕的核心承诺，补原问题的明确结果 |

结构表是检查工具。若作者选用另一种组织方式，也应检查目标、因果和回报，而不是强行把每一段贴成三幕标签。
body.en:
| Problem | Revision |
|---|---|
| Setup contains only background | Bring the necessary anomaly or conflict forward; reveal relevant context through action |
| Confrontation merely delays a deadline | Check how attempts affect what follows; compress purposeless repetition without requiring a fresh loss every time |
| Chance supplies every turn | Let investigation, choices or opposing actions create new conditions |
| Resolution invents a new solution | Establish tools, knowledge, or cooperation earlier and actually use them; show an established cost when it occurs |
| The ending solves a different problem | Return to the setup’s central promise and give it a definite result |

The outline is a checking tool. An author using another structure still needs goals, causality and payoff, without forcing every passage into an act label.

q.zh: 三幕必须按固定字数比例分吗？
q.en: Must the acts follow fixed length percentages?

a.zh: 不必。本篇按每幕承担的任务判断，长度随内容分量变化。比例只能辅助看明显失衡，不能替代人物行动和因果。
a.en: No. Judge each act by its job and let length follow the material. A proportion may help spot imbalance, but it cannot replace action and causality.

q.zh: 第二幕卡住，怎么找下一步？
q.en: How do I find the next step in a stalled second act?

a.zh: 先写旧计划为何失效，再让当前选择产生新条件。如果只是不断增加不相关麻烦，回到主角目标与已铺线索重新安排。
a.en: Identify why the old plan fails, then let the present choice create a new condition. If you only add unrelated trouble, return to the goal and established clues.

text.zh: 对 story-long-write 说：“只规划这段故事的三幕方案。列每幕目标、行动、结果和转折的新条件；检查结尾是否回应开头，不展开章节正文。”
text.en: Ask story-long-write for a three-act plan only: goal, action, result and changed conditions at each turn. Check that the ending answers the opening without drafting chapters.

title.zh: 小说剧情不合理怎么改：检查选择、证据与后果
title.en: How to Fix Plot Logic With Cause and Effect

seo_title.zh: 小说剧情不合理怎么改：检查选择、证据与后果
seo_title.en: How to Fix Plot Logic With Cause and Effect

description.zh: 把事件清单改成因果链，核对人物为什么知道、为什么行动、结果怎样出现。附原创调查故事对照和逻辑修改表。
description.en: Turn an event list into a causal chain. Check knowledge, choices and outcomes with an original investigation example and a revision table.

answer.zh: 逐个转折问三件事：人物依据什么作决定，这个决定怎样改变条件，下一件事为什么因此发生。缺原因就补必要证据或约束，缺后果就让选择真正改变局面。不要只加一句“他忽然想到”或用角色降智把剧情推到预定结局。
answer.en: At each turn, ask what supports the decision, how it changes conditions and why the next event follows. Supply missing evidence or constraints and make choices produce consequences. A sudden insight or a character acting foolishly is not a substitute for the missing causal link.

heading.zh: 先分事件顺序与因果关系
heading.en: Separate chronological order from cause

body.zh:
Oh Story 的结构方法区分静态事实、发生变化的事件，以及按因果组织出来的故事。两件事先后发生，不代表前者造成后者。

**只有顺序：**林月接到投诉，去了库房，看见一箱旧书，找到丢失的画册。

**补上因果：**投诉说画册已归还；林月核对归还扫描与搬箱记录，发现时间重叠；值班员记得那批箱子被临时放进库房；林月比较标签与箱内书目，找到画册，再核对实物条码。时间重叠提供调查方向，找到并核对的实物才解决“是不是这本书”。

第二版的每一步都说明下一步为什么合理。它仍可以有意外，但意外出现后，人物要根据新条件行动，不能用巧合连续送齐全部答案。
body.en:
Oh Story distinguishes static facts, changing events and a story organized through causality. Two events happening in sequence does not mean one causes the other.

**Sequence only:** Lin receives a complaint, goes to storage, sees old books and finds the missing art book.

**Causal version:** the complaint says the book was returned; Lin checks the return scan and handling record, whose times overlap; the duty worker remembers that batch going to temporary storage; Lin compares labels and contents, finds the art book, and checks its barcode. Overlapping times suggest a route; the identified physical book answers whether it is this item.

Every step explains the next. Chance can occur, but the protagonist must respond to its new conditions rather than receive every answer through repeated coincidence.

heading.zh: 用三栏表找断点
heading.en: Use a three-column audit to find gaps

body.zh:
以下是原创图书馆故事。系统有归还扫描，架上没有画册，本身不能确定任何人的责任。本例中林月可登记待查，盘点更正由负责人确认。

| 已有依据 | 行动与结果 |
|---|---|
| 归还扫描与空书架不一致 | 行动：林月登记待查，先询问读者并查馆内流程。结果：读者提供还书时间，同事担心盘点期限；报时仍只是读者的陈述。 |
| 读者报时、归还扫描与搬箱记录时间重叠 | 行动：询问当天值班员。结果：对方说那批箱子送往库房，并指出放置区域；这给出路线，不证明书已在箱内。 |
| 值班员说搬运时换过临时标签 | 行动：比较那批标签与箱内书目。结果：发现修复书与归还书混装，在待修箱找到画册；林月再用实物条码核对归还扫描，确认是同一本。 |
| 实物与扫描已匹配，画册先前只是错归类 | 行动：林月提交核对记录，负责人查看实物后更正盘点；她向读者发送说明。结果：读者回复已收到，但仍不满先前催问。书和记录问题解决，关系后果继续。 |

表格是作者检查因果的工作表，不是原生卷纲。空项可以提示你提问：人物从哪里知道？他做了什么？这段给后文留下什么？但等待、陪伴和氛围段不必套齐所有项，也不必每段得到新证据。

不必把因果全用旁白解释。显示扫描时间、实际问话、箱子标签与实物核对，读者就能看懂联系。重要的是线索支持人物的下一步，不能让他提前知道作者留到结尾的答案。
body.en:
This is an original library story. A return scan and empty shelf do not establish anyone’s responsibility. Here Lin can mark a case unresolved, while a supervisor confirms inventory corrections.

| Available basis | Action and result |
|---|---|
| The return scan conflicts with the empty shelf | Action: Lin marks the case for investigation, asks the borrower, and checks internal handling. Result: the borrower supplies a time and a colleague worries about the deadline; the reported time remains the borrower’s account. |
| That account, the scan, and handling record overlap | Action: ask the duty worker. Result: the worker says that batch went to storage and gives its area. This provides a route without proving the book is inside. |
| The worker reports changing temporary labels | Action: compare batch labels and contents. Result: repair stock and returned books are mixed; Lin finds the art book and matches its barcode to the scan, identifying the same item. |
| The identified book had been misclassified | Action: Lin submits her checks; the supervisor examines the book and corrects inventory. Lin sends an explanation. Result: the borrower acknowledges receipt but remains upset about the earlier inquiry. The book and record are settled; the relationship retains consequences. |

This is an editorial causality worksheet, not a native volume outline. An empty field prompts questions: how does the character know, what do they do, and what carries forward? Waiting, companionship, and atmosphere need not fill every field or discover evidence in every passage.

Show scan times, actual questions, labels, and an item check rather than explaining every link in narration. The clue must support the next action without giving the character the author’s future answer.

heading.zh: 再问：人物能不能轻易避开这件事
heading.en: Check whether an easier alternative breaks the plot

body.zh:
林月为什么不直接打电话问读者？可以问。本例读者给出还书时间，有助于缩小范围，却不能单凭这句话确认实物流向。已有归还扫描，也不能从空书架直接推定读者责任；继续核查馆内搬运。让简单办法产生它实际能产生的结果，再处理剩下的问题，不为调查篇幅让所有人忘记电话。

检查三种容易漏掉的选择：

- **现成工具**：记录、电话、钥匙或已建立的能力能否立即解决？能解决就用，或提前说明合理限制。
- **退出路径**：主角能否放弃却不失去任何东西？若故事需要他留下，写清目标、承诺或现实代价。
- **信息传播**：谁知道了新事实，何时告诉别人？消息公开不等于每个人都看过。按谁实际读到、听到或被告知更新人物判断；不知道的人可以仍用旧信息。

约束要属于设定与人物处境。不临时让手机全部没电，也不让善于核对的人突然完全不检查。
body.en:
Why not call the borrower? Lin can. The reported time narrows the search but does not alone establish physical handling. With a return scan present, the empty shelf does not directly establish borrower responsibility either; check internal movement. Let the simple method deliver what it can, then address the remaining gap without making everyone forget phones exist.

Check three alternatives:

- **Available tools:** could a record, phone, key or established ability solve this? Use it or establish a credible limit beforehand.
- **An exit:** could the protagonist quit without losing anything? If they must stay, establish a goal, promise or real cost.
- **Information sharing:** who learns the fact, and when is it shared? Publication does not mean everyone has read it. Update judgments for people who actually read, heard, or were told; others may still use old information.

Constraints must belong to setting and character. Do not suddenly drain every phone or make a careful person stop checking anything.

heading.zh: 逻辑修改不要顺手重写整本故事
heading.en: Repair the missing link without casually replacing the story

body.zh:
| 断点 | 修订记录 |
|---|---|
| 人物突然知道库房在哪 | 局部修法：提前交代值班员提供路线；若仍不成立：重新安排调查顺序 |
| 同事无理由拒绝合作 | 局部修法：写明盘点期限和责任分歧；若仍不成立：调整冲突，不把同事写成无脑阻拦者 |
| 关键标签此前没出现 | 局部修法：在搬箱或记录场景里给可见线索；若仍不成立：修改揭示方式与铺垫 |
| 找到书却无后果 | 局部修法：明确盘点更正与误判后的关系回应；若仍不成立：重新确定本段承诺 |

先修有证据的局部缺口。若修法需要改主线真相、人物重大选择或结局，就回大纲确认，不能在一句润色里悄悄换掉。修改后从前一个决定读到后一个结果，检查新补的约束是否又造成矛盾。

这篇检查的是“为什么会发生”；[人物、时间线与伏笔检查](/oh-story/ai-fiction-consistency-check)另负责“已发生的事实是否前后一致”。两项能帮助发现不同缺口，仍需看人物目标、情绪和读者关心的问题。
body.en:
| Gap | Revision record |
|---|---|
| Lin suddenly knows the storage route | Local repair: Establish the worker’s directions; If still insufficient: Reorder the investigation |
| A colleague refuses without reason | Local repair: Show deadline and responsibility concerns; If still insufficient: Revise the conflict rather than making them foolish |
| The decisive label never appeared | Local repair: Show it during handling or record checking; If still insufficient: Replan setup and reveal |
| Finding the book changes nothing | Local repair: Establish the inventory correction and the response to the mistaken judgment; If still insufficient: Reconsider the sequence’s promise |

Fix supported local gaps first. A repair changing the main truth, major choice or ending belongs in outline revision, not a casual sentence edit. Reread from the preceding decision through the following result to catch contradictions caused by the new constraint.

This article checks why events happen. [Character, chronology and clue continuity](/oh-story/ai-fiction-consistency-check) checks whether established facts stay consistent. Both expose different gaps; still review goals, emotion, and what readers care about.

q.zh: 所有巧合都不能用吗？
q.en: Must I remove every coincidence?

a.zh: 不必。巧合可以让故事开始或产生新压力。关键问题的解决仍应来自人物对条件的处理，不连续用巧合送答案和胜利。
a.en: No. Chance can start the story or create pressure. Major solutions should still follow how characters handle conditions rather than repeated chance delivering answers and victories.

q.zh: 剧情合理，就一定好看吗？
q.en: Does logical plotting automatically make a good story?

a.zh: 不一定。因果让读者相信事情这样发生，目标、情绪和回报让他愿意继续看。逻辑检查后还要看冲突是否值得关心、选择是否有分量。
a.en: No. Causality makes the sequence believable; goals, emotion and payoff make it worth following. Also check whether the conflict matters and the choices carry weight.

text.zh: 把大纲交给 story-long-write：“只检查这段情节的因果，按已有依据、人物行动、可见结果列断点。先给局部修法；需要改主线或结局的方案另列，不直接重写。”
text.en: Give story-long-write the outline and request a causal audit only: available evidence, action and result. Ask for local repairs first, separating proposals that change the main plot or ending.

label.en: Goals, resistance and costs of leaving

title.zh: 小说主题怎么写不说教：让选择与后果给出答案
title.en: How to Write a Story Theme Without Preaching

seo_title.zh: 小说主题怎么写不说教：让选择与后果给出答案
seo_title.en: How to Write a Story Theme Without Preaching

description.zh: 把抽象主题变成反复出现的选择，人物可以给出不同答案。附原创选择对照、场景修改与主题偏离检查。
description.en: Turn an abstract theme into recurring choices with different consequences. Includes an original comparison, a scene revision and checks for drift.

answer.zh: 先把主题改写成人物必须回答的问题，再安排不同角色的选择及其后果。主题会从这些因果里浮现，不需要人物轮流宣布道理。保留作者想要的核心情绪，但允许人物承担不同立场，让结局回应前面的选择，而不是用总结替代经历。
answer.en: Turn the theme into a question characters must answer, then give their choices consequences. Meaning emerges from those causal relationships without everyone announcing a lesson. Keep the intended emotional focus while allowing different positions, and make the ending answer earlier choices through what happens.

heading.zh: 把主题从口号改成人物问题
heading.en: Replace a slogan with a question characters can answer

body.zh:
Oh Story 的剧情方法用因果关系组织意义；商业创作方法以核心情绪检查全书取舍。这里借两者检查“同一问题、不同选择、实际后果”，不要求所有文学作品只有一种情绪，也不要求每个正确选择都受罚。

“诚信很重要”是观点，还不是场景。改成“先前把找不到书归咎于读者，发现馆内处理有误时，人物怎么回应”，就有具体行动与关系。

以下是原创图书馆故事：画册有归还扫描却不在架上，林月此前让读者回家再找。本例她可登记待查，盘点更正由负责人确认；现在是重新核查，不是凭空把已归还记录改成未归还。

| 人物 | 选择、好处与后果 |
|---|---|
| 林月 | 选择：登记待查，核查后承认先前催问不充分。好处：把调查转到可能的馆内流向。后果：需重新整理盘点，面对读者的实际不满；承认不保证获谅解。 |
| 同事 | 选择：希望先按现有表格结清，再处理争议。好处：赶上期限。后果：若未查清就结案，后续仍需重开盘点。他关心工期，不能写成只为衬托林月正确的笨人。 |
| 值班员 | 选择：说明换过临时标签，带林月查那批箱子。好处：提供具体路线。后果：混装经实物核对后，他与林月重列该箱书目；说明行为不自动等于承担全部责任。 |

让目标和压力可理解，再写实际发生的后果。表是编辑比较卡，不是原生人物档案。
body.en:
Oh Story’s plot method organizes meaning through causality; its commercial-writing method uses a core emotional focus to check a book’s choices. Apply these to a shared question, different decisions, and actual consequences, without requiring every literary work to have one emotion or punishing every favored choice.

“Honesty matters” is a position, not a scene. “After blaming the borrower for a missing book, how does someone respond to a handling error inside the library?” supplies action and relationships.

This is an original library story: a return scan exists, but the art book is absent from its shelf. Lin previously sent the borrower home to look again. Here she can mark a case for investigation; the supervisor confirms final inventory corrections. Rechecking the case does not turn a returned record into an unreturned one.

| Character | Choice and result |
|---|---|
| Lin | Choice: mark the case unresolved, investigate, and acknowledge that her earlier inquiry was insufficient. Benefit: examine a possible internal route. Consequence: redo inventory work and face the borrower’s actual dissatisfaction; acknowledgment does not guarantee forgiveness. |
| Colleague | Choice: close the existing ledger before returning to the dispute. Benefit: meet the deadline. Consequence: closing without checking may require reopening inventory. The colleague cares about workload rather than being foolish merely to prove Lin right. |
| Duty worker | Choice: disclose the temporary label change and help check that batch. Benefit: a specific route. Consequence: after identifying mixed contents, help Lin relist the box. Describing a label change does not establish sole responsibility. |

Make aims and pressure understandable, then show what actually follows. This is an editorial comparison, not a native character file.

heading.zh: 改前改后：把道理换成可见结果
heading.en: Before and after: replace a lecture with consequences

body.zh:
以下场景为原创。两版共用前提：林月已循搬箱记录在待修箱找到画册，核对了实物条码与归还扫描；负责人看过记录和书，同意更正。读者此刻来听说明。没有这些前提，只在单子上签名不能证明调查完成。

**改前：**

> 林月意识到诚信比个人面子更重要。她告诉同事，做人应该勇于承认错误，只有诚实才能获得真正的信任。

这段表达立场，却没有让读者看见她怎样回应自己的误判。

**改后：**

> 林月把找回的画册和核对表放在桌上。负责人在盘点表上更正了存放位置，把说明副本递给读者。
>
> “书在我们的待修箱里。”林月说，“上次让您回去再找，是我没有先查清馆里的搬运。”
>
> 同事指着截止时间。“这一箱都混了，今天的表要重列。”
>
> “我和今天值班的人重列。”
>
> 读者收起说明。“更正我收到了。上次我也说过已经还了。”

这个回复承认收到更正，没有替读者宣布原谅。接着写林月与值班员实际重列该箱书目、交回核对表，负责人接收后再结这一项；“我重做”是承诺，后续行动才兑现它。主题由人物回应和结果形成，不靠一句完美台词收账。
body.en:
This is an original comparison. Both versions share a premise: following box-handling records, Lin found the book in repair stock and matched its barcode to the return scan. The supervisor reviewed the book and records and accepted a correction. The borrower has come for an explanation. Without those steps, a signature alone does not establish completed investigation.

**Before:**

> Lin realized honesty mattered more than saving face. She told her colleague that people should admit mistakes and that honesty alone earns true trust.

This states a position without showing her response to the mistaken judgment.

**After:**

> Lin set the recovered book and checking sheet on the desk. The supervisor corrected its location on the inventory and handed the borrower a copy of the explanation.
>
> “It was in our repair box,” Lin said. “Last time, I sent you home to look before checking our handling.”
>
> Her colleague pointed at the deadline. “That whole box is mixed. Today’s list needs redoing.”
>
> “The duty worker and I will relist it.”
>
> The borrower put away the explanation. “I’ve received the correction. I told you last time that I’d returned it.”

The reply acknowledges receipt without declaring forgiveness. Follow with Lin and the worker actually relisting the box and returning the checking sheet; the supervisor receives it before closing that inventory item. Offering to redo work is a promise; later action fulfills it. Theme comes from response and consequence rather than a perfect final line.

heading.zh: 重复同一问题，别重复同一场训话
heading.en: Vary the pressure while keeping the thematic question

body.zh:
之后可以把同一问题放到不同关系里：林月对读者承认先前催问不充分，对同事承认自己先入为主，对负责人说明制度缺口。各次回应可以不同，不必每次增加惩罚，也不重复“诚信很重要”。

主题统一也不等于每章情绪相同。可以有轻松的找书场景、紧张的盘点、尴尬的道歉；这些可以一起呈现“出错后怎样负责”。笑话、日常和支线也能服务声线、陪伴与生活感，不必逐场证明主题价值；作品确有重复或分散阅读重点时，再按作者意图取舍。

不同人物可以保留分歧。同事担心期限并不自动成为反派；负责人是否接受延误、读者是否接受道歉，都可以有自己的答案。让故事检验立场，不用作者替所有角色盖章。
body.en:
Later, place the question in different relationships: Lin acknowledges the insufficient earlier inquiry to the borrower, her assumption to a colleague and a procedural gap to a supervisor. Responses can differ without a new punishment every time or repetition of the same moral speech.

Thematic unity does not require identical emotion every chapter. A light search scene, tense inventory, and awkward apology can develop responsibility after error. Jokes, ordinary life, and subplots may also serve voice, companionship, or a lived-in world. They need not justify themselves through theme in every scene; revise repetition or lost focus according to the author’s intention.

Characters may keep disagreements. Deadline concerns do not automatically make the colleague a villain. A supervisor may question the delay; the reader may reject the apology. Let events test their positions without authorial approval stamped on everyone.

heading.zh: 检查主题是否来自故事，而非最后一段
heading.en: Check that the theme exists before the closing paragraph

body.zh:
- 删掉总结句，人物的选择和后果是否仍能表现核心问题？不能，就补场景，不只补金句。
- 看重要转折是否在检验同一问题；若结尾突然换成另一条道理，重新核对前面的承诺。
- 检查后果是否由已设条件产生；不因人物支持作者观点就自动获奖，也不为显得深刻强制处罚正确选择。
- 让相反立场有可理解的理由，不写成只能被打败的稻草人。
- 检查旁白是否反复解释读者已经看见的意义，保留必要叙述，删重复裁决。

作者不一定先有一句完整主题再动笔。也可以从已写场景反复出现的选择里提炼问题，再回头修正偏离。核心是意义有故事依据，而非结尾贴上一个结论。
body.en:
- Remove summary sentences. Do choices and consequences still express the central question? If not, strengthen scenes rather than slogans.
- Check whether major turns test the same question. An ending that announces a different lesson needs earlier setup revised.
- Let consequences follow established conditions. Do not automatically reward the author’s favored position or punish a sound choice merely to appear profound.
- Make the opposing position understandable rather than a straw figure to defeat.
- Keep necessary narration but remove repeated judgments about meaning already visible in events.

An author need not settle a perfect theme sentence before drafting. You can identify a recurring question in existing choices and revise drift afterward. Meaning needs story evidence, not a conclusion pasted onto the end.

q.zh: 主题一定要让角色说出来吗？
q.en: Must a character state the theme aloud?

a.zh: 不用。人物可以有观点，但情节应让这些观点面对选择与后果。删掉宣讲后仍然成立的主题，通常更有说服力。
a.en: No. Characters may express views, but the plot should test them through choices and consequences. A theme that survives removing the speech is more convincing.

q.zh: 多个主题会不会分散？
q.en: Will several themes divide the story’s focus?

a.zh: 可以有多个问题，但先确定主线最重要的选择。次要问题应影响这个选择或人物关系，不要在结尾临时增加未经情节检验的道理。
a.en: Several questions can coexist, but identify the main plot’s central choice first. Secondary questions should affect it or the relationships rather than arrive as untested final lessons.

text.zh: 对 story-long-write 说：“只检查大纲的主题表达。提炼反复出现的人物问题，列不同选择和后果；指出说教段落怎样改成场景，不改变我已定的结局。”
text.en: Ask story-long-write to review thematic expression in the outline only. Identify the recurring question, choices and consequences, and suggest scene replacements for preaching while preserving the settled ending.

label.zh: 因果关系产生故事意义

title.zh: 仙侠小说修炼线怎么写：资源、突破与新目标
title.en: How to Write a Cultivation Arc in Xianxia Fiction

seo_title.zh: 仙侠小说修炼线怎么写：资源、突破与新目标
seo_title.en: How to Write a Cultivation Arc in Xianxia Fiction

description.zh: 把修炼写成争取资源、承担代价和改变处境的过程。附原创宗门试炼案例、升级表与境界设定的投放方法。
description.en: Build cultivation around resources, costs and changed circumstances. Includes an original sect trial, a progression worksheet and ways to introduce ranks.

answer.zh: 先定主角为了什么必须变强，再写他缺什么资源、谁控制资源、突破后能解决什么问题。修炼准备、失败和突破都要改变后续行动；赢一场之后，资源、资格或关系也应有明确结果。境界名称随具体收益和危险进入正文，不先堆完整等级表。
