| Return if the gate closes; do not pass it to the aide | A condition menu may suffice | Complex plans need a readable adopted meaning |

Menus may be clearer when combinations are few and costs explicit. Keep wording differences when arranging or negotiating is part of the role’s appeal.

“Handle it soon” cannot authorize arbitrary spending or disclosure. Ask about missing terms. If expression adds no value beyond existing actions, record `signature_command` as `N/A`.

heading.zh: 输入有效，也不等于安排必定成功
heading.en: Valid input still meets resistance

body.zh:
在纸面设计中，调度员提出：“换岗后由阿岚把这封信交给守门人；城门关闭就带回，内容只给收件人看。”先展示被采用的安排，再让世界按规则回应。

阿岚可能不在站内，守门人可能拒收，时间也可能被前一任务占用。这些是有依据的阻力，不能由模型随意换成“任务已完成”。部分执行时，写清已经做了哪一步、信仍在谁手里、谁实际得知了内容。

可支持的安排、费用、权限与保密后果都要在世界设计中确定。概念阶段只提出候选和风险，不冒充已经有可运行解析器。实现时的验证与状态提交另见[自由输入不乱改结果](/novel-to-game/llm-text-games)。
body.en:
In the paper design, the dispatcher says: “After the guard change, have Alan deliver this letter to the gatekeeper. Return if the gate is closed; show the contents only to the recipient.” Display the adopted plan before the world responds.

Alan may be absent, the recipient may refuse or an earlier job may occupy the time. Grounded resistance cannot become a model’s invented success. Partial execution must say what happened, who holds the letter and who learned its contents.

World design determines supported plans, costs, rights and disclosure effects. A concept proposes candidates and risks; it is not a working parser. See the separate free-input guide for validation and state commits.

heading.zh: 原型只检验最重要的表达差别
heading.en: Test the important difference

body.zh:
为同一小任务准备按钮版和自由表达版，使用相同世界条件。让参与者做一项确实需要取舍的安排，观察：能否理解动作，能否预判代价，能否看出结果对应自己哪项决定。

这是一份待执行的比较方案，不是测试成绩。若输入自由了，结果仍全部相同，先修玩法；若表达有价值但常被误读，缩小候选范围、增加采用前确认，或改用组合菜单。不要靠新增无限 NPC 对话掩盖问题。

保留能够重复使用、产生不同后果的核心动作。输入方式应帮助玩家做决定，而不是增加打字工作。
body.en:
Prepare button and free-text versions of the same small task under the same world conditions. Ask participants to make a consequential plan. Observe whether they understand actions, anticipate costs and identify which decision caused the result.

This is an unrun comparison plan. If every input produces the same result, repair the gameplay. If valuable expression is often misread, bound intents, confirm the adopted plan or use a menu that combines choices. More NPC chat will not fix the decision.

Keep repeatable actions with distinct consequences. Input should help the player decide rather than merely type.

q.zh: 按钮会不会让文字游戏显得不够智能？
q.en: Do buttons make a text game less intelligent?

a.zh: 不会。可理解的选择、真实的代价和世界对过去行为的回应更重要；打字后只得到同一结果，互动并未增加。
a.en: No. Clear choices, meaningful costs and remembered consequences matter more. Typing toward the same outcome adds little interaction.

text.zh: 用 $game-concept 比较此小说游戏的按钮与自由输入。基于已有 SOURCE_BIBLE 和 PRODUCT_BRIEF，写玩家身份、反复任务、按钮能否完整表达、值得保留的措辞差异与世界阻力；无必要则 signature_command 为 N/A。不写解析器或声称已测试。
text.en: Use $game-concept with the existing SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF to compare buttons and free text: role, recurring job, expressive value and world resistance. Use N/A for signature_command when unnecessary. Do not implement a parser or claim test results.

title.zh: 游戏参考怎么分析：借玩法，不只看题材相似
title.en: How to Analyze Gameplay References

seo_title.zh: 游戏参考怎么分析：借玩法，不只看题材相似
seo_title.en: How to Analyze Gameplay References

description.zh: 按当前设计问题拆玩法参考，记录核心动作、循环、压力与熟练度。用原创改编方案示例说明借什么、不借什么，以及怎样验证。
description.en: Analyze references by actions, loops, pressure and mastery. Use an original adaptation worksheet to state what to borrow, omit and test.

answer.zh: 先写本项目要解决的设计问题，再选能回答它的主要玩法参考。分析玩家反复做什么、为什么要取舍、怎样变熟练，以及结果如何回到下一轮；辅助参考只补独立缺口。记录借与不借的部分，让原作规则改变玩法，不用同题材和截图代替分析。
answer.en: Name the design question, then choose a primary reference that answers it. Study repeated actions, trade-offs, mastery and carryover. Auxiliary references fill separate gaps. Record what to borrow and omit, and let the source story’s rules change the play.

heading.zh: 先写需要参考回答的问题
heading.en: Write the question first

body.zh:
novel-to-game 的概念方法按设计问题选择先例。小说里有侦探、宫廷或经营，不意味着只看同题材游戏；你可能需要的是追问顺序、证据比较、任务压力或关系记忆。

先填写：“玩家以什么身份，反复做什么工作？当前最不清楚的是哪一步？”例如原创渡口故事中，玩家是摆渡人，需要在有限班次里安排乘客；原作设定某些乘客彼此不能同行。设计问题是怎样让调度和识别人际约束都成为可读选择。

主参考解释核心循环，辅助参考只解决主参考没回答的问题。不能说明具体缺口的参考，先从清单里删掉；数量并不证明分析深入。
body.en:
The concept method selects precedents by design question. A detective, court or business setting does not require references from that same genre. You may need question order, evidence comparison, time pressure or remembered relationships.

Write: “Who is the player, what recurring job do they do, and which step is unclear?” In an original ferry story, the player schedules passengers across limited departures. The source establishes pairs who cannot travel together. The question is how scheduling and reading those constraints become clear choices.

A primary reference explains the loop; an auxiliary one answers a distinct gap. Remove references without a named purpose. A long list is not deeper analysis.

heading.zh: 把游玩观察写成可用记录
heading.en: Turn observations into a usable record

body.zh:
| 要记的事 | 观察什么 | 本项目要决定 |
|---|---|---|
| 核心动作 | 玩家亲自操作什么 | 采用哪种参与方式 |
| 循环与压力 | 结果怎样影响下一轮、为何不能全选 | 如何保留取舍 |
| 熟练度 | 重玩后判断或操作怎样改善 | 成长来自什么 |
| 借与不借 | 哪项机制解决问题，哪项超出范围 | 切片保留边界 |

为真实参考填写这些项时，区分亲自游玩、官方材料和推测，附对应记录或来源。销量、榜单和平台信息只有确实影响当前决定时才核对，不拿它们代替玩法证据。

不要只写“节奏很好”“有沉浸感”。改成可观察过程：玩家先看需求，再安排位置，遇到冲突后调整；或拿到新证词，回头质问先前对象。记录要能指导下一项设计。
body.en:
| Record | Observe | Decide |
|---|---|---|
| Actions | What the player does | Form of participation |
| Loop and pressure | Carryover and why not everything is possible | Required trade-offs |
| Mastery | How judgment or skill improves | Source of growth |
| Borrow and omit | Useful mechanism and excess scope | Slice boundaries |

For real references, separate direct play, official material and inference, and attach evidence. Check sales, rankings or platform facts only when they change the decision; they do not replace gameplay evidence.

Replace “good pacing” with an observable process: inspect demand, place people, revise a conflict; or hear testimony and return to question an earlier witness. The record should guide a design decision.

heading.zh: 原创示例：让原作改变安排
heading.en: Example: the source changes the plan

body.zh:
以下是原创纸面方案，不描述某款真实游戏，也不报告游玩结果。渡口设计考虑借一种排程循环：查看请求、分配班次、执行、处理反馈。它不借参考里无关的建城系统或大量生产链。

原作的人际约束必须进入动作：玩家知道阿禾不愿与旧雇主同船，便要改班次、征求她的同意，或承担失约后果。不能只在开场讲过她的过去，后续排程仍只按空位自动填满。

若另一个参考用于信息呈现，记录它只解决“怎样看见已知约束”，不顺手复制它的地图、角色或界面。最终方案应写清安排前看见什么、玩家改变什么、执行后谁接受或拒绝，下一轮哪些条件被继承。
body.en:
This original paper design describes no real game and reports no play results. The ferry concept considers a scheduling loop: inspect requests, assign departures, execute and handle feedback. It omits unrelated city-building or production chains.

The source’s relationship constraint must affect actions. Knowing that Ahe refuses to share a boat with her former employer, the player changes departures, seeks consent or bears a broken agreement. Her past cannot remain a prologue while later scheduling simply fills seats.

An auxiliary presentation reference addresses only how known constraints are visible; it does not supply copied maps, characters or screens. Specify visible facts, player changes, accepted or refused execution, and carryover.

heading.zh: 用切片验证借来的机制
heading.en: Test the borrowed mechanism

body.zh:
给每项借用写一句待验证问题，例如：“不读长篇解释，玩家能否识别人际冲突，并在班次、承诺与时间中做出不同安排？”只做足以回答这句的小切片。

若所有安排都由旁白修成同一结局，参考没有带来因果选择；若必须堆大量地点才能看懂，先缩小范围；若删掉原作名字后动作、代价与回应都没区别，继续让原作规则进入循环。

先例分析服务于决定。交付一张简明记录、明确取舍和未执行的验证计划即可，不靠小数评分掩盖没有证据的推荐。后续实际游玩再写结果与失败情况。
body.en:
Attach a question to each borrowed mechanism: “Can players recognize the relationship conflict without a long explanation and make distinct plans across departures, promises and time?” Build only enough to answer it.

If narration repairs every plan into one ending, there is little causal choice. If understanding needs many locations, reduce scope. If removing source names leaves actions, costs and responses unchanged, bring more source rules into the loop.

Reference analysis serves a decision. Deliver a compact record, explicit trade-offs and an unrun test plan. Decimal scores cannot replace evidence. Report outcomes after actual play.

q.zh: 需要给每个方案找很多游戏参考吗？
q.en: Does each concept need many references?

a.zh: 不需要。主要参考解释循环，必要的辅助参考补独立问题；无法说明用途的名单不增加设计依据。
a.en: No. A primary reference explains the loop; useful auxiliaries fill distinct gaps. A list without purposes adds little evidence.

text.zh: 用 $game-concept 分析已有 SOURCE_BIBLE 和 PRODUCT_BRIEF 的玩法参考。先列当前设计问题，记录主参考的动作、循环、压力、熟练度与来源，再写借什么、不借什么、原作如何改变它及最小验证问题。不按题材相似或销量替我选。
text.en: Use $game-concept with the existing SOURCE_BIBLE and PRODUCT_BRIEF to analyze gameplay references: design question, actions, loop, pressure, mastery, evidence, borrow/omit decisions, source-specific changes and a minimal test. Do not choose from genre resemblance or sales alone.

title.zh: 自动字幕识别错了怎么改：人名、否定词与原声对白
title.en: Fix Automatic Subtitle Errors in a Video Recap

seo_title.zh: 自动字幕识别错了怎么改：人名、否定词与原声对白
seo_title.en: Fix Automatic Subtitle Errors in a Video Recap

description.zh: 先分清旁白、原声对白和画面硬字幕，再对照实际声音纠正人名与否定词。说明校对文件的优先级、原片与成片时间轴及重做后的检查。
description.en: Correct names and negation against actual speech. Separate narration, dialogue and burned text, then choose the right subtitle source and clock.

answer.zh: 先听采用的声音，确认错的是文字还是录音，再找到真正被合成使用的字幕来源。原声留白可用用户字幕或已校对的 original_subtitles.json；优先级和时间轴必须正确。只改低优先级文件或把原片时码当成片时码，错误仍会出现。
answer.en: Listen to the adopted audio, identify whether text or speech is wrong, and correct the subtitle source assembly actually uses. Dialogue gaps can use supplied subtitles or corrected original_subtitles.json. Source priority and source-versus-output time must match.

heading.zh: 先找到错误属于哪一层
heading.en: Locate the wrong layer

body.zh:
video-recap 的数据契约区分解说旁白与原声留白。旁白文字应对应采用的配音；对白字幕则对应留白里真正听见的句子。原片已经烧进画面的硬字幕是像素，另改一份文字文件不会擦除它。

原创素材中，人物说“不是顾砚，是顾源”，自动识别却写成“是顾砚，是顾源”。丢掉否定词，人物纠正姓名的意思变了。先回听这句，再对照本片已核定的人物名单确定姓名字形，不依据剧情猜它该说什么；听不清时记录待确认，不能补一个看似合理的名字。

若录音本身说错，修改屏幕字幕只能制造音画矛盾，应先决定是否更换声音。下面的方法重点处理已经正确出声的原声对白。
body.en:
The data contract distinguishes narration from original-dialogue gaps. Narration text follows the adopted voice track; dialogue subtitles follow what is actually audible in a gap. Text already burned into source frames is pixels, which a text-file edit cannot erase.

In an original example, a speaker says “Not Gu Yan—Gu Yuan.” ASR produces “Gu Yan—Gu Yuan,” losing the correction. Listen and check the approved character list for spelling; do not infer the intended name from the plot. Mark unclear speech for confirmation rather than guessing.

If the recording is wrong, changing the subtitle creates a mismatch. Decide about the audio first. The following workflow focuses on dialogue that is already spoken correctly.

heading.zh: 改真正会被读取的字幕文件
heading.en: Correct the source that wins

body.zh:
原声留白字幕的优先级从高到低是：`user_subtitles.json`、用户提供的 SRT/ASS、Agent 校对的 `original_subtitles.json`、ASR 兜底。若前面已有旧用户字幕，只改后面的校对文件，仍可能读到旧文字。

| 当前来源 | 先做什么 | 核对什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 用户字幕 | 在采用的版本中改人名或否定词 | 是否覆盖了需要保留的对白 |
| 已校对白 | 更新实际出声句子的记录 | 是否仍对应当前剪辑 |
| 识别兜底 | 准备有依据的校对文件 | 不靠粗略估时冒充精确对白 |

一次修改的范围也要说明。若用户文件不是完整对白集，先确定剩余句子的保留方案，不假设会自动与低优先级文件逐条合并。字幕内容核对不等于已完成出入点听审。
body.en:
Dialogue-gap priority is: user_subtitles.json, supplied SRT/ASS, corrected original_subtitles.json, then ASR fallback. An older supplied file can still win even after the lower-priority correction is fixed.

| Source | First action | Check |
|---|---|---|
| Supplied text | Correct the adopted version | Coverage of retained dialogue |
| Reviewed text | Update audible utterances | Match to the current edit |
| ASR fallback | Prepare supported corrections | No coarse timing presented as precise |

State the edit’s coverage. If a supplied file contains only part of the dialogue, plan how remaining lines are retained; do not assume line-by-line merging with lower-priority files. Correct wording is separate from reviewing cue boundaries.

heading.zh: 原片时码与成片时码不能混用
heading.en: Keep the two clocks separate

body.zh:
下面是原创纸面时间示例，不是已合成的视频。原片第 110—113 秒的句子，剪进当前成片后位于第 8—11 秒。只填 110—113 而不说明轴，可能让字幕完全离开对应画面。

在这一固定版本中，`user_subtitles.json` 的裸数组默认是成片 OUTPUT 轴；包一层 `timeline` 与 `lines` 可明确指定 `source` 或 `output`。用户 SRT/ASS 默认按原片轴映射；`original_subtitles.json` 使用成片轴。

例如要提供原片轴校对，可写：

> {"timeline":"source","lines":[{"start":110,"end":113,"text":"不是顾砚，是顾源。"}]}

这只是文件形状示例，实际区间必须回听原片并依据当前剪辑映射。精确来源会按句区间裁到留白边界，跨边界可拆分；不能把 ASR 的中点估时当作相同证据。
body.en:
This fictional timing example is not rendered media. A source utterance at 110–113 seconds appears at 8–11 seconds in the current cut. Unqualified source times can put the subtitle away from its speech.

In this pinned version, a bare user_subtitles.json array defaults to the OUTPUT clock. An envelope with timeline and lines can specify source or output. Supplied SRT/ASS defaults to source time; original_subtitles.json uses output time.

A source-clock correction can use:

> {"timeline":"source","lines":[{"start":110,"end":113,"text":"Not Gu Yan—Gu Yuan."}]}

This shows file shape only. Obtain actual intervals from listening and the current edit map. Precise sources are clipped to covered dialogue-gap intervals and may split across boundaries. ASR midpoint estimates provide different evidence.

heading.zh: 重做后检查实际听到和看到的内容
heading.en: Review the actual new output

body.zh:
用当前文件重做后，播放姓名出现、否定词、句子交界和旁白切回的片段，再完整看一遍实际交付文件。检查是否多了一行旧字幕、换场后还残留上一句、原声被压住，或硬字幕与新对白互相遮挡。

原声对白是否烧录还受现有遮罩和用户替换要求影响，文件存在不保证它已显示。需要替换旧硬字幕时，另按明确方案处理画面；不要用新文字叠在错误文字上就当修好了。

若项目采用显式 `subtitle_track.json`，它是完整替换字幕轨，不能当一条纠错补丁；需携带所有应保留的 cue 并匹配当前音画。本文没有渲染或试听结果，文件合法也不能代替实际播放。
body.en:
After rebuilding from current files, review names, negation, cue edges and returns from narration, then watch the actual full deliverable. Look for duplicate old lines, text left across cuts, inaudible dialogue or competing burned captions.

Burning dialogue also depends on the mask and explicit replacement request. A file’s presence does not prove it appears. Replacing source-burned errors requires a picture-edit plan; overlapping new text is not a repair by itself.

If the project uses an explicit subtitle_track.json, it completely replaces generated subtitles; it is not a one-cue patch. Carry all retained cues and bind current media. No rendering or listening result is reported here; valid files do not replace playback.

q.zh: 校对文件改对了，为什么导出还是旧字？
q.en: Why does export still show old text after correction?

a.zh: 先看是否仍采用更高优先级的用户字幕，再核对是否重新合成当前版本；也可能旧字已烧在原片画面里。分清来源后再修对应层。
a.en: Check for a higher-priority supplied subtitle file and whether the current version was rebuilt. The old text may also be burned into source frames. Correct the relevant layer.

text.zh: 用 $video-recap 只修这段原声对白字幕。回听当前采用的声音，核对人名与否定词，列实际字幕来源及优先级、原片或成片轴与留白区间。保留其他文案和声音；重做后报告实际显示与播放检查，未检查就明确写未检查。
text.en: Use $video-recap to correct only these dialogue subtitles. Listen to adopted speech; check names, negation, winning subtitle source, clock and gap intervals. Preserve other copy and audio. Report actual display and playback checks after rebuilding, or mark them unperformed.

label.zh: 对白字幕来源与两条时间轴
显式完整字幕轨的替换边界

title.zh: AI短剧动作回放怎么拍：多角度，同一个结果
title.en: Replay an AI Drama Action from Multiple Angles

seo_title.zh: AI短剧动作回放怎么拍：多角度，同一个结果
seo_title.en: Replay an AI Drama Action from Multiple Angles

description.zh: 重大揭示可有意回放同一动作，但状态只改变一次。用原创揭布分镜说明主镜、回放标注、参考起止与接回后果，避免道具复位。
description.en: Replay a peak action deliberately without repeating its result. An original reveal plan covers the primary shot, shared states and the next shot.

answer.zh: 先完整设计一个关键动作，再把需要的角度写成明确回放，指向同一个主镜。每个回放从相同动作前状态到相同动作后状态，剧情结果只发生一次；最后接回已经完成的状态。回放是峰值的风格选择，不是每场的必做步骤。
answer.en: Design the primary action first, then label extra angles as replays of that shot. Every replay travels from the same before-state to the same after-state, while the story result happens once. Resume from the completed state. Replay is an optional peak treatment.

heading.zh: 只在有明确作用的峰值回放
heading.en: Choose a purposeful peak

body.zh:
short-drama-storyboard 的镜头方法允许在情绪爆发或重大揭示处有意重看同一动作。它同时要求注明这种处理，不能让普通接镜中的重复动作冒充风格。

原创场景：顾青当众揭开桌上一块布，让账箱露出来。回放可以强调揭示那一下，但箱子可见不等于箱内内容已经被核对，更不等于当场证明某人有罪。下一个镜头仍需承担新的证据或反应。

若只是想多看表情，直接在完成后的状态拍反应；若需要重看动作本身，才设计回放。不要因为一个角度不清楚就连续堆相同镜头。
body.en:
The shot-craft method allows intentional repetition at an emotional peak or major reveal. Declare it so accidental duplicate actions do not masquerade as style.

Original scene: Gu Qing lifts a cloth from a box on a table. Replay may stress that reveal, but a visible box does not establish its contents or anyone’s guilt. A later shot must supply evidence or reaction.

If the purpose is a reaction, film the completed state. Replay only when the action itself deserves another view. Repeated angles do not automatically clarify a poorly shown action.

heading.zh: 原创分镜：共同起点与共同终点
heading.en: Example: shared before and after

body.zh:
先锁两项事实：动作前，布盖住账箱，顾青右手握布角；动作后，账箱露出，布仍由右手拿着，箱子没有移动。以下只是纸面分镜，未生成视频。

| 镜头 | 职责 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| SHOT-04 | 主要落实揭布 | 从盖住到露出 |
| SHOT-05 | 另一角度重看同一揭布 | 仍从同一盖住状态到同一露出状态 |
| SHOT-06 | 观察者看向账箱 | 从已露出状态继续，不再揭一次 |

SHOT-05 的说明写“冲击重复：SHOT-04”，明确指向主镜。这是方法中的标注用语，文章主题仍是普通的动作回放。

回放之间不按连续时刻硬接：第二角度回到动作前，是已声明的回放。最后一个回放之后再恢复正常连续，不能把布重新盖回去而没有新动作。
body.en:
Lock the facts: before, cloth covers the box and Gu grips a corner with her right hand; after, the box is exposed and the cloth remains in that hand. The box does not move. This is an ungenerated shot plan.

| Shot | Job | State |
|---|---|---|
| SHOT-04 | Primary cloth lift | Covered to exposed |
| SHOT-05 | Replay from another angle | Same covered start to same exposed end |
| SHOT-06 | Observer looks at the box | Continue exposed; no second lift |

Mark SHOT-05 with the source method’s native note, “冲击重复：SHOT-04,” identifying the primary shot.

Replay cuts intentionally return to the before-state rather than representing successive moments. After the last replay, resume normal continuity. The cloth cannot cover the box again without a new action.

heading.zh: 参考图不能预先完成动作
heading.en: References must preserve the start

body.zh:
两个角度可以改变观察位置，但都必须保留动作前的对象位置、持物手和覆盖状态。若第二角度的首帧已经露出账箱，却又要求完整揭布，就会重新生成一块布或表演没有依据的动作。

提示中分清本角度起点、关键接触、终点，以及它回放哪个镜头。主镜和回放镜共享同一事件，不添加第二次揭示、第二只箱子或新的交接。

如果当前参考和模型无法清楚呈现揭布过程，可先修参考或调整拍法；不把生成失败强行解释成有意回放。角度变化也不能随意换服装、桌面物件或人物位置。
body.en:
Angles may change the view, but both preserve the object, holding hand and covered before-state. If the second angle already exposes the box, asking for another full lift invites a new cloth or an unsupported action.

Specify the angle’s start, contact and end, plus the shot it replays. Both shots share one event, without another reveal, box or handoff.

Repair the reference or staging if the lift is unclear. A failed generation does not become intentional replay by relabeling it. A new angle also cannot arbitrarily change clothing, table objects or positions.

heading.zh: 最后接回真正的新后果
heading.en: Resume with a new consequence

body.zh:
组接后检查：观众是否读懂在重看同一事件，动作前后事实是否一致，最后一镜是否从结果继续。下一步可以是人物核对箱上编号或承受者改变策略，不能旁白说“第二次揭开”来圆道具错误。

| 问题 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 第二角度从已完成状态再做动作 | 恢复共同起点，或改成完成后的细节镜 |
| 回放后布又盖回箱上 | 后续从动作后状态开始 |
| 每个回放都获得新的剧情结果 | 把同一事件结算一次，新动作另拍 |
| 每场都反复回放 | 只保留确实需要强调的峰值 |

这是待执行的镜头与剪辑检查。实际生成后还要看过程是否可读、回放节奏是否符合风格；标注存在不等于视频已经通过连续性审查。
body.en:
After assembly, check whether viewers read one replayed event, whether shared facts match and whether the next shot continues from the result. Follow with a new action such as comparing the box number or changing strategy. Narration cannot excuse a prop error as a “second reveal.”

| Problem | Repair |
|---|---|
| Another lift from an exposed start | Restore the before-state or use a detail shot |
| Cloth covers the box again | Continue from the after-state |
| Every replay creates a new result | Settle the event once; film new actions separately |
| Every scene repeats actions | Reserve repetition for a purposeful peak |

This is a review plan. Inspect generated motion and edited rhythm afterward. A replay label does not prove continuity has passed.

q.zh: 多角度回放一定要拍三遍吗？
q.en: Must an action have three replay angles?

a.zh: 不必。按风格和峰值需要取舍，也可以完全不回放。多看一遍要有强调作用，不能只是补镜头数量。
a.en: No. Use as much or as little as the style and peak require, including none. Another view needs a purpose beyond adding shots.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-storyboard 为这一个峰值动作设计可选多角度回放。先锁主镜、共同动作前后事实，再为回放标注冲击重复及主镜编号，最后从已完成状态接新后果。不要新增剧情结果或把生成错误当回放。
text.en: Use $short-drama-storyboard to plan optional replay angles for this peak. Lock the primary shot and shared before/after facts, mark replays with the primary ID, then continue from the completed state into a new consequence. Do not add results or relabel errors as replay.

label.zh: 主要动作、冲击重复与镜头职责
label.en: Primary actions, deliberate replay and shot jobs

title.zh: 小说人物第一次出场怎么写：特征、目标与选择
title.en: How to Introduce a Fiction Character Readers Remember

seo_title.zh: 小说人物第一次出场怎么写：特征、目标与选择
seo_title.en: How to Introduce a Fiction Character Readers Remember

description.zh: 人物登场不必先报设定表。用当前任务、少量可辨认特征和一次有意义的选择，附原创排练场景与出场卡。
description.en: Introduce a character through a task, a memorable detail and a choice. Includes an original rehearsal scene and a compact planning card.

answer.zh: 人物第一次出场先让读者认清“谁在做什么”，再用少量特征建立记忆，用面对眼前压力的选择显出性格。身份、经历和能力按当前需要进入，不必在第一段把设定表倒完；登场也不一定要大事件或惊艳所有人。
answer.en: First establish who is doing what, then use a few memorable details and a choice under immediate pressure. Bring in identity, history and ability as needed. An entrance need not recite a character sheet, stage a crisis or impress everyone.

heading.zh: 先给人物一个正在做的任务
heading.en: Give the character an immediate task

body.zh:
先定视角：谁第一次看见这个人，认识到什么程度？同事介绍能提供姓名和身份；陌生人只能看见行为，不能凭外貌知道履历或内心。

再选本场任务。领唱要带完一段排练，房客要搬进一个房间，店主在给第一位顾客找零钱。任务给特征一个出现位置：不是“他很细心”，而是他在时间有限时决定先处理哪个问题。

压力可以很小。保留一分钟给新人练习，也能显出优先顺序。若任务无需抉择，可以先给一个清楚动作，等真正有选择时再深化；不要为了立人设硬造冲突。
body.en:
Fix the viewpoint and degree of familiarity. An introduction can supply name and role; a stranger sees behavior, not a résumé or private thoughts.

Choose the immediate task: lead a rehearsal, move into a room or serve the first customer. It gives details a place to appear. Rather than “careful,” show what the person prioritizes with limited time.

Pressure can be small. Giving a newcomer one minute to practice can reveal priorities. If no choice is needed, establish a clear action and deepen character later instead of forcing conflict.

heading.zh: 出场卡：只填本场需要的内容
heading.en: A scene-specific entrance card

body.zh:
这是作者手写卡，不是 skill 固定交付格式。以新领唱夏禾进入社区乐队为例：

| 项目 | 本场填写 |
|---|---|
| 谁认识她 | 团长向鼓手介绍姓名与领唱身份 |
| 当前任务 | 在十分钟内排完副歌 |
| 记忆点 | 蓝布琴袋，不再同时堆身高、发色与履历 |
| 眼前压力 | 新鼓手说自己怕跟不上，整首重练会超时 |
| 选择与响应 | 夏禾只陪练入拍那一句；鼓手随后按标记进入 |
| 暂不交代 | 她怎样学琴、为什么换乐队 |

记忆点不必都是外貌，也可以是说话关注点或工具用法。初次出场少写几项，后续在需要时补，别把“有辨识度”变成反复念标签。
body.en:
This manual card is not a fixed skill output. For new lead singer Xia He joining a community band:

| Item | This scene |
|---|---|
| Known identity | Leader introduces her name and role |
| Task | Finish the chorus within ten minutes |
| Memory cue | Blue fabric guitar bag |
| Pressure | New drummer fears missing the entry; a full restart would overrun |
| Choice and reply | Practice only the entry phrase; drummer enters on the mark |
| Withheld history | Training and reason for changing bands |

A memory cue can be appearance, conversational focus or tool use. Introduce a few details, then develop them when needed rather than repeating labels.

heading.zh: 原创范例：新领唱进排练室
heading.en: Original example: a new singer joins rehearsal

body.zh:
鼓手周泽是本场视角人物。团长已经说明夏禾来担任领唱，墙上的排练表只剩十分钟。以下为原创文字。

**设定表式开场**：

> 夏禾二十六岁，性格温柔而果断，学琴多年，善于照顾新人，曾在别的乐队担任领唱。

**放进场景**：

> 团长介绍完，夏禾把蓝布琴袋放在周泽旁边。她翻到副歌，问他从哪一拍进。
>

> “标记这里。”周泽指了指谱，“我怕又跟不上。”
>

> 夏禾看了眼钟：“整首不重来。我们只过入拍那句，好吗？”
>

> 周泽点头。她唱了一遍，他在标记处敲下鼓槌。第二遍接进副歌时，她继续唱，没有再停。

读者见到身份、一个特征和一项取舍；新人有自己的顾虑与实际响应。她不是宣布“我善于照顾人”，也没有凭一句话让周泽掌握整首曲子。本场只兑现一次入拍。
body.en:
Drummer Zhou Ze is the viewpoint. The leader has introduced Xia as lead singer; ten minutes remain on the rehearsal schedule. This scene is original.

**Character-sheet version:**

> Xia was twenty-six, kind but decisive, an experienced musician who looked after newcomers.

**In the scene:**

> After the introduction, Xia put her blue guitar bag beside Zhou. She turned to the chorus and asked where he entered.
>

> “At this mark,” he said. “I’m afraid I’ll miss it again.”
>

> She glanced at the clock. “No full restart. Shall we try just that phrase?”
>

> He nodded. She sang it once; his stick landed on the mark. On the second pass she carried on into the chorus.

Readers get identity, one detail and a tradeoff. Zhou has a concern and an enacted response. Xia does not announce her kindness or make him master the entire song: this scene pays off one entry.

heading.zh: 多人登场时分批给名字与作用
heading.en: Stagger names and functions

body.zh:
同场有六个人，不等于第一段要给六份简历。先跟随正在影响眼前任务的人；其他人可按关系或动作暂称，等参与选择时再给姓名。具体人数按场景需要，不套“有台词者只能几个”的固定上限。

同名、同职业或同一阵营的角色，可以分别用不同任务建立注意点。若读者混淆，先查每人是否真的在做不同的事，再改称呼。指代问题另见[人名与代词](/oh-story/clear-character-names-and-pronouns)，配角的长期功能另见[配角设计](/oh-story/write-a-memorable-supporting-character)。
body.en:
Six people in a room do not require six biographies in the opening paragraph. Follow those affecting the immediate task; identify others by relationship or action until their participation needs a name. Use the scene’s needs rather than a fixed speaker limit.

Separate similar roles by their tasks. If readers confuse them, check their actions before changing names. Names and pronouns, and a supporting character’s long-term function, have separate guides.

heading.zh: 人物出场常见失败与修正
heading.en: Common entrance failures

body.zh:
| 失败 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 姓名与履历连续堆满 | 只留当前辨认和行动所需信息 |
| 所有人都夸新角色 | 让不同人按自己的任务响应 |
| 一个动作证明全部性格 | 先建立局部印象，后续再检验 |
| 陌生视角知道全部过去 | 改成已听介绍、直接观察或保留未知 |
| 为显厉害强造大危机 | 用本场本来存在的压力给一次选择 |

初次印象可以被后文修正。反差另见[人物反差](/oh-story/write-character-contrast)；登场本身不必立刻揭出全部秘密。
body.en:
| Failure | Fix |
|---|---|
| Name followed by a résumé | Keep identity and action needed now |
| Everyone praises the newcomer | Give observers their own concerns |
| One act proves the whole personality | Establish a local impression, test it later |
| A stranger knows private history | Use an introduction, observation or unknown |
| A forced crisis makes them impressive | Use pressure already in the scene |

Later scenes can revise first impressions. An entrance need not expose every secret.

q.zh: 人物第一次出场一定要写外貌吗？
q.en: Must a first appearance describe looks?

a.zh: 不一定。一个清楚的任务、称呼或有辨识度的选择也能建立记忆。外貌有用时先取少量可见特征，不用把完整设定表搬进正文。
a.en: No. A task, form of address or distinctive choice can establish memory. Use a few visible features when they help, without copying the full character sheet.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 为这个人物试写首次出场。先确认视角、当前任务、已知身份与场景结果，用少量特征和一次有意义的选择建立印象；不补陌生视角不知道的履历，不强造危机。说明哪些信息暂留后文。
text.en: Use $story-long-write for this first appearance. Confirm viewpoint, task, known identity and scene outcome. Use a few details and a meaningful choice without inventing private history or a crisis. Explain what stays for later.

label.zh: 出场记忆点与选择立人设
label.en: Memory cues and character through choice

title.zh: 小说人物外貌怎么写：少量特征，跟着视角进入
title.en: How to Describe Character Appearance in Fiction

seo_title.zh: 小说人物外貌怎么写：少量特征，跟着视角进入
seo_title.en: How to Describe Character Appearance in Fiction

description.zh: 人物外貌描写怎样避免眼睛、头发和身材清单？按视角与当下注意选择特征，附改衣师原创场景及删改对照。
description.en: Choose visible traits through viewpoint and attention rather than listing features. Includes an original scene and before-and-after descriptions.

answer.zh: 人物外貌先选当前视角会注意到的少量特征，让它们进入站位、任务或交流。设定卡可以写全，正文按需要分次给。外表能建立印象和记忆，却不能单凭穿着、伤痕或五官证明性格、贫富和过去。
answer.en: Choose the few visible traits this viewpoint would notice, and place them in action or interaction. A character sheet can be complete while prose reveals details gradually. Looks create impressions and memory; clothing, scars and features do not by themselves prove personality, wealth or history.

heading.zh: 从“谁在看”决定写什么
heading.en: Choose through the observer

body.zh:
先问看的人认识对方吗、此刻在等什么、距离是否足以看清。第一次见改衣师的顾客可能注意围裙和量尺；远处只见轮廓的人不能同时看清瞳色与细小疤痕。亲近的人可以注意今天的变化，不必重复读者已知的身高与发色。

Oh Story 的人物卡用外貌关键词帮助记忆；那是设计时的候选，不是每次出场照抄的正文。挑能建立本次印象的特征，其余留在设定或后续。
body.en:
Ask whether the observer knows the person, what they are waiting for and how much they can see. A customer meeting an alterations specialist may notice apron and tape measure; a distant silhouette cannot also disclose eye color and tiny scars. A familiar observer may notice today’s change rather than repeat established features.

Oh Story’s character card uses appearance keywords as memory aids. They are design candidates, not a passage to paste into every entrance.

heading.zh: 外貌记录：可见事实与主观印象分开
heading.en: Separate visible facts from impressions

body.zh:
| 项目 | 改衣店场景填写 |
|---|---|
| 视角与关系 | 许湄第一次见店员介绍的林柯 |
| 当前关注 | 裙摆太长，想赶上周末演出 |
| 可见特征 | 黑围裙边有白粉痕，眼镜架在头顶 |
| 怎么进入动作 | 林柯俯身看裙摆，才放下眼镜 |
| 不可直接推出 | 粉痕不证明家境，眼镜不证明严厉 |

这是手写取材表。一个特征有时只承担气氛或记忆，无需强加伏笔；关键是别把观察变成无依据的定性。
body.en:
| Item | Alterations scene |
|---|---|
| Viewpoint | Xu Mei first meets Lin Ke after an introduction |
| Concern | Hem too long for weekend performance |
| Visible traits | White marks on black apron; glasses on head |
| Action | Lin lowers glasses to inspect the hem |
| Not established | Marks do not prove poverty; glasses do not prove severity |

This is a manual selection sheet. A trait can serve atmosphere or memory without becoming a clue. Keep observation distinct from unsupported judgment.

heading.zh: 原创对照：把清单放回交流
heading.en: Original comparison: description inside interaction

body.zh:
许湄来改演出裙，店员已介绍林柯的名字和工作。下面两版取同一组可见特征。

**清单版**：

> 林柯头发短，戴细框眼镜，穿黑围裙，围裙边有白粉痕。她看起来精明能干。

**场景版**：

> 林柯把架在头顶的细框眼镜放下来，俯身看许湄的裙摆。黑围裙边的两道白粉痕随着她蹲下折了进去。
>

> “周末穿？”她问。
>

> 许湄点头。林柯拿起量尺：“先看看你打算配哪双鞋。”

外貌跟随动作出现，话题仍是当前任务。取掉“精明能干”，读者仍可形成自己的印象；这几句还没有证明修改已完成、周末一定能交衣。若后文需要发型，等它进入注意范围再补。
body.en:
Xu has come to alter a performance dress; a staff member has introduced Lin’s name and role. Both versions use the same visible features.

**List:**

> Lin had short hair, fine-framed glasses and a black apron with white marks. She looked capable.

**Scene:**

> Lin lowered the fine-framed glasses from her head and bent to inspect Xu’s hem. Two white marks at the edge of her black apron folded out of view as she crouched.
>

> “For the weekend?”
>

> Xu nodded. Lin picked up the tape. “Let’s see which shoes you’ll wear.”

Appearance enters through action; the conversation stays on the task. Readers can form an impression without “capable.” Neither passage proves a finished alteration or promised delivery. Add the haircut later if attention needs it.

heading.zh: 漂亮、特殊与重复出场怎么处理
heading.en: Beauty, distinctive traits and reappearances

body.zh:
可以直接写“漂亮”，尤其当叙述声音如此说话。需要具体画面时，再选观察者真正注意的一两项；不用把鼻梁、睫毛、嘴唇逐项赞美，也不靠“所有人都看呆”证明美。

重逢写新变化或新的注意：第一次见围裙上的粉痕，后来注意她为正式演出换了外套。别每次重复同一段外貌；稳定特征在有辨认需求时提醒即可。伤痕、衣着和身体差异不自动说明善恶或能力，过去若重要要另有建立。
body.en:
“Beautiful” can be a valid direct judgment in this narrative voice. Add one or two noticed features when a concrete image helps, rather than praising every facial part or making everyone stare.

At a reappearance, show change or changed attention: the observer who noticed an apron before may now notice formal clothing. Remind readers of stable traits when recognition needs them. Scars, clothing and bodily differences do not establish morality or ability; relevant history needs separate setup.

heading.zh: 外貌描写自查
heading.en: Appearance revision checks

body.zh:
| 问题 | 改法 |
|---|---|
| 像证件资料 | 把当前未被注意的字段移回设定 |
| 距离与细节不相容 | 只写此处可见程度 |
| 每次登场复制同一段 | 留辨认所需的一项，补实际变化 |
| 用五官给性格判词 | 区分视角偏见与故事事实 |
| 所有好看的人都一样 | 换观察重点与表达声音，不堆新形容词 |

若问题是整个第一次登场的信息过载，另看[人物登场](/oh-story/introduce-a-fiction-character)。
body.en:
| Problem | Revision |
|---|---|
| Reads like an ID form | Move unnoticed fields back to the sheet |
| Detail exceeds viewing distance | Keep what can be seen here |
| Same paragraph at every entrance | Keep a recognition cue and actual change |
| Features become a personality verdict | Separate viewpoint bias from fact |
| All attractive characters look alike | Change attention and voice, not adjective count |

For the whole first-appearance sequence, use the character-introduction guide.

q.zh: 外貌描写要写几个特征？
q.en: How many appearance traits should I describe?

a.zh: 没有统一数量。人物卡可以准备几个关键词，正文只取当前视角注意到、对这次印象有用的内容。远近、熟悉程度和文风比数量更重要。
a.en: There is no universal count. Prepare candidate keywords in the sheet, then use what this viewpoint notices and this impression needs. Distance, familiarity and voice matter more than quantity.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 改这段外貌描写。按已有视角、距离和当前任务选可见特征，保留人物事实，删重复清单与无依据的性格判断。不要改人物长相或用新经历解释原描写。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to revise this appearance passage. Select visible traits for the established viewpoint, distance and task. Preserve appearance facts; remove repeated lists and unsupported verdicts without inventing history.

label.en: Appearance memory cues in character cards

title.zh: 小说心理描写怎么写：把判断写进眼前选择
title.en: How to Write Interior Monologue That Changes a Choice

seo_title.zh: 小说心理描写怎么写：把判断写进眼前选择
seo_title.en: How to Write Interior Monologue That Changes a Choice

description.zh: 心理描写不只是情绪标签。把观察、猜测、记忆和决定分开，附临时取消约会的原创两版及知识边界检查。
description.en: Separate observations, guesses, memories and decisions in interior monologue. Includes an original cancellation scene and knowledge checks.

answer.zh: 心理描写要让读者跟随人物怎样理解眼前事情、比较选项并决定下一步。需要慢想时可以展开，需要快走时用半句判断或略过。人物的猜测可以错，但不能在限知视角里把他不知道的他人动机写成事实；已有行动也不必再由内心解释一遍。
answer.en: Interior monologue lets readers follow interpretation, alternatives and choice. Expand deliberation when needed; compress it to a phrase or omit it when action is clear. A character can guess wrongly, but limited viewpoint cannot turn unknown motives into facts or explain an already clear action again.

heading.zh: 心理描写和情绪描写各解决什么
heading.en: Thought and emotion have different jobs

body.zh:
“她失望”说明感受；“这是拒绝，还是临时有事？要不要问？”说明判断与选项。两者可以同段出现，不必每次都齐全。

先问此处需要让读者理解什么：误判的依据、犹豫的原因、记忆怎样改变当下，还是一项尚未说出口的决定？若读者已经从对白与行动看懂，就无需完整复述。感受怎样落地另见[情绪描写](/oh-story/emotion-on-the-page)，本页侧重思考过程。
body.en:
“She was disappointed” conveys feeling. “Was this a refusal or a change of plans? Should she ask?” conveys interpretation and options. Both can share a passage, but neither is mandatory.

What needs explanation here: the basis of a wrong guess, hesitation, memory affecting the present, or an unspoken decision? If dialogue and action make it clear, do not repeat it. This guide concerns thought; emotion has its own guide.

heading.zh: 心理段先分清四种信息
heading.en: Sort four kinds of information

body.zh:
朋友发来“今晚不来了”。以等候的沈意为视角，手写记录可以是：

| 类别 | 此处内容 |
|---|---|
| 已见事实 | 收到取消消息，没有说明原因 |
| 自己记得 | 上周朋友说临时加班；本周原因仍未知 |
| 主观猜测 | 是忙，还是不想见自己？ |
| 可选行动 | 追问、暂不问、说明自己的安排 |

“她又在躲我”可以是沈意的猜测，语境要让读者知道这不是全知宣布。不要临时补“她早已知道朋友在加班”来修知识越界；让消息、回忆或实际观察按正文顺序进入。
body.en:
A friend texts “I can’t come tonight.” For waiting Shen Yi, a manual note can separate:

| Kind | This passage |
|---|---|
| Observed | Cancellation received, no reason given |
| Remembered | Friend mentioned overtime last week; today unknown |
| Guessed | Busy, or avoiding me? |
| Available action | Ask, wait or state her own plans |

“She’s avoiding me again” can be a biased thought if context marks it as such. Do not repair overreach by inventing prior knowledge of today’s overtime. Let evidence enter in story order.

heading.zh: 原创对照：让念头通向一个行动
heading.en: Original comparison: thought leading to action

body.zh:
沈意在家准备了两人的晚饭。朋友只发来取消消息；上周加班的事曾在前文建立。

**解释过满**：

> 沈意很失望，觉得朋友不重视她。她想起上周朋友加班，但认定今天也是借口。她知道朋友不愿和她吃饭，于是决定不问了。

最后一个“知道”越过证据，前几句也替读者把感受说了数遍。

**保留判断过程**：

> 今晚也加班？上周她说是在办公室加班，可这回只有“不来了”。沈意看着已经摆好的第二只碗，想把“你到底什么意思”发过去，又改成：“我先吃了。你有空时再说。”
>

> 对方回：“临时加班，对不起，位置不用给我留。”沈意把第二只碗收回橱柜。

她从有限信息作猜测，选择没有逼对方立刻解释的回复。后面的消息带来对方说出的理由；这段仍未证明全部隐情，却足以支持收起碗。本例不是“正确沟通”的万能示范，重点是念头怎样接到本人的选择。
body.en:
Shen has prepared dinner for two. The cancellation gives no reason; last week’s overtime is established earlier.

**Overexplained:**

> Shen was disappointed and felt unimportant. She remembered last week’s overtime but decided today was another excuse. She knew her friend did not want dinner with her and chose not to ask.

“Knew” exceeds the evidence; the opening also explains the feeling repeatedly.

**Follow the judgment:**

> Overtime again? Last week she had said she was working late at the office. This time there was only “I can’t come.” Shen looked at the second bowl, started to type “What do you mean?” and changed it to “I’ll eat now. Tell me when you have time.”
>

> “Last-minute overtime, sorry. Don’t keep a place for me,” came the reply. Shen put the second bowl away.

She guesses from limited evidence and chooses a reply. The later text supplies a stated reason, not proof of every hidden fact, but supports putting away the bowl. This is a thought-to-choice example, not a universal communication prescription.

heading.zh: 内心独白写多长，怎样融入文风
heading.en: Length and narrative voice

body.zh:
追逐或即时决断可以只留影响下一步的判断；复杂取舍、推理或强内省文风，可以给完整思考链。长度看这段是否新增条件、比较或转向，不看固定行数。

念头可以用第一人称原话、贴近人物的第三人称，或叙述者转述。先选本书既有表达，不临时混用字体、引号和人称让读者失去说话者。Oh Story 的深度限知半句念头是默认写法之一，本书明确需要长独白时按文风调整；事实与透露范围仍保留。
body.en:
A chase or instant decision may need only the thought changing the next move. A complex dilemma, inference or introspective voice can sustain a full chain. Judge new conditions, comparisons and turns rather than a fixed line count.

Use direct first-person thought, close third person or narrative summary according to the book. Avoid unexplained shifts in typography and person. Oh Story’s brief close-viewpoint thought is one default; an established long-monologue voice can override it while retaining facts and reveal boundaries.

heading.zh: 心理描写冗长或越界怎么改
heading.en: Repair repetition and overreach

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 思考反复得出同一结论 | 留一个最有分量的判断，接下一步 |
| 无依据读出别人真实动机 | 标为猜测，或补已有可用证据 |
| 每个动作后都解释为何 | 只保留会改变理解的原因 |
| 推理像作者讲解题目 | 保留人物的有限信息、偏好与盲点 |
| 怕直写而全改成身体反应 | 需要判断就写判断，不换成无效微动作 |

改前后核对：同一组事实是否仍成立，人物为什么选这一步是否更清楚。不要为了省字把关键推理台阶删掉。
body.en:
| Problem | Revision |
|---|---|
| Thought repeats one conclusion | Keep the strongest judgment and next move |
| Reads another person’s motive without evidence | Mark a guess or use established evidence |
| Every act gets an explanation | Keep reasons changing understanding |
| Reasoning sounds like an answer key | Retain limited knowledge, preferences and blind spots |
| Direct thought replaced with bodily gestures | Write the needed judgment, not empty motion |

Compare the facts and reasons before and after. Brevity should not remove necessary inference steps.

q.zh: 心理描写一定要变成动作吗？
q.en: Must every thought become an action?

a.zh: 不用。判断、记忆或犹豫本身可以承担理解和情绪作用。只是当一段反复解释相同感受、又不增加认知时，需要删重；如果它决定行动，应把连接写清。
a.en: No. Judgment, memory and hesitation can serve understanding or feeling. Remove repeated explanations that add nothing; show the connection when thought determines action.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 审读这段心理描写。分别标事实、记忆、猜测与选择；保留必要推理和本书内省文风，删重复解释。不能把别人的未知动机写成主角已知，也不新增经历来弥补越界。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review this interior passage. Separate fact, memory, guess and choice. Preserve necessary inference and voice; remove repetition without turning unknown motives into knowledge or inventing experiences.

label.zh: 深度限知与念头融入动作
label.en: Close viewpoint and thought within action

label.zh: 画面、思想与叙述的分工

title.zh: 小说感官描写怎么写：让人物的注意带着细节走
title.en: Sensory Details in Fiction: Attention Before Quantity

seo_title.zh: 小说感官描写怎么写：让人物的注意带着细节走
seo_title.en: Sensory Details in Fiction: Attention Before Quantity

description.zh: 感官描写不必把五感写满。按人物任务、可感知条件和段落作用选细节，附后台候场的原创改写与取舍表。
description.en: Choose sensory detail through task, perceptual access and purpose. An original backstage revision shows when to use one sense or omit decoration.

answer.zh: 感官描写先问人物正在注意什么、这个细节让读者感到或理解什么，再选择声音、触感、气味、味道与视觉。可以只用一种感官，也可以织进连续行动；不为“五感齐全”添加本场无用的信息，更不能把闻到、听到的线索直接写成已证实的原因。
answer.en: Ask what the character attends to and what the detail contributes to understanding or experience. Choose sound, touch, smell, taste or sight as needed. One sense can be enough. Do not fill a five-sense quota or treat a sensory clue as a confirmed cause.

heading.zh: 感官选择先看任务与可感知条件
heading.en: Choose by task and perceptual access

body.zh:
紧张的候场者可能听台词，饥饿的人更注意食物，熟悉的房间也可能因气味改变而被重新看见。这是人物的注意，不是作者给每段配一组感官。

先定位置、距离、遮挡与已有经验。隔帘能听见声音，不一定能看见动作；熟悉的声线可产生猜测，身份仍需其他依据。感官也可只承担气氛与记忆，不必每一处都触发大转折。

环境如何参与任务另见[环境描写](/oh-story/environment-description)；本页聚焦选哪一种感知、怎样放进文字。
body.en:
A waiting performer may attend to a line; a hungry person to food; a familiar room may feel altered by its smell. This is character attention, not a sensory set assigned to each paragraph.

Fix position, distance, barriers and experience. Hearing through a curtain does not reveal the action beyond it. A familiar voice can prompt a guess, with identity requiring other support. Detail may serve atmosphere or memory without triggering a major turn.

Environment interacting with a task has a separate guide; this page concerns selection and placement of perception.

heading.zh: 取舍表：一处细节承担什么
heading.en: A sensory selection sheet

body.zh:
原创场景：简声在小剧场候场，已经排练过，指定台词才是她的入场信号。

| 候选 | 本场作用 | 取舍 |
|---|---|---|
| 帘外灯光明灭 | 她看不清舞台，不能用灯判定入场 | 简写遮挡 |
| 舞台上指定台词 | 她确认轮到自己 | 详写听清的那句 |
| 衣摆潮冷 | 雨后候场的身体体验 | 点到即可 |
| 远处甜香 | 与此处注意和气氛无关 | 省略 |

同一种声音也能有多个作用，但不要用五种方式重复“她很紧张”。要增细节时先看缺的是判断台阶还是气氛，而非感官种类。
body.en:
Original scene: Jian Sheng waits backstage after rehearsal. A specified spoken line is her entrance cue.

| Candidate | Role | Choice |
|---|---|---|
| Changing light beyond curtain | Cannot show the stage clearly | Brief barrier detail |
| Rehearsed line on stage | Confirms her entrance | Make it audible |
| Cold, damp hem | Rainy waiting experience | Brief texture |
| Distant sweetness | Adds nothing here | Omit |

One sound can serve several purposes. Do not repeat “nervous” through five senses. Diagnose missing inference or atmosphere before adding detail.

heading.zh: 原创对照：不用凑满五种感觉
heading.en: Original comparison: no five-sense quota

body.zh:
**堆叠版**：

> 灯很亮，空气有木头的气味，裙摆很冷，远处有人咳嗽，嘴里像有苦味。简声非常紧张。

**选择后的版本**：

> 潮冷的裙摆贴着简声的小腿。她隔着帘缝看见一道光移过去，仍没动；排练时说好，要等那句台词。
>

> “你终于来了。”声音从台上传来。
>

> 简声掀开帘子，走进亮处。

这里触感留下候场体验，声音完成入场判断；光只说明她能看到的范围。没有补香味和味道，也没说闻到木头便知道台上发生什么。台词与入场约定提前建立，行动没有靠一声不明响动跳到正确结论。
body.en:
**Stacked:**

> The lights were bright. Wood scented the air. Her hem was cold. Someone coughed; her mouth tasted bitter. Jian was very nervous.

**Selected:**

> The cold, damp hem touched Jian’s calf. A strip of light moved beyond the curtain gap. She stayed where she was; rehearsal had fixed the spoken cue.
>

> “At last, you’re here,” came the voice from the stage.
>

> She lifted the curtain and stepped into the light.

Touch carries the waiting experience; sound supports the entrance decision. Light establishes what she can see. Smell and taste add nothing. The cue was established before the action rather than inferred from an unexplained noise.

heading.zh: 让名词和动词承担感觉
heading.en: Use precise nouns and verbs

body.zh:
“很响”“很香”“很冷”可以直接用；需要更清楚的画面时，再写声音来自哪里、触感落在哪里、它怎样与正在做的事相遇。不是越复杂越好，人物此刻也不一定有条件分辨味道的层次。

推断与感知分开：闻到焦味是观察，判断哪件东西烧了还需看见或查问；看见潮湿不证明谁刚来过。涉及专业判断时，不让人物凭一种感官突然获得未建立的技能。
body.en:
“Loud,” “sweet” and “cold” can be enough. When precision helps, name the source, contact point or relation to the ongoing action. Complexity is not a goal; the character may lack time or experience to distinguish layers.

Separate perception from inference. A burning smell is observed; what burned needs sight or inquiry. Dampness does not prove who visited. A sense should not grant an unestablished professional skill.

heading.zh: 感官描写常见修订
heading.en: Common sensory revisions

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修改 |
|---|---|
| 每段固定写五感 | 留本场注意到且有作用的几处 |
| 声音、气味都重复同一情绪 | 留最有分量的一处 |
| 感觉只在动作后补标签 | 放入观察、判断或体验发生的位置 |
| 一闻一听就知道完整真相 | 加验证，或保留为猜测 |
| 为精简把气氛也删净 | 保留确实影响阅读体验的细节 |

朗读改后段落，看感觉是否与行动连在一起。不要把“发生、感知、反应”拆成三段，把同一瞬间写三遍。
body.en:
| Problem | Revision |
|---|---|
| Five senses in every paragraph | Keep relevant attention and purpose |
| Several senses repeat one emotion | Keep the strongest detail |
| Detail labels an action afterward | Place it where perception occurs |
| One smell proves the whole truth | Verify or retain a guess |
| Compression removes all atmosphere | Keep detail affecting the reading experience |

Read aloud for continuity. Event, perception and response need not become three paragraphs repeating one instant.

q.zh: 感官描写至少要写几种感觉？
q.en: How many senses must a passage use?

a.zh: 没有最低数量。按当前人物的注意、场景条件与段落作用选择。一种声音足以完成入场判断；需要气氛或身体体验时再补有效细节。
a.en: There is no minimum. Choose by attention, access and purpose. One sound can support an entrance decision; add useful atmosphere or texture when needed.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 修改这段感官描写，先确认视角、位置、任务与已有经验，选真正影响理解或体验的细节，保持事实和行动顺序。不按五感凑数，不把线索改成确定结论，不堆同一瞬间的反应。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to revise sensory detail. Confirm viewpoint, position, task and experience. Keep details affecting understanding or experience while preserving facts and order. Do not fill a sensory quota, turn clues into certainty or stack reactions.

label.zh: 按需感知、连续场景与疏密
label.en: Relevant perception, scene continuity and density

label.zh: 五感、动态描写与文风默认值
label.en: Senses, dynamic description and style defaults

title.zh: 小说句子长短怎么安排：连贯推进，关键处停顿
title.en: Sentence Length in Fiction: Flow, Pauses and Emphasis

seo_title.zh: 小说句子长短怎么安排：连贯推进，关键处停顿
seo_title.en: Sentence Length in Fiction: Flow, Pauses and Emphasis

description.zh: 长短句怎样影响小说读感？先保住动作与因果，再按强调和停顿调整。附断弦场景的同事实三版与朗读检查。
description.en: Vary sentence length for continuity, emphasis and pause while preserving facts. Compare three original versions of a string breaking on stage.

answer.zh: 长短句先服从这段正在交付的信息和情绪：连贯动作可以在句内接起来，新事实或关键选择可以单独停顿。长句不一定慢，短句不一定紧张；不用每句交替长短，也不靠删掉主语、因果和中间动作制造速度。
answer.en: Let length serve information and feeling. Connect continuing actions within a sentence; pause on a new fact or important choice. Long need not mean slow, short need not mean tense. Avoid mechanical alternation or speed created by deleting subjects, causes and steps.

heading.zh: 先分句子的任务，不先数长度
heading.en: Identify sentence jobs before counting

body.zh:
一句在讲同一动作过程时，用合适连接说明先后、因果或转向；信息过载或注意对象改变时，分句能帮助读者跟上。关键一句需要被注意时，可以给它独立位置，不必扩大成最长一段。

Oh Story 的正文方法强调句子连续和疏密起伏；具体长短、标点与停顿按本书文风调整。中文连接词和英文从句结构不同，不把一种语言的字符阈值直接套给另一种。
body.en:
Connect a continuing action with the right sequence, cause or turn. Split when information overload or changed attention makes following difficult. Give a crucial fact its own position rather than the longest paragraph.

Oh Story emphasizes continuity and varied density. Length, punctuation and pause follow the book’s voice. Chinese connectors and English clauses differ; a character-count threshold does not transfer directly.

heading.zh: 同一事实，比较三种读感
heading.en: Compare three rhythms with the same facts

body.zh:
原创事实：青禾在演出中断了一根琴弦；她停拨，看向鼓手；鼓手仍按原拍敲鼓边；她接着唱完副歌，台下鼓掌。比较节奏时不额外发明事故、救场者或新结果。

**句句同重**：

> 琴弦断了。青禾停拨。她看向鼓手。鼓手敲鼓边。原来的拍子还在。青禾继续唱。她唱完副歌。台下响起掌声。

**信息挤在一口气里**：

> 琴弦断了，青禾停拨并看向鼓手，鼓手继续按原来的拍子敲鼓边，所以她接着唱完副歌，而台下响起掌声。

**按变化分轻重**：

> 琴弦断了。
>

> 青禾停拨，看向鼓手；鼓边仍按原拍响着。她顺着那拍子接着唱，直到副歌结束，台下响起掌声。

第三版把断弦停出来，后续动作仍连贯。它没有比前两版多一个转折，优势来自注意分配。若文风需要一口气的慌乱，第二版可继续调整后采用，不能只按长度判错。
body.en:
Original facts: Qing He breaks a guitar string during a performance, stops picking and looks to the drummer. The drummer maintains the beat on the rim. She finishes the chorus; the audience applauds. No new accident, helper or result is added.

**Equal weight:**

> The string snapped. Qing stopped picking. She looked at the drummer. He tapped the rim. The beat continued. She sang on. She finished the chorus. The audience applauded.

**One breath:**

> The string snapped and Qing stopped picking and looked at the drummer, who kept the beat on the rim, so she sang through the end of the chorus and then the audience applauded.

**Weighted by change:**

> The string snapped.
>

> Qing stopped picking and looked at the drummer; the rim still carried the beat. She followed it through the end of the chorus, and applause rose from the audience.

The third isolates the break and connects the response. It adds no plot turn: attention changes. An intentionally breathless voice may adapt the second version; length alone does not make it wrong.

heading.zh: 句长修订表：事实先锁定
heading.en: A revision sheet with facts fixed

body.zh:
| 位置 | 本段任务 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 断弦 | 新变化，需要被注意 | 单独停一拍 |
| 停拨、看鼓手 | 同一反应过程 | 连在一句，主语明确 |
| 鼓边原拍 | 新依据支持下一步 | 与她的注意连接 |
| 唱完、掌声 | 当前结果与外部回应 | 收束，不再解释“她成功了” |

这是朗读与修订用简表，不是每段都要四句。若长句有几个不相关的信息，先删重复或移动背景，再拆；不要仅按字数切断完整推理。
body.en:
| Place | Job | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Broken string | New fact | Isolate a beat |
| Stop and look | Continuing response | Connect with clear subject |
| Continuing rhythm | Basis for next move | Link to attention |
| Chorus and applause | Result and reply | Close without another success summary |

This manual sheet does not require four sentences in every passage. Remove repetition or move background before splitting unrelated information. Do not cut a complete inference merely at a word count.

heading.zh: 朗读检查哪里卡、哪里该停
heading.en: Read aloud for strain and emphasis

body.zh:
读时问：主语有没有丢，前后动作怎样相接，哪里是转向，哪一句才最值得停？喘不过来可能是修饰和并列项过多；读得一顿一顿可能是同一动作链被拆散。

可以先标原有连接，再改变句号位置。每次调整后核对事实：唱完副歌之后才有掌声，不能为了顺口把回应提前到过程里。如果问题是分段，见[小说分段](/oh-story/write-a-fiction-paragraph)；如果已经被删成碎句，见[过度去 AI 味修复](/oh-story/over-edited-prose)。
body.en:
Check subjects, links, turns and the fact worth pausing on. Strain may come from too many modifiers or list items; choppiness may come from a single action chain split apart.

Mark existing connections before moving full stops, then check facts. Applause follows the completed chorus; smoothing prose must not move it into the performance. Paragraph structure and repairing overedited fragments have separate guides.

heading.zh: 长短句常见误用
heading.en: Common misuses

body.zh:
| 误用 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 每句长度都差不多 | 按信息变化调轻重 |
| 强制一长一短交替 | 回到实际动作和停顿 |
| 长句像动作逗号清单 | 用真实先后、因果与转向连接 |
| 为快删掉指代和原因 | 补必要连接，不补无用动作 |
| 所有短句都单独成段 | 只在需要强调时留独立位置 |

有意的重复节奏可以保留，例如仪式、喜剧或强烈情绪。检查它是否产生预期效果，而不是用统一句长标准压平全书。
body.en:
| Misuse | Revision |
|---|---|
| Every sentence has equal weight | Follow changes in information |
| Forced long-short alternation | Follow real action and pause |
| Long sentence is an action list | Connect actual sequence, cause and turn |
| Speed removes pronouns or reasons | Restore needed links, not extra gestures |
| Every short sentence gets a paragraph | Reserve isolation for useful emphasis |

Deliberate recurring rhythm can serve ritual, comedy or intense feeling. Judge its effect rather than flattening it with one standard.

q.zh: 短句是不是更有紧张感？
q.en: Do short sentences automatically create tension?

a.zh: 不一定。短句能强调新事实，也可能把连续过程打碎。紧张感还来自目标、阻力、未决问题与人物选择；句长只是注意和停顿的工具。
a.en: No. Short sentences can emphasize a new fact or fragment a continuing process. Tension also needs goals, resistance, uncertainty and choice; length controls attention and pause.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 只调整这段的句长和连接。先列不可改变的动作顺序与结果，再标强调、转向和连贯推进处。保留本书文风、主语与因果，不为配长短句新增反应或改写剧情。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to adjust sentence length and links only. Fix action order and results first, then mark emphasis, turns and continuity. Preserve voice, subjects and causality without new reactions or plot changes.

label.zh: 文笔中的精准、节奏与画面
label.en: Precision, rhythm and image in prose

title.zh: AI写小说资料乱编怎么办：查原始来源，分清范围
title.en: AI Fiction Research: Verify Sources and Scope

seo_title.zh: AI写小说资料乱编怎么办：查原始来源，分清范围
seo_title.en: AI Fiction Research: Verify Sources and Scope

description.zh: AI生成的年代、场所规则和职业细节不能直接当事实。用日期、原始来源、分歧与待核实项整理，附官方公告核查例。
description.en: Check dates, original sources and claim scope before using AI research. Includes a real official-notice check and a reusable research note.

answer.zh: 先把 AI 给出的段落拆成可核查的事实问题，确认故事发生的时间、地点和人物身份，再读原始来源，而不只看搜索摘要。区分已支持、存在分歧与尚未找到依据的部分；研究材料提供事实与限制，人物怎样选择仍由故事决定。
answer.en: Split AI-generated research into checkable questions with story date, place and role. Read original sources rather than only search snippets. Separate supported, disputed and unsupported claims. Research supplies facts and limits; the story still decides character choices.

heading.zh: 先问一个能核查的问题
heading.en: Ask a checkable question first

body.zh:
“这个职业怎样写真实”太宽，改成“故事日期内，哪种身份能做这项操作”“这处真实场所当时从哪个入口向公众开放”。人、时间和适用范围写全，能避免把今天的规则套到过去、把访客规定套给工作人员。

把真实事实与虚构设定分开。魔法凭证可以由作者设定；真实机构的公开规则需要来源。故事采用改编时明确它是本作设定，不把艺术处理列成查证结果。外部事实核查与书内连续性不同，后者见[前后矛盾检查](/oh-story/ai-fiction-consistency-check)。
body.en:
“Make this profession realistic” is broad. Ask what a specified role could do on the story date, or which entrance a real venue then opened to the public. Date, actor and scope prevent applying present rules to the past or visitor rules to employees.

Separate real facts from fictional premises. Authors can invent a magic pass; a real institution’s public rule needs a source. Mark adaptation as this story’s premise, not a researched finding. External research differs from internal continuity.

heading.zh: 读原文，检查独立性与适用关系
heading.en: Read originals and check independence

body.zh:
1. **先找原始发布者**：机构公告、原始文献、实物资料或明确的专业记录，按问题选择。
2. **打开全文**：看发布日期、正文条件和更新，不把摘要的一句话当完整规则。
3. **查其他来源**：按来源实际出处判断独立性。多家转载同一公告，不能算几份独立证明。
4. **处理差异**：先分时间、地区、对象、常规与例外，再判断是否真的矛盾。
5. **留缺口**：没查到的写“待核实”，不要让 AI 编一个出处填空。

Oh Story 的资料研究方法要求完整调研交叉独立来源、记录分歧和置信度。单一原始公告可以说明“机构发布了什么”，但不能因此宣称已经完成多源调查，或推断公告外的事实。
body.en:
1. Find the original issuer: an institutional notice, original document, object record or professional account suited to the question.
2. Read the full page, including date, conditions and updates; a snippet is not the rule.
3. Seek other sources and trace independence. Several copies of one notice remain one origin.
4. Resolve differences in date, region, actor and exception before calling them contradictions.
5. Leave gaps unresolved rather than inventing a citation.

Oh Story’s research method requires independent cross-checks, disagreements and confidence reporting for a full investigation. One original notice can establish what an institution announced; it does not complete a multi-source investigation or prove facts outside the notice.

heading.zh: 实查示例：日期改变了常规判断
heading.en: Verified example: date changes the default

body.zh:
假设小说中的游客打算在 2026 年 7 月 27 日参观故宫。AI 只凭“周一闭馆”的印象，就把剧情写成他到门口一定被拒。

本页于 2026 年 9 月 30 日读取[故宫博物院当日专项公告](https://www.dpm.org.cn/announce_detail/379398.html)：院方宣布那个周一免费开放，但仍需实名预约。这里支持的是公告内容，不能把“免费”写成“无需预约”，也不能证明角色本人已预约或工作人员后台通行权。

| 记录 | 本例内容 |
|---|---|
| 具体问题 | 当日是否有周一开放例外 |
| 原始依据 | 院方 2026 年 7 月 23 日专项公告 |
| 可支持 | 公告规定当日免费开放且须预约 |
| 未支持 | 角色已获预约、所有区域可进入、后台权限 |
| 独立性 | 一份原始公告，未称完成多源调查 |

作者据此可以修改“仅因周一被拦”的依据，并在故事内建立角色的预约状态。尚未核实的其他权限另查；不为保住旧剧情随意补一张万能工作证。这个例子只核查一项公开声明，不冒充整个故事的已完成调研报告。
body.en:
Suppose a fictional visitor plans to enter Beijing’s Palace Museum on 27 July 2026. An AI draft assumes Monday closure means certain refusal.

On 30 September 2026, this page checked the [museum’s date-specific announcement](https://www.dpm.org.cn/announce_detail/379398.html). It announced free opening on that Monday, with a real-name reservation still required. Free did not mean unreserved, and the notice did not establish the character’s booking or staff-only access.

| Record | This check |
|---|---|
| Question | Was there a Monday exception that date? |
| Original | Museum notice dated 23 July 2026 |
| Supported | Announced free opening with reservation |
| Not supported | Personal booking, every area, backstage rights |
| Independence | One original notice, not a full cross-check |

Revise refusal based solely on Monday and establish the booking in the fiction. Research other access separately, without inventing an all-purpose staff pass to save the old plot. This is one public-statement check, not a completed investigation of the whole story.

heading.zh: 资料卡怎样转交给写作
heading.en: Hand research to the writer

body.zh:
> **问题与范围**：故事时间、地点、身份、要写的动作。
>

> **支持事实**：一句结论，附对应原始页面与位置。
>

> **条件与例外**：适用于谁，何时有效，哪里不覆盖。
>

> **分歧与缺口**：不同说法分别有何依据，下一步查什么。
>

> **创作选择**：作者准备使用哪项，哪些仍是本作虚构。

研究者不要把“查不到”润成确定知识；写作者不要把来源里的一条条件扩成万能规则。资料影响已写剧情时，先列受影响的具体段落，再选择保留事实、改场景或明确虚构改编。
body.en:
Record the question and story scope; supported claims with original page locations; conditions and exceptions; disagreements and next checks; and which facts or fictional adaptations the author chooses.

Do not turn “not found” into certainty or one condition into a universal rule. If research affects existing prose, identify the specific passages before choosing to retain the fact, revise the scene or establish a fictional adaptation.

heading.zh: 资料幻觉常见问题
heading.en: Common research hallucinations

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 链接标题像真，页面不存在 | 打开原页，缺来源就撤下结论 |
| 只读搜索摘要 | 回到全文与适用条件 |
| 多家转载被当独立查证 | 追溯共同原始出处 |
| 今日规则套到历史日期 | 查当时版本与专项公告 |
| 公开参观信息证明后台权限 | 按身份重新提问，保留未知 |
| 专业细节被一句口述定论 | 分清经验描述与明确制度依据 |

工具暂时无法查到资料，就保留查询和缺口；不要让“先写完”变成编造研究结果。
body.en:
| Problem | Revision |
|---|---|
| Plausible title, missing page | Open the original; withdraw unsupported claims |
| Search snippet only | Read full conditions |
| Reprints treated as independent | Trace the shared origin |
| Today’s rule applied to another date | Check the relevant version and notice |
| Visitor rule proves staff access | Reask for the actor and preserve unknowns |
| One account settles professional detail | Distinguish experience from institutional evidence |

When tools cannot retrieve material, retain questions and gaps instead of fabricating a result to finish the draft.

q.zh: 两个网站说的一样，算查证完成吗？
q.en: Do two agreeing websites finish verification?

a.zh: 先看它们是否独立、是否适用同一时间与对象，是否真正支持要写的动作。转载数量不能替代原始依据；不在来源范围内的权限或结果仍待核实。
a.en: Check independence, matching time and actor, and whether they support the planned action. Reprint counts do not replace original evidence; permissions or outcomes outside scope remain unknown.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 讨论这场景的资料需求，不写正文。列故事日期、地点、人物身份和可核查问题；研究时读原始页面、交叉独立来源、列分歧与缺口。找不到依据不补造，最后分清研究事实与本作设定。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to discuss research needs without drafting prose. List date, place, role and checkable questions. Read originals, cross-check independent sources and report disagreements and gaps. Separate researched facts from fictional premises without invented evidence.

label.zh: 研究场景、独立来源、事实与创作边界
label.en: Research scope, independent sources and facts versus creation

title.zh: AI连续写多章怎么安排：分批目标与写后核对
title.en: How to Draft Several Novel Chapters with AI

seo_title.zh: AI连续写多章怎么安排：分批目标与写后核对
seo_title.en: How to Draft Several Novel Chapters with AI

description.zh: AI批量续写不是一次生成越多越好。用有限章节范围、阶段目标、透露边界和每章变化衔接，附三章计划与批末检查。
description.en: Plan bounded chapter batches with a shared goal, reveal limits and per-chapter changes. Includes a three-chapter example and a batch-end review.

answer.zh: 先限定本批章节和一个阶段推进目标，分清每章要兑现什么、哪些事实此时不能透露，再按故事顺序逐章写。上一章的实际结果决定下一章进入状态；写完核对这几章的累积进展、旧承诺和知情边界，不能只按总字数判断批量续写成功。
answer.en: Bound the chapter range and shared progress goal. Give each chapter a payoff and reveal limits, then draft in story order. Actual results set the next chapter’s entry state. Review accumulated progress, old promises and knowledge boundaries rather than judging a batch by word count alone.

heading.zh: 批量续写前先具备什么
heading.en: Prerequisites for a chapter batch

body.zh:
已经有正文、当前人物状态和可执行细纲，才适合续写多章。只有一个点子先做大纲；已有散稿但没有结构和追踪，先[导入已有书稿](/oh-story/import-and-continue)，不要把聊天记忆当完整前史。

先核对从哪章开始。若第七章计划已成正文，就不要又生成第二份第七章。细纲只给“主角找到真相”而没有行动与因果时，先补足，不用连续生成来掩盖缺口。

本页讲一个批次怎样接稳，人物和伏笔长期维护见[长篇连续性](/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)。
body.en:
Several chapters suit a project with existing prose, current character state and executable outlines. Plan an idea first; import a loose manuscript before treating chat memory as history.

Check the first unwritten chapter. Do not generate another Chapter Seven if it already exists. An outline saying only “finds the truth” needs action and causality before a batch can consume it.

This page concerns one batch; long-term character and clue maintenance has a separate guide.

heading.zh: 本批任务卡：阶段与单章分开
heading.en: Separate batch goal from chapter jobs

body.zh:
原创故事中，林岑负责一场社区露天电影。第六章已拿到场地同意；本批目标是落实可行放映安排，不能提前写“大家已看完电影”。

| 章 | 本章任务与结果 | 后续承接 |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | 核对设备与时间，发现借来的幕布太宽 | 现有场地不能直接用原方案 |
| 8 | 比较缩幕与换场，借出方同意换较窄幕布并实际交接 | 获得可用物件，仍需试映 |
| 9 | 现场试映，接收人确认画面与开场时间 | 本轮方案可用；正式观众场仍在后面 |

这是手写计划，不是 skill 原生细纲格式。每章仍需要场景、选择、反制与篇幅安排；三行不能替代可执行细纲。后续秘密若尚未解锁，写进“本批不得透露”，不为提速先揭底。
body.en:
In this original story, Lin Cen organizes an outdoor community film. Chapter Six established venue consent. This batch must make the screening arrangement workable, not claim the audience has already watched it.

| Chapter | Job and result | Carryover |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | Check equipment and time; borrowed screen too wide | Current plan does not fit |
| 8 | Compare resizing and moving; lender agrees and hands over narrower screen | Object available; trial still needed |
| 9 | Trial at venue; responsible host confirms picture and start time | Plan works; public event remains later |

This manual plan is not the native chapter-outline format. Each row needs scenes, choices, resistance and space; it does not replace executable outlines. Mark unreleased secrets explicitly rather than spoiling them for speed.

heading.zh: 逐章接结果，不并排编出几条前史
heading.en: Carry actual results forward in order

body.zh:
写第八章前，按第七章正文实际结果更新：知道幕布尺寸不合，不等于已经换到新的。第八章若只得到口头许可而未交接，第九章不能直接写新幕布已挂好，除非补出交接或把它留作新的阻碍。

在固定版本的 Oh Story 工作流里，章节按序写并在每章后提交状态；其单轮上限是三章，这是该工具流程，不是所有作者的日更标准。长请求分到后续批次，不靠一次开更多窗口生成互相矛盾的结果。作者自己写时也可以借这个原则：先确认上一章发生了什么，再接下一章。

文中选择了哪一个场地、谁拿着设备、哪些人知道变化，只记会影响后续的实际事实。不要把未接受的方案写成已完成状态。
body.en:
Before Chapter Eight, carry the actual Chapter Seven result: knowing the screen does not fit is not having a replacement. If Eight gains only verbal consent without handover, Nine cannot begin with the new screen installed unless that step is supplied or remains an obstacle.

The pinned Oh Story workflow drafts sequentially and commits state after each chapter, with a three-chapter per-turn ceiling. That is a tool workflow, not every writer’s daily quota. Split longer requests into later batches rather than generating conflicting results in parallel. Manual writers can borrow the principle of checking what actually happened before continuing.

Record relevant selected venue, held equipment and known changes. Unaccepted plans are not completed state.

heading.zh: 批末检查累积结果与下一步
heading.en: Review accumulated results at batch end

body.zh:
本轮三章连起来，林岑是不是从“有场地”走到“有经过试映的安排”？每章是否消费了上一章结果，而非反复谈同一尺寸问题？谁的功劳、资源和知识发生了什么变化？旧承诺有没有被另一个更大的谜题盖住？

再核对标题是否重复、伏笔与角色状态是否对得上、哪些细纲内容没写成。字数是交付的一部分，但多写三千字不能替代少掉的试映或回应。

给下一批写一个准确入口：正式观众场尚未开始，设备已交接并试过，主持人已确认时间。不要把“候选方案”在摘要里升级为“活动圆满结束”。
body.en:
Do the three chapters move Lin from venue consent to a tested arrangement? Does each consume the previous result instead of repeating screen dimensions? Whose credit, resources and knowledge change? Has a new mystery displaced an old promise?

Check repeated titles, clues, character state and unconsumed outline items. Length matters to delivery, but extra words do not replace the missing trial or response.

Leave an accurate next-batch entry: public screening not started, equipment handed over and tested, host confirmed the time. A candidate plan must not become a successful event in the summary.

heading.zh: 可复制的批次请求与常见修复
heading.en: A bounded request and common repairs

body.zh:
> 用 $story-long-write 续写第7—9章，按已有细纲顺序推进本批放映准备。保留第6章已获场地同意的事实；第8章物件交接前不写已持有，第9章只完成试映，不提前写正式观众场。每章说明实际完成、未完成和对下一章的影响。缺细纲先报告，不另编结局；本批后停止。

把章节号和事实换成自己的项目，不把本文三行计划当正式细纲。若只想讨论，明确“不写正文”。

| 问题 | 修复 |
|---|---|
| 连续几章都重复一项准备 | 合并重复，把下一步真实变化给细纲 |
| 某章未写成却跳到已完成 | 补缺口，或改下一章进入状态 |
| 批末摘要泄露后期秘密 | 按当前读者认知重新记录 |
| 标题重复、角色忽然回到旧状态 | 核对本批与已有正文，修事实后再续 |

日更安排也要留出改稿与恢复精力的空间。减少批次范围比靠注水凑量更能保住判断。
body.en:
Ask $story-long-write to draft Chapters 7–9 in the established outline order. Keep Chapter Six’s consent, require handover before possession, end Nine at the trial rather than the public event, report actual and missing results, and stop after the batch. Missing outlines should be reported, not replaced with a new ending.

Replace numbers and facts with your project. The three-row example is not a formal outline. Say “discussion only, no prose” if that is the task.

| Problem | Repair |
|---|---|
| Several chapters repeat one preparation | Merge repetition; plan the next real change |
| Unwritten step treated as complete | Supply it or revise the next entry state |
| Summary exposes future secrets | Use current reader knowledge |
| Duplicate titles or old character state | Reconcile with existing prose before continuing |

Allow room for revision and rest. A smaller batch preserves judgment better than padding a quota.

q.zh: 让AI一次写十章会更省事吗？
q.en: Is requesting ten chapters at once more efficient?

a.zh: 要看工作流和细纲成熟度。这里的固定版本单轮最多三章，长范围拆批；关键是逐章保住因果、信息边界与状态，不把少核对等同于高效率。
a.en: It depends on the workflow and outline readiness. The pinned version caps a turn at three chapters and splits longer ranges. Preserve causality, reveal boundaries and state rather than equating fewer checks with efficiency.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 按已有细纲续写本批指定章节。先确认起止章与阶段目标，按实际上一章结果串行推进；保持信息解锁边界，逐章更新有效变化，批末核对累积兑现与缺口后停止。
text.en: Use $story-long-write for the specified batch in outline order. Confirm range and shared goal, carry actual previous results forward, preserve reveal limits, update relevant changes and review accumulated payoffs and gaps before stopping.

label.zh: 日更批次、串行写作与批末核对
label.en: Chapter batching, sequential drafting and batch review

label.zh: 场景展开、因果与有效变化
label.en: Scene expansion, causality and useful change

title.zh: AI视频多出人物、角色分身怎么办：人数与入画路径
title.en: Extra People or Duplicate Characters in AI Video

seo_title.zh: AI视频多出人物、角色分身怎么办：人数与入画路径
seo_title.en: Extra People or Duplicate Characters in AI Video

description.zh: AI视频多出陌生人、同一角色变成两个人，怎样定位？检查参考图职责、实际可见人数与遮挡进出，附原创修订示例。
description.en: Check reference roles, visible cast and entry paths when AI video adds people or duplicates a character. Includes an original prompt repair.

answer.zh: 先定位多出来的人在哪一刻出现：输入图已经有、背景被带入，还是人物遮挡后重新出现时多了一份。把本镜实际可见者、画外者、入画与出画分别写清，并核对参考图只承担被指定的职责。保持人数要对应剧情，不能用“不要多人”抹掉本来就有的配角。
answer.en: Find when the extra person appears: already in the input, imported from a background, or duplicated after occlusion. Specify visible cast, off-screen people and entries or exits, and restrict each reference to its assigned role. Count constraints must preserve the scene’s actual supporting cast.

heading.zh: 先分清多了谁、何时多出来
heading.en: Locate who was added and when

body.zh:
先回看输入与输出，不用一句“模型分身了”代替观察：

| 观察 | 先查什么 |
|---|---|
| 首帧已有陌生人 | 实际起始图是否符合分镜 |
| 风格图里的模特出现在本镜 | 参考是否被当成整图复制 |
| 遮挡后原人和新身影同时在场 | 身份、路径和再次出现的状态 |
| 一个人走出画面后又多一人回来 | 出画、回归与新人物是否区分 |
| 镜子里也有同一人 | 是否为剧本已有反射，别误删 |

表里是排查方向，不是凭缺陷就认定的技术原因。没有实际输出时只能指出要求含混，不称某次生成已经失败。
body.en:
Review inputs and output rather than label everything “duplication.”

| Observation | First check |
|---|---|
| Extra person in first frame | Actual start image against storyboard |
| Style-image model enters scene | Role mistakenly treated as full-image copying |
| Original and extra figure coexist after occlusion | Identity, route and reappearance state |
| Exit followed by another person returning | Distinguish return from new entry |
| Same person appears in mirror | Established reflection, not necessarily extra cast |

These are diagnostic directions, not proven technical causes. Without output, flag ambiguous requirements rather than claim a failed generation.

heading.zh: 把在场、画外与进出分开
heading.en: Separate visible, off-screen and entering cast

body.zh:
不用把整集人物名单塞进这一镜。只列本镜看得见的人，以及影响动作或声音的画外者。

下面是手写排查卡，不是 skill 原生产物。原创场景：修衣店内，店主叶青绕过衣架，回到试衣镜旁；顾客唐真始终坐在前景，送货员只在门外喊话。

| 对象 | 本镜位置与变化 |
|---|---|
| 叶青 | 从画面右侧衣架后绕过，仍是同一店主 |
| 唐真 | 前景坐着，全程留在画面内 |
| 送货员 | 门外声源，不在本镜入画 |
| 可见人数 | 起点两人；叶青全身被挡时仅唐真可见；终点仍是这两人 |
| 不变条件 | 地点、服装、唐真的位置，衣架外其他人物不新增 |

遮挡会改变某一刻看得见的人数，不等于故事里人物消失；因此“始终两张脸完整可见”与衣架遮挡互相冲突。下一镜若拍送货员，再按新镜头更新可见名单。
body.en:
Do not paste the episode’s full cast into a shot. List visible people and off-screen participants affecting action or sound.

This manual check card is not a native skill output. In an original alterations-shop scene, owner Ye Qing passes behind a garment rack and returns beside the fitting mirror. Customer Tang Zhen stays seated in the foreground. A courier calls only from outside.

| Entry | Position and change |
|---|---|
| Ye | Passes behind right-side rack; same owner returns |
| Tang | Seated in foreground throughout |
| Courier | Outside voice; no on-screen entry in this shot |
| Visible count | Two at start; only Tang visible during full occlusion; same two at end |
| Preserved facts | Location, outfits and Tang’s position; no added people beyond rack |

Occlusion changes visible count without removing a person from the story. “Two fully visible faces throughout” would contradict it. If the next shot shows the courier, update that shot’s visible cast.

heading.zh: 人物板、风格图与首帧不能混用
heading.en: Keep character sheets, style images and start frames distinct

body.zh:
多视图人物板展示同一人的不同观察面，不代表本镜要出现三个相同的人。它可提供身份与造型；本镜起始帧另按分镜写出实际人数、位置与持物。没有合适起始图时，先准备与本镜对应的画面，或按已选择的参考模式补足文字，不把人物板冒充现场首帧。

风格图只借色彩、材质与视觉语言。图里有路人，不能因此把路人带进修衣店；地理图里的临时人物也不自动成为本镜角色。若输入图本身与已定人数冲突，先修输入或更换正确参考，负面词不能把已有像素风险变成已修好。

正式项目按已选模型的参考方式绑定稳定身份。不要把示例角色名当成各个平台统一支持的锁人参数；具体格式由[参考图职责](/drama-skills/reference-image-roles)与当前模型配置决定。
body.en:
A multi-view character sheet shows several views of one person, not three identical people in the shot. It can provide identity and look; the actual start frame follows the storyboard’s visible count, positions and held objects. Prepare a matching start image or supply the chosen reference mode’s required text rather than use the sheet as a scene frame.

A style image supplies color, material and visual language. Its passerby does not belong in this shop, and temporary people in a geography image do not automatically become cast. Fix an input conflicting with the scene; negative wording does not establish that existing pixel risks are repaired.

Bind stable identities through the chosen model’s reference method. Example character names are not universal identity-lock parameters. Follow the reference-role guide and current project profile.

heading.zh: 原创提示词修订：衣架后的同一店主
heading.en: Original repair: the same owner behind the rack

body.zh:
分镜已规定叶青绕衣架回到镜旁，送货员只在门外说话；镜子留在同一位置，但这次取景不显人物镜像。以下是设计对照，未送生成服务。

**含混写法**：

> 参考人物板和时尚店铺照片。她走到衣架后，另一个人走出来，门口有人喊“货到了”，画面始终两个人，不要分身。

“另一个人”与同一店主矛盾，门口喊话也没有区分画外声源；持续可见人数又与遮挡冲突。

**修订写法**：

> 从已确认的起始帧开始，叶青在衣架右侧，唐真坐在前景。门外送货员先喊：“货到了。”送货员保持画外，不入画。叶青转头看门口，随后沿衣架后方绕向试衣镜旁；叶青被衣架完整挡住时，只有唐真可见。叶青从衣架靠镜子的一侧重新出现，仍是同一叶青，衣着与起始帧一致。最终叶青站在镜旁，唐真仍坐在原位。机位固定，看清绕行前后是同一店主；店内只保留这两名人物，不新增路人。本机位不拍人物镜像。

身份、路径、画外声音和终点分别落地，没有把送货员从故事删掉。正式提交时还要按已接受参考映射绑定叶青和唐真；这段自然语言不替代挂图配置。
body.en:
The accepted storyboard has Ye pass behind the rack and return beside the mirror; the courier speaks outside. The mirror stays fixed, but this framing shows no character reflection. This is an ungenerated design comparison.

**Ambiguous:**

> Reference the character board and fashion-shop photo. She goes behind the rack; another person comes out. Someone at the door calls “Delivery.” Always two people, no duplicates.

“Another person” contradicts a returning owner. The voice lacks an off-screen distinction, and continuous visible count conflicts with occlusion.

**Revised:**

> Begin with the accepted start frame: Ye Qing stands right of the rack; Tang Zhen sits in the foreground. The courier first calls from outside, “Delivery.” The courier stays off screen. Ye looks toward the door, then passes behind the rack toward the fitting mirror. While Ye is fully hidden, only Tang is visible. Ye reappears on the mirror side of the rack as the same Ye in the same outfit. End with Ye beside the mirror and Tang seated in the original place. Fixed camera makes the route readable. Retain these two people in the shop without added passersby. This framing shows no character reflection.

Identity, route, off-screen voice and end state are distinct without deleting the courier from the story. Bind Ye and Tang to accepted references when submitting; natural-language text does not replace image mapping.

heading.zh: 生成后沿遮挡前后逐段核对
heading.en: Check output around occlusion

body.zh:
回看起点、遮挡前、遮挡中、重新出现及终点。脸、服装、站位和人数是否连续？原身影是否仍留在衣架前，新身影却又走出来？送货员是否越过了本镜画外范围？只写实际可见缺陷及出现时刻，不把整镜笼统记成失败。

参考和边界清楚、缺陷只偶发时，可以在预算内重试；同处反复出现，就调整本次要求或拆出更可读的绕行镜头。拆镜先修分镜，保持同一店主、声音时机和终点义务，别为避免分身把人物移动删掉。

一次提示词修订不等于视频已修好。只有实际结果里多余人物消失、原定角色和剧情仍保留，才能作为可用版本；处置选择另见[重抽、改写还是补拍](/drama-skills/reroll-or-rewrite)。
body.en:
Review start, pre-occlusion, hidden interval, reappearance and end. Check identity, outfit, position and count. Does an original figure remain before the rack while another emerges? Does the courier enter contrary to the shot? Record the visible defect and moment instead of marking the whole shot simply “failed.”

If inputs and boundaries are clear and the defect is occasional, retry within budget. If it recurs at the same point, revise requirements or split the route into clearer shots. Revise the storyboard first while preserving the owner, voice timing and end obligation rather than deleting movement.

A prompt repair is not a repaired video. Accept only output that removes the extra person while retaining intended cast and story. The reroll-or-rewrite guide covers routing choices.

q.zh: 只写“不要多人、不要分身”有用吗？
q.en: Is “no extra people, no duplicates” enough?

a.zh: 它可以是必要的排除说明，但不能替代正确输入和具体状态。先写本镜原定可见者、画外者及遮挡进出，再保护不参与变化的人物；若原场景就有两人，不要改成“只能一人”解决。
a.en: It can be a useful exclusion, but does not replace correct inputs and concrete state. Specify intended visible cast, off-screen participants and occlusion paths. Do not force a two-person scene down to one.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-video-prompts 检查这一镜多出人物的风险。先核对已接受分镜、实际参考图职责、可见名单和画外声音；沿遮挡进出写同一身份与终点，保留原剧情。若有真实输出，只报告看见的缺陷；先修提示词，不生成视频。
text.en: Use $short-drama-video-prompts to check extra-cast risks against accepted storyboard, reference roles, visible cast and off-screen voices. Preserve identity along occlusion and the required end state. Report only observed defects when output exists. Revise text without generating video.

label.zh: 参考图职责与人数边界
多人指代与本镜可见状态
关键帧的可见角色与边界

title.zh: AI视频配乐在剪辑点重启怎么办：跨镜头接续表
title.en: How to Keep Music Continuous Across AI-Generated Video Shots

seo_title.zh: AI视频配乐怎么跨镜头接续
seo_title.en: AI Video Music Continuity Across Shots

description.zh: 分别生成的镜头一拼接，配乐就重启或硬切？用逐镜状态表把观众专属配乐放回时间线，标清延续、进入、退出和对白让位，再回听实际成片接点。
description.en: Does music restart or hard-cut when separately generated shots are joined? Map its entry, exit, continuation, or dialogue ducking, then replay the joined cut.

answer.zh: 镜头一拼接配乐就重启，先分清观众专属配乐与画内声音。通常把同一条配乐安排在整段剪辑时间线上，逐镜写进入、延续、让对白和退出；素材里已混入的音乐则先查能否独立处理。提示词中的方案不等于已经混好，最后要回听成片接点。
answer.en: If music restarts at each cut, distinguish audience-only score from sound in the scene. Usually place one score on the sequence timeline and map entry, continuation, dialogue space and exit. First check whether music baked into footage can be treated separately. A prompt is a plan; listen to the actual joined output.

heading.zh: 先分清配乐与画内声源
heading.en: Separate score from scene sound

body.zh:
观众听见、人物听不见的衬乐是配乐层。收音机、手机铃声、现场演奏等属于画内或画外的场景声源，要随地点、距离和剧情动作变化。

Drama Skills 默认把配乐实现留给时间线，避免每个生成文件各自起奏。逐镜仍应写配乐意图。如果项目已明确接受单镜自带音乐或整段统一交付，沿用该方案，不把“单镜有音乐”一律判错。音乐多少、强弱和是否使用，按本场体验选择。
body.en:
Audience-only underscore belongs to the score layer. A radio, ringtone or live performance belongs to the scene and follows location, distance and story action.

Drama Skills normally leaves score realization to the sequence timeline, so individual files do not each begin a new piece. Per-shot musical intent still matters. Honor an accepted baked-music or single-container approach when that is the project’s choice. Density, strength and whether to use music follow the scene’s experience.

heading.zh: 把音乐写成跨镜接续
heading.en: Map the music across cuts

body.zh:
先看相邻镜之间需要连续、主动断开，还是让一句话成为焦点。下面是作者手写表，不是已经执行的混音报告。

| 状态 | 要写清什么 | 回听什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 进入 | 从哪个事件起，同一条音乐的哪个位置 | 是否抢过必要台词或提前泄露情绪 |
| 延续 | 与前镜使用同一时间线位置 | 切点有没有重新起奏或突然换曲 |
| 让位 | 哪段对白需要更清楚，何时恢复 | 台词、环境与音乐的相对关系 |
| 退出 | 由何事件结束，怎样收尾 | 尾音是否被无意截断 |

硬切音乐也可以有叙事用途，例如突然失去安全感；说明意图，再用实际听感判断。不要为了“平滑”消除作者需要的断裂。
body.en:
Decide whether neighboring shots need continuity, an intentional stop or space for a line. This manual author table is a plan, not an executed mix report.

| State | Specify | Listen for |
|---|---|---|
| Enter | Trigger and position in the chosen track | A line masked or emotion revealed too early |
| Continue | Same timeline position across the cut | Restart, sudden new music or level jump |
| Yield | Dialogue span and recovery point | Relative voice, room and music levels |
| Exit | Trigger and ending shape | An accidentally chopped tail |

A hard music cut can serve the story, such as a sudden loss of safety. State that intent and judge the actual listening result. Smoothing should not erase the desired break.

heading.zh: 原创例子：天文馆的三镜试映
heading.en: Original example: a three-shot dome test

body.zh:
以下是剪辑设计示例，尚未生成或试听。技术员在开门前调星图；投影机风扇是已设定的场景声源，配乐 M1 是这个示例项目选用的观众专属音乐。

| 镜头 | 画面与声音 | 配乐位置 |
|---|---|---|
| A01 | 暗圆顶亮起第一组星点；风扇持续 | 星点亮起时进入 M1 |
| A02 | 调焦环近景；技术员说“木星边缘还在发虚” | 延续 M1，在这句台词期间让位 |
| A03 | 星图稳定；回圆顶全景 | 延续后退出；风扇仍在空间中 |

配乐让位不是把所有声音关闭。技术员必须能被听清，风扇是否保留、退远多少，服从场景已确定的声音方案。

若 A02 自带音乐，先检查是否有可独立处理的音轨。能处理时，在该音乐层上调整，再接序列中的 M1；若音乐、台词和风扇已混成一个文件，先评估实际可用性。无法保住完整台词时回制作阶段补素材，不能假设能无损剥离。
body.en:
This is an edit design, not generated or auditioned footage. A technician adjusts the star map before opening. The projector fan is an established scene sound; M1 is the example project’s audience-only score.

| Shot | Content | Score |
|---|---|---|
| A01 | First stars appear on a dark dome; fan continues | Enter M1 with the stars |
| A02 | Focus-ring detail; “Jupiter’s edge is still blurry” | Continue M1 and yield for this line |
| A03 | Stable stars, wide dome view | Continue then exit; fan remains |

Yielding score does not mute all sound. Keep the line intelligible; preserve or reduce the fan according to the accepted scene plan.

If A02 contains music, inspect whether that layer can be treated separately. If so, adjust it and join timeline M1. If music, speech and fan share one baked file, assess the actual usable material. Request replacement footage when the complete line cannot be preserved; do not assume lossless separation.

heading.zh: 从方案到实际混音
heading.en: From plan to an actual mix

body.zh:
这个固定版本的内置 render 保留原声，`声音` 行记录方案，不执行配乐进出、交叉淡入或对白压低。需要这些处理时，用外部剪辑或混音工具完成，记录所用素材、音乐位置、处理区间和实际输出，再回到成片验收。

连听 A01→A02、A02→A03，检查音乐位置、台词完整性与风扇空间是否相接。整片响度合适也不等于每句都清楚。重出某个视频后，再查该处接点；不把旧试听结果沿用到新文件。

环境声的变化另见[同场底声接续](/drama-skills/ai-video-ambient-sound-continuity)；场景为什么需要音乐或留白，见[声音设计主篇](/drama-skills/scene-sound-and-silence)。
body.en:
In this pinned version, built-in render retains source audio. Its sound line records intent; it does not execute score entry/exit, crossfades or dialogue ducking. Use an external edit or mix tool when needed, record source material, track position, treatment spans and actual output, then review the finished sequence.

Listen across A01→A02 and A02→A03 for track position, complete speech and fan space. An acceptable overall level does not prove each line is clear. Recheck a join when a shot is regenerated rather than carrying an old listening result onto a new file.

See [room-tone continuity](/drama-skills/ai-video-ambient-sound-continuity) for ambience, and [scene sound design](/drama-skills/scene-sound-and-silence) for why music or silence belongs here.

q.zh: 每个镜头都不能带音乐吗？
q.en: Must every shot be music-free?

a.zh: 不是。时间线实现是默认方案；已接受的单镜音乐或统一交付可以保留。先区分场景声源与配乐，再检查实际接缝。
a.en: No. Timeline score is a default; accepted baked music or unified delivery can remain. Separate scene sound from score and check actual joins.

text.zh: 用 $short-drama-edit 检查已存在的素材、剧本和剪辑单。逐镜区分场景声源与配乐，列进入、延续、让位和退出；标明需要外部混音的区间，实际处理后回听成片。没有媒体或输出时只交方案，不写试听通过。
