title.en: How to Write a Second-Chance Romance Readers Believe
title.zh: 破镜重圆怎么写可信：让旧问题被解决，而非遗忘

seo_title.en: Write a Second-Chance Romance
seo_title.zh: 破镜重圆怎么写

description.zh: 分清旧误会、真实伤害与分离后的变化，用回忆、当前选择和双方回应写可信复合。附原创小说片段、关系检查表与失败修法。
description.en: Separate misunderstanding, harm, and change after separation. Includes an original prose scene, a repair worksheet, and checks for a believable reunion.

answer.zh: 先写两人为何分开，以及当时的理解与实际伤害分别是什么。重逢后的解释可以改认知，可靠选择与对方回应才让读者相信相处变了。分开记录“还有感情”和“同意重新交往”；回忆用来重读旧事，不替人物自动原谅。结局按作品承诺与双方选择写，不强制受伤的一方也要被改造成另一个人。
answer.en: Establish why they separated, distinguishing what they believed from the harm that occurred. Explanation may change understanding; reliable choices and the other person’s response make changed contact believable. Track lingering affection separately from agreement to date again. Use memory to reinterpret the past without automatic forgiveness, and follow the book’s promise and both choices rather than forcing the injured person to become someone else.

heading.zh: 把“当年没说清”与“当年真的做错”分开
heading.en: Separate an Unexplained Past from Actual Harm

body.zh:
一句“其实我一直爱你”不能回答所有分离。先区分：两人误解了同一件事，外部条件让他们分开，还是一人确实替另一人做了决定、失约或伤害。解释分别能改什么，损失又有哪些已经无法撤销？

不必给每次重逢加秘密或第三者。若双方当年没有过错，重新认识现在的彼此也能成为故事；若确有伤害，查清事实之后仍要接住当事人的回答。

本页将人物关系方法中的独立目标、好感与社会关系两条进度、基于既有人设的局部变化，以及情绪方法中的具体投入和可信回应，组合成复合检查。它是作者编辑方法，不是 skill 的原生“破镜重圆公式”。
body.en:
“I always loved you” cannot answer every separation. Distinguish misunderstanding, outside circumstances, and actual decisions made for someone else, broken promises, or harm. What can explanation change, and which losses cannot simply be undone?

Reunion need not acquire a secret or third party. Without past wrongdoing, meeting each other as changed people can carry the story. With harm, clarification still needs the affected person’s answer.

This page combines the relationship methods’ independent goals, separate affection and social progress, and local change grounded in established character with the emotional methods’ specific investment and credible response. It is an editorial approach, not the skill’s native second-chance formula.

heading.zh: 复合检查表：别把道歉直接跳成确认关系
heading.en: A Repair Worksheet: Do Not Jump from Apology to Dating

body.zh:
| 记录 | 要写清什么 |
|---|---|
| 旧相处 | 为什么曾经愿意在一起？留一个具体而可信的体验。 |
| 分离 | 谁知道什么、怎样判断、实际做了什么？别把误会和行为混成一项。 |
| 当前目标 | 没有复合结果时，两人仍各自要做什么？重逢是否符合这些目标？ |
| 改变 | 哪个当前选择回应了旧问题？这次对方有没有听见、看见或收到？ |
| 对方回应 | 接受说明、继续合作、约会或拒绝分别是不同决定。 |
| 新相处 | 双方答应了什么，实际相处又走到哪里？不用一句“从此再无问题”封口。 |

不用一次写满，也不要求相处每场升级。人物的变化可以是原有长处获得新的边界：仍擅长安排，但不再代替伴侣决定。犯错者承担对应责任，不为追求“双向成长”把受伤者改写成同样有错。
body.en:
| Record | Clarify |
|---|---|
| Earlier bond | Why did they want to be together? Keep a specific, credible experience. |
| Separation | Who knew what, how did they interpret it, and what did they actually do? Belief and conduct are distinct. |
| Present goal | What does each want without reunion? Does meeting again fit those goals? |
| Change | Which current choice answers the old problem? Has the other person seen, heard, or received it? |
| Response | Accepting an explanation, working together, dating, and refusing are different decisions. |
| New contact | What have both agreed, and how far has actual interaction gone? “No more problems” cannot replace contact. |

Do not fill everything at once or upgrade the relationship in every scene. Change may give an old strength a boundary: someone remains good at planning while ceasing to decide for a partner. Responsibility follows conduct; “mutual growth” need not make the injured person equally at fault.

heading.zh: 完整原创片段：同一句“我替你想好了”，如今怎样回答
heading.en: Complete Original Prose: Answering “I Planned It for You” Differently

body.zh:
虚构小说中，编辑沈晓与插画师周衡分开一年。过去他常帮她整理出行细节，她曾喜欢那种被照顾的轻松；后来他未经询问，向邀请方说她不接受外地驻留，错过的名额已给别人。她在看见往来邮件后分手，原因不是不知道他爱她，而是不接受自己的去留由他决定。

一年后，两人分别接受朋友组织的小册子项目：沈晓交文字，周衡交插画。双方都知道会合作，沈晓明确只谈项目。她又收到新的驻留邀请，出发日期在册子交稿前；这个机会来自她自己的申请，与周衡无关。

> 周衡把版面样张推到她面前。“你出发后，校样我可以替你看。”
>
> 沈晓没接。他以前也这样把车票摊在桌上，连转车时该买什么都算好了。那时她把不用再想的晚上叫作安心；后来才知道，他会把同一份安心延伸到她没交出去的决定。
>
> “插画部分你看，”她说，“文字我自己看。”
>
> 他把已写上的“我统一确认”划掉，重新分开两人的部分。“好。你什么时候方便，我按你回信的时间排。”
>
> “驻留我会去。”
>
> 周衡停了一会儿。“知道。我当年说你不去，是我想让你留下，不是邀请方误会。那个名额补不回来。我已经向他们更正了我代你答复这件事，请他们以后直接找你。回信转给了你。”
>
> “我收到了。”沈晓说。邀请方回复已修改联系备注，没有承诺恢复旧名额。她那天读完，合上邮件做了自己的申请；此刻不需要再听一个更动人的理由。
>
> 她指了指样张。“下周三我在路上。文字校样周四发我，我当天回。你若赶不上，也先告诉我。”
>
> “周四发。来不及我会说，不替你确认。”

**回应后来发生，不能只停在这段答应。** 周四沈晓收到文字校样，回复了一处段落调整。周衡依她的回复更新版面，再发她确认；没有因印厂催促替她点头。插画由他负责，文字由她负责，朋友组织者收到各自确认后才交印。这项合作完成了新边界，没有自动恢复恋爱。

驻留一个月后，两人已按沈晓愿意的频率通话。她说：“回来后我想和你约会，重新开始，但我的去留还是我决定。”周衡回答“我愿意”，没有把这句话当作她放弃驻留。她回来后，两人实际去了一次约好的晚饭，谈了新的工作安排；她没有搬回去，他们也没有宣称全部旧伤消失。

这段回忆让读者重读“照顾”的旧意义，不复述整个恋爱史；当前协商、校样回应和双方确认各有落点。她重新靠近不靠替他开脱，也不需要否定过去所有温暖。若作者要写最终分开，保留已完成的更正与合作，把约会一段改成双方选择；不能仍称已经复合。
body.en:
In this fictional novel, editor Shen Xiao and illustrator Zhou Heng separated a year ago. He used to organize travel details, and she liked the ease of being cared for. Later he told a residency organizer she would not attend without asking her. The place went to someone else. She read the correspondence and ended the relationship because her movements were being decided for her, not because she doubted his love.

A year later, both separately accept a friend’s booklet project: her text, his illustrations. Both know they will collaborate; Shen has specified work contact only. A new residency invitation, from her own application, has a departure date before the booklet deadline. Zhou did not obtain it for her.

> Zhou pushed the layout toward her. “Once you leave, I can check the proofs for you.”
>
> Shen did not take it. He had once spread tickets across the table like this, planning even what to buy between trains. Back then she called an evening with nothing left to arrange peace. Later she learned he could extend that peace into decisions she had never handed over.
>
> “You check the illustrations,” she said. “I’ll check my text.”
>
> He crossed out “I confirm everything” and separated their portions. “All right. Tell me when you can reply, and I’ll plan around that.”
>
> “I’m going to the residency.”
>
> He paused. “I know. I told them you wouldn’t because I wanted you to stay. They didn’t misunderstand. I can’t restore that place. I corrected the reply I made for you and asked them to contact you directly in future. I forwarded their answer.”
>
> “I received it.” The organizer had changed the contact note, not promised the old place back. After reading it she had closed the message and made her own application. She did not need a more moving excuse now.
>
> She pointed to the layout. “I’m traveling next Wednesday. Send the text proof Thursday and I’ll reply that day. Tell me first if you can’t make it.”
>
> “Thursday. If I’m late, I’ll say so. I won’t confirm for you.”

**The later response matters beyond this agreement.** On Thursday Shen receives the text proof and requests a paragraph adjustment. Zhou updates the layout from her reply and sends it for confirmation instead of agreeing for her when the printer asks. Each confirms their own contribution before the friend sends it to print. Work establishes a new boundary; it does not automatically restore romance.

A month into the residency, they have been calling at a frequency Shen welcomes. She says she wants to date again after returning, with her movement still her own decision. Zhou agrees without treating that as cancellation of the residency. On her return they actually share an arranged dinner and discuss current work. She has not moved back in, and neither declares every old hurt gone.

Memory lets readers reinterpret care without retelling the whole relationship. Present discussion, proof replies, and mutual confirmation each have a place. Shen need not excuse Zhou to approach him or deny all past warmth. For an ending apart, retain correction and professional cooperation and rewrite the dating section around both choices; do not still report reunion.

heading.zh: 复合显得勉强，先修哪一处
heading.en: Where to Repair a Reunion That Feels Forced

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 只有痛哭和表白，没有旧问题的回应 | 找一个对应旧问题的真实选择，接另一方回答；不必新增巨大牺牲。 |
| 真相全推给第三人，行为责任消失 | 分开写谁提供错误信息、谁作决定及其实际影响。 |
| 一句道歉马上变同居或结婚 | 分开好感与关系确认，补符合当前阶段的相处。 |
| 回忆每次原样重播 | 检查新理解或情绪体验，压缩无作用的重复。 |
| 所有改变都由受伤者完成 | 将对应责任放回行为者，不用“你也成长了”抹平过错。 |
| 修复全是办事流程，读者感受不到靠近 | 保留具体相处、迟疑、声音或直接情绪；流程只留故事需要的部分。 |

先修最影响相信的一处，不把整本小说写成逐条验收。双方可仍保有分歧，也可以在一个温暖场景里稳定相处。
body.en:
| Problem | Repair |
|---|---|
| Tears and confession never answer the old problem | Show a corresponding choice and the other person’s answer without requiring enormous sacrifice. |
| A third party takes all blame and conduct disappears | Separate who supplied misinformation, who decided, and what it did. |
| Apology instantly becomes living together or marriage | Separate affection from confirmation and show contact suited to the present stage. |
| Each memory replays unchanged | Check new understanding or emotional experience; compress repetition without function. |
| The injured person does all the changing | Return responsibility to conduct rather than erasing fault through “you grew too.” |
| Repair is all procedure, with no felt closeness | Preserve shared experience, hesitation, voice, or direct feeling; retain only procedures the story needs. |

Repair the weakest basis for belief first rather than turning the novel into an inspection. Differences may remain, and a warm scene can sustain stable contact.

q.zh: 破镜重圆必须两个人都改变吗？
q.en: Must both people change for a reunion?

a.zh: 不必同等改变或同等有错。源方法提供基于旧人设的双向变化作为选择；实际责任、愿望和关系进度按这两个人来写，不强迫受伤者替另一人完成成长。
a.en: They need not change equally or share blame equally. The source offers mutual change grounded in established character as an option. Write responsibility, wishes, and relationship progress for these people without making the injured partner perform the other’s growth.

q.zh: 结尾可以不复合吗？
q.en: Can they stay apart at the end?

a.zh: 可以按作者选择写，但要对照作品已建立的承诺。若复合是核心期待，分开结局应有充分的过程与落点；接受道歉、原谅和同意交往不是同一件事。
a.en: Follow the author’s chosen ending while checking the promise established by the book. If reunion is central to that promise, an ending apart needs adequate development and a clear resolution. Accepting an apology, forgiving, and agreeing to date are different.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查这段破镜重圆小说，附旧分离、已发生损失、当前知情和作者选定结局。检查回忆是否增加理解、行为变化是否对应旧问题、另一方是否真实回应，以及好感与关系确认是否混淆。保留本书文风和独立目标，不自动改成复合，不强迫双方同等有错；只处理点名片段。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review this second-chance passage with the separation, actual losses, present knowledge, and chosen ending. Check the memory’s function, behavior answering the old problem, genuine response, and affection versus relationship confirmation. Preserve voice and independent goals without assuming reunion or equal blame. Revise only the named passage.

label.zh: 独立目标、关系进度与人物变化
label.en: Independent goals, relationship progress, and character change

label.zh: 具体投入、意义变化与可信回应
label.en: Investment, changing meaning, and credible response

title.en: How to Write an Argument Scene That Changes the Relationship
title.zh: 小说争吵戏怎么写有变化：让双方各有目标和筹码

seo_title.en: Write an Argument Scene
seo_title.zh: 小说争吵戏怎么写

description.zh: 从双方议程、情绪承接和实际分歧写争吵。附搬家场景完整改写、逐回合分析与重复吵架的修订办法。
description.en: Build arguments from different agendas and responsive emotion. Includes a complete moving-day scene, exchange analysis, and repairs for repetitive fights.

answer.zh: 先写各人希望谈话改变什么、正在保护什么，再让下一句回应上一句的内容与情绪。争吵可以澄清事实、暴露旧委屈、作出让步，也可以暂时停下；不必一路升级到侮辱。分清“这件事谈妥了”和“关系完全修好了”，结尾保留实际做到的部分。
answer.en: Start with what each person wants the conversation to change and what they protect. Make the next line answer both content and emotion. An argument may clarify a fact, expose resentment, negotiate, or pause without escalating to insults. Distinguish settling this issue from repairing the entire relationship, and end at what actually happens.

heading.zh: 先写争什么，再写为什么这句话刺痛人
heading.en: Define the Dispute and Why This Line Hurts

body.zh:
对白方法从议程、关系、场合和目的决定语气；情绪场景还要承接、偏转、升级或退缩，而不是轮流播报。把争吵缩成“一个人想什么，另一个人不让”后，再找各自不愿失去的具体东西。

| 问题 | 写前记录 |
|---|---|
| 表面争什么 | 一个安排、物件、说法或选择，别只写“他们意见不合”。 |
| 各人想保什么 | 时间、被尊重、过去的价值、工作量或自己的决定。 |
| 当前知道什么 | 看见的事实与推测分开，作者知道不等于人物知道。 |
| 本场走到哪里 | 和解、部分谈妥、暂缓或分开，按这场戏的目标选择。 |

这些是编辑提问，不是原生争吵模板。源方法中的压制、反转、心死是可选对白模式；字数门槛、五级冲突与刻薄话术不适用于每场争论。明确表达也能有张力，不要求所有真实动机藏起来。
body.en:
The dialogue methods derive tone from agenda, relationship, setting, and purpose. Emotional replies acknowledge, redirect, escalate, or withdraw rather than take turns broadcasting. Define the contested issue, then what each person fears losing.

| Question | Record Before Writing |
|---|---|
| Surface dispute | A plan, object, statement, or choice, rather than “they disagree.” |
| What each protects | Time, respect, the past, workload, or an independent decision. |
| Present knowledge | Separate observations from guesses. Author knowledge is not character knowledge. |
| Scene destination | Resolution, partial agreement, postponement, or separation, according to this scene. |

These are editorial questions, not a native argument template. The source’s domination, reversal, and emotional-withdrawal patterns are options. Word thresholds, five-level escalation, and cruel tactics do not govern every dispute. Direct expression can carry tension without hiding every motive.

heading.zh: 原创改写：照片被当成“杂物”，争的却不只是一箱东西
heading.en: Complete Original Revision: Photographs Labeled “Miscellaneous”

body.zh:
虚构搬家场景：母亲已经去新住处，姐弟留在旧屋打包，搬家车六点来。弟弟陆川已收拾两下午，姐姐陆宁下班后五点半才到；双方知道她此前在上班。母亲的旧相册必须带走，但还没有逐本整理。陆川把相册装进待搬的纸箱，箱外写“杂物”；他刚说过新家放不了那么多旧东西。陆宁看见标签，担心他会丢掉。没有人已经扔掉相册。

**泛用吵法：**“你总是这么自私！”“你又来指责我！”“你根本不在乎这个家！”它可以套在任何争吵上，也让搬走与丢弃混成一件事。

**完整片段：**

> 陆宁按住箱盖。“这些你要扔？”
>
> “装车的。”陆川把胶带放到桌上，“六点车来，你要一本本挑，现在肯定来不及。”
>
> “我没说现在挑。你刚说旧东西放不下，这上面又写杂物。”
>
> “不写杂物写什么？两下午都是我一个人装的，你来了先看我哪里不对。”
>
> 陆宁松开箱盖。她知道那两下午他没去打球，但直到这句，才听出他不是嫌照片占地方。
>
> “我刚才是怕你扔，不是说你没做事。”她说，“这个箱子我带着，今晚慢慢分。剩下的书我装，你去吃点东西。”
>
> “照片全带，不在这儿挑？”
>
> “全带。箱上改写相册，到新家我自己搬。”
>
> 陆川把记号笔递给她。“书按大小装，别把那套放散了。”
>
> “知道。你给我留个大箱。”

陆宁实际改好标签，接着装剩下的书；陆川把大箱放到她旁边，去吃之前留在厨房的饭。车来时，相册箱随其他箱子搬走，陆宁在新家接过并放到自己的整理区。这里完成的是照片去向和本次分工，不是证明她今晚已经整理完，也不是两人所有积怨消失。

陆宁纠正误判，同时接住“工作都落在我身上”的委屈；陆川不再只催时间，开始确认她提出的办法。变软有具体触发，但不必逐步写“很生气、稍微生气、不生气”。两人也没有因一句话突然换性格。
body.en:
Fictional moving day: their mother is already at the new home. Siblings Lu Chuan and Lu Ning pack the old one before the truck arrives at six. Chuan has worked two afternoons; Ning arrives from work at five-thirty, as both know. Their mother’s albums must come along but have not been individually sorted. Chuan places them in an outgoing box labeled “Miscellaneous,” after saying the new home cannot hold every old possession. Ning fears disposal. No album has been thrown away.

**Generic fight:** “You’re always selfish!” “You only blame me!” “You don’t care about this family!” It could fit any argument and blurs moving the albums with discarding them.

**Complete passage:**

> Ning held the lid. “Are you throwing these away?”
>
> “They’re going on the truck.” Chuan put the tape on the table. “It comes at six. We can’t choose them one by one now.”
>
> “I didn’t say choose now. You said there wasn’t room for old things, and this says miscellaneous.”
>
> “What else should it say? I’ve spent two afternoons packing alone. You arrive and look for what I did wrong.”
>
> Ning released the lid. She knew he had missed basketball both afternoons, but only now heard that he was not complaining about the photographs taking space.
>
> “I thought you were throwing them out. I wasn’t saying you’d done nothing,” she said. “I’ll take this box and sort it tonight. I’ll pack the books left here. Go eat something.”
>
> “All the photographs? No choosing here?”
>
> “All of them. Label it albums. I’ll carry it at the new place.”
>
> He offered the marker. “Pack the books by size. Keep that set together.”
>
> “I know. Leave me a big box.”

Ning changes the label and packs the remaining books. Chuan places a large box beside her and goes to eat the meal left in the kitchen. When the truck comes, the albums travel with the other boxes; Ning receives them at the new home and puts them in her sorting area. Destination and this division of work are settled. This does not prove she has finished sorting that night or that every resentment has vanished.

Ning corrects her inference while answering his resentment about doing the work alone. Chuan moves from insisting on time to checking her proposal. A concrete trigger supports the softening without a narrated ladder from furious to less furious to calm. Neither abruptly changes personality.

heading.zh: 逐回合看：下一句有没有接住上一句
heading.en: Check Whether the Next Line Answers the Previous One

body.zh:
| 回合 | 起作用的地方 |
|---|---|
| “这些你要扔？”→“装车的” | 先纠正实际去向，不让错误指控无限重复。 |
| 标签解释→两下午独自劳动 | 对话露出真正委屈，争点由照片去向增加到劳动分担。 |
| “不是说你没做事”→承担剩下的书 | 接住情绪并给可行安排，不只劝他别生气。 |
| “照片全带？”→“全带” | 确认方案内容，不把沉默当同意。 |
| 改标签、留箱、实际搬走 | 把谈妥落实到本次行动，保留整理尚未完成。 |

分析表只解释这一段，不要求所有争吵使用同样回合。有的场景需要爆发，有的需要冷下来或说不下去；对方不愿答时，也可以写拒绝、回避或暂停。不要让外人突然打电话替两人解决全部，也不要强行让一人认错来结束篇幅。
body.en:
| Exchange | What It Does |
|---|---|
| “Throwing these away?” → “On the truck” | Corrects destination instead of repeating a false accusation indefinitely. |
| Label explanation → Two afternoons alone | Exposes resentment and adds workload to the disputed destination. |
| “Not saying you did nothing” → Packing the books | Answers emotion with a feasible arrangement rather than “calm down.” |
| “All the photographs?” → “All of them” | Confirms the proposal instead of treating silence as agreement. |
| New label, available box, actual move | Enacts this agreement while leaving sorting unfinished. |

The table explains this passage, not required rounds for every fight. A scene may need an outburst, cooling, or inability to continue. Refusal, avoidance, and a pause are possible replies. An outsider’s convenient call need not solve everything, and a forced admission should not merely end the word count.

heading.zh: 争吵重复或太假，按问题修
heading.en: Repair Repetitive or Unconvincing Arguments

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 双方各说各话 | 找出没被回应的要求或情绪，让下一句选择接住、偏转或拒绝。 |
| 只有喊叫和侮辱 | 补具体争点与后果，按人设选表达，不把升级当必经路。 |
| 一句解释就变开心 | 分清事实澄清与旧委屈；写真实触发和回应，不填情绪等级表。 |
| 同一误会跨场重新出现 | 保留已经知道的事实，后续争新的问题或真实未解决部分。 |
| 每句配攥拳、转头、咬唇 | 删重复情绪标签，保留有意义的动作或准确直写。 |
| 结尾像会议纪要 | 把本场需要的体验写在声音、迟疑和实际相处里，解释表留在教程。 |

朗读不是考口语纯度。端正、文雅、克制或有意夸张的声音都可以成立，按作品文风判断有没有机械轮换、凭空知情或不接话。需要修改 AI 稿时，把原片段、双方已知事实与停笔点一起给出，先说明只改对白还是也可改衔接；不要借“更有冲突”擅自增加伤害。
body.en:
| Problem | Repair |
|---|---|
| Parallel monologues | Find the unanswered request or emotion; let the next line acknowledge, redirect, or reject it. |
| Only shouting and insults | Specify issue and consequence, then choose expression for these people without compulsory escalation. |
| Explanation instantly makes everyone happy | Distinguish corrected facts from resentment. Show a credible trigger and reply without a mood-level worksheet. |
| The same misconception resets next scene | Keep acquired knowledge and dispute a new issue or what remains unresolved. |
| A clenched fist, turn, or bitten lip per line | Remove duplicate emotional tags; keep meaningful action or accurate direct feeling. |
| The ending reads like minutes | Let voice, hesitation, and contact carry the experience; leave the analysis table in the tutorial. |

Reading aloud is not a test of colloquial purity. Formal, elegant, restrained, or deliberately exaggerated voices can work. Within the book’s voice, check mechanical turns, invented knowledge, and unanswered lines. Give AI the original passage, known facts, and stopping point. Specify dialogue-only changes or permitted transitions rather than letting “more conflict” silently add harm.

q.zh: 争吵一定要越吵越激烈吗？
q.en: Must an argument keep escalating?

a.zh: 不一定。源方法有递进式冲突作为选择，本场可以部分谈妥、安静下来、暂停或分开。关键是情绪与回应接得上，并保留已知事实和当前关系。
a.en: No. Escalation is one source option. This scene may reach partial agreement, quiet, a pause, or separation. Connect emotion and replies while preserving knowledge and the present relationship.

q.zh: 一场争吵一定要分出谁赢吗？
q.en: Must one person win the argument?

a.zh: 不必。可以谈妥本次安排、得到新理解、维持分歧或暂缓；按本场需要写。共同搬走照片不等于所有旧委屈都解决，不强行安排胜者与输者。
a.en: No. This scene may settle a practical arrangement, change understanding, retain disagreement, or pause. Moving the photographs does not resolve every resentment; a winner and loser need not be assigned.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查这段争吵对白，附双方议程、已知事实、场合与本场结局。找没被回应的内容和情绪、重复争点与突然变脸；按作者文风提出局部改法，不强迫侮辱、和解或新增身体动作。保留剧情，只改点名范围。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review this argument with agendas, known facts, setting, and the intended ending. Find unanswered content or emotion, repeated disputes, and abrupt mood changes. Suggest local repairs within the author’s voice without compulsory insults, reconciliation, or bodily gestures. Preserve plot and revise only the named scope.

label.zh: 议程、情绪承接与对白模式
label.en: Agendas, emotional replies, and dialogue modes

label.zh: 情绪直写与反应删除测试
label.en: Direct feeling and reaction deletion test

title.en: How to Write a Friends-to-Lovers Romance That Feels Earned
title.zh: 如何写出转变自然的朋友变恋人故事

seo_title.en: Write Friends-to-Lovers Romance
seo_title.zh: 写好朋友变恋人

description.zh: 从既有友情与新的私人邀约写转变，分清熟悉、好感和确认。附原创录音场景、双方回应与拒绝后的修订办法。
description.en: Distinguish friendship, attraction, and agreement to date. Includes an original recording scene, mutual replies, and repairs when a transition feels forced.

answer.zh: 先让读者相信两人原来怎样做朋友，再写某次相处为什么被重新理解。熟悉、帮忙和陪伴可能已存在多年，不等于对方愿意恋爱；新的邀请、心意与回答才说明关系发生什么。保留友情里真实的温暖，也保留各自目标，不靠突然吃醋或救命恩情逼出恋爱。
answer.en: Establish how these people were friends, then why a present encounter gains a different meaning. Familiarity, help, and company may have existed for years without willingness to date. New invitations, feelings, and replies clarify what changes. Keep the friendship’s warmth and independent goals rather than using jealousy or rescue debt to force romance.

heading.zh: 先写友情已经有的内容，别把旧帮助都改成暗恋证据
heading.en: Keep What the Friendship Already Contains

body.zh:
人物关系方法分开实际好感与表面关系，也强调恋爱之外的独立目标。朋友变恋人的难点常是：同一种陪伴，过去可以被理解成友情，如今要让读者看出为什么有了新意义。

| 记录 | 问自己 |
|---|---|
| 旧友情 | 常一起做什么？怎样相处舒服？谁曾认真听过谁？ |
| 新认识 | 此次为什么想到恋爱，而不是重复一场普通帮忙？ |
| 两方所知 | 自己心动、猜对方心动和已得到回答分别是什么？ |
| 独立生活 | 即使没有恋爱结果，两人仍要完成什么？ |

这张卡组合关系与情绪方法，是编辑工具，不是 skill 原生的“朋友变恋人公式”。不用把从前每次送饭、接送都倒改成蓄意追求；友情本身有价值。
body.en:
The relationship methods separate affection from public status and preserve goals beyond romance. The difficulty is often that the same company once meant friendship; readers now need to understand its changed meaning.

| Record | Ask |
|---|---|
| Earlier friendship | What did they do together? What felt easy? Who listened to whom? |
| New recognition | Why consider romance here instead of another ordinary favor? |
| Knowledge | Separate personal attraction, a guess about the friend, and an actual answer. |
| Independent life | What does each want even without a romantic outcome? |

This editorial card combines relationship and emotional methods, not a native friends-to-lovers formula. Past meals or rides need not all be rewritten as deliberate courtship. Friendship has its own value.

heading.zh: 原创片段：这次邀请不再叫“顺便”
heading.en: Original Passage: An Invitation That Is No Longer “While We’re There”

body.zh:
唐沐和韩澈都是二十四岁，做朋友多年。唐沐三周后去已确认的外地音乐实习，今晚要提交作品录音；韩澈正准备摄影展。两人一直会帮对方看作品，今晚的录音帮助也已约好，并不附带私人回报。录音结束，设备收好后，唐沐才提出新的邀请。

> “周六一起吃饭吧。”唐沐说。
>
> 韩澈翻了翻展览安排。“行，还是录音哪儿没弄好？”
>
> “录好了。我想约你，不是找你补录。”
>
> 他把手机放回口袋。“约我？”
>
> 她以前说顺便吃饭，真的只是两个人都饿了。今晚她也饿，可不想再借这个理由。
>
> “按约会来。”她说，“你愿意吗？”
>
> 韩澈笑了一下，又问：“实习你还是去吧？”
>
> “去。你答应的展也别为了这顿饭取消。”
>
> “没冲突。我愿意。周六七点怎么样？”
>
> “七点。地方我发给你。”

周六两人实际按约见面。还是会开熟悉的玩笑，但唐沐讲到远行的期待时，韩澈没有马上转回录音技术；他说想继续认识她生活里的部分，问她愿意怎样联系。她说第一周安顿后再约视频，两人同意，不把“从前每天聊天”自动当成未来仍必须随叫随到。

这次约会结束，两人确认愿意开始交往。唐沐三周后照常去实习，韩澈完成摄影展；第一次远程联系由双方另约时间，不声称从此没有分歧。友情的默契保留下来，新增的是双方说清并接受的关系，而不是一个人把帮助兑换成恋爱。

内心判断只属于本例视角里的唐沐；韩澈是否愿意由他的实际回答给出，不能从笑容替他确认。
body.en:
Tang Mu and Han Che are both twenty-four and have been friends for years. Tang leaves in three weeks for a confirmed music internship and submits a work sample tonight; Han is preparing a photography exhibition. They routinely comment on each other’s work. Tonight’s recording help was already agreed without a personal return. Tang makes the new invitation after recording ends and equipment is put away.

> “Dinner Saturday?” Tang asked.
>
> Han checked the exhibition schedule. “Sure. Is something wrong with the recording?”
>
> “It’s finished. I want to ask you out, not book another take.”
>
> He pocketed the phone. “Ask me out?”
>
> Earlier, dinner while they were together had meant they were both hungry. She was hungry tonight too, but did not want that excuse again.
>
> “As a date,” she said. “Would you like that?”
>
> Han smiled, then asked, “You’re still taking the internship?”
>
> “Yes. Don’t cancel your exhibition for dinner either.”
>
> “It doesn’t clash. I’d like to. Seven on Saturday?”
>
> “Seven. I’ll send the place.”

They actually meet Saturday. Familiar jokes remain, but when Tang discusses leaving, Han does not immediately return to recording technique. He wants to know more of her life and asks how she wants to keep contact. She suggests arranging a video call after settling in during the first week. Both agree rather than assuming past daily messages require constant future availability.

At the end of the date both confirm they want to begin a relationship. Tang leaves for the internship three weeks later; Han completes his exhibition. They arrange the first remote contact separately, without declaring every future difference solved. Friendship’s ease remains; the new element is a relationship both name and accept, not help exchanged for romance.

The interior judgment belongs to Tang in this passage’s viewpoint. Han’s willingness comes from his reply, not a smile interpreted as confirmation for him.

heading.zh: 哪些变化说明新的关系，哪些仍可以是友情
heading.en: Distinguish New Agreement from Continuing Friendship

body.zh:
| 本例内容 | 说明什么 |
|---|---|
| 帮忙录音、看展览安排 | 原来已存在的友情，不独自证明恋爱。 |
| “按约会来”与“我愿意” | 双方知道并接受这次私人邀请。 |
| 周六实际见面 | 约定发生了，不只留在一句答应。 |
| 约会结束确认交往 | 关系名称有共同确认，不由旁人起哄决定。 |
| 实习和摄影展继续 | 恋爱没有取消各自生活。 |

不必把每场升级，也不要求所有朋友照此顺序。可以慢慢认识、直接说清或暂缓；亲近的行为按当下两人愿意什么写。作者要写未能恋爱，也应把拒绝或犹豫接住，不能仍把对方当已接受。
body.en:
| Detail | What It Establishes |
|---|---|
| Recording help and checking the exhibition schedule | Existing friendship, not romance by itself. |
| “As a date” and “I’d like to” | Both understand and accept this personal invitation. |
| Meeting Saturday | The arrangement happens beyond a promise. |
| Confirming a relationship afterward | Both name the bond rather than observers deciding it. |
| Internship and exhibition continue | Romance does not cancel independent lives. |

Neither escalation in every scene nor this exact sequence is required. People may approach slowly, speak directly, or wait. Write closeness for what both want now. If the author chooses no romance, answer refusal or hesitation rather than still treating the invitation as accepted.

heading.zh: 转变突兀或伤害友情，先修什么
heading.en: Repair an Abrupt Turn or a Disregarded Friendship

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 从“熟悉”直接跳到“当然属于我” | 分清旧关系与新意愿，给对方真实回答。 |
| 所有帮助都要求回报 | 保留无条件友情，不把恋爱当补偿。 |
| 只用情敌突然引出喜欢 | 也可写新理解、审美、谈话或对未来的感受。 |
| 拒绝后仍被迫保持原有亲密 | 允许重新约定距离，不用“好朋友不能这样”否定选择。 |
| 恋爱后人物全部换性格 | 基于旧人设局部调整，保留已有默契和独立目标。 |

修稿先确定作者要写的结局。不要为增加波折临时安排事故、第三者或巨额牺牲；本来温暖的相处可以继续温暖。
body.en:
| Problem | Repair |
|---|---|
| Familiarity becomes “You obviously belong to me” | Separate an old bond from present willingness and allow a real answer. |
| Every favor demands repayment | Keep freely offered friendship instead of compensatory romance. |
| Only a sudden rival reveals attraction | New understanding, taste, conversation, or a feeling about the future can also work. |
| Refusal requires unchanged intimacy | Allow a newly agreed distance rather than invoking friendship to deny choice. |
| Dating replaces their personalities | Adjust established character locally, preserving ease and independent goals. |

Choose the author’s ending before repair. Extra accidents, rivals, or enormous sacrifices need not manufacture complications. Warm contact can remain warm.

q.zh: 朋友变恋人必须写多年暗恋吗？
q.en: Does friends-to-lovers require years of secret longing?

a.zh: 不必。喜欢可以早已有，也可以来自最近的新理解。写清目前的认识和双方回应，别把所有旧友情倒改成有目的的追求。
a.en: No. Attraction may be longstanding or follow recent understanding. Clarify present recognition and both replies without rewriting every earlier friendship act as courtship.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查朋友变恋人的片段，附原友情、双方目标、当前知情和选定结局。区分普通帮忙、实际好感、私人邀请与关系确认，检查回应和后续相处。保留文风与温暖，不强迫吃醋、牺牲或放弃独立生活；只改点名范围。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review this friends-to-lovers passage with the earlier friendship, goals, known facts, and chosen ending. Separate help, attraction, personal invitation, and agreed relationship; check replies and later contact. Preserve voice and warmth without compulsory jealousy, sacrifice, or abandoned independent lives. Revise only the named scope.

label.zh: 独立目标与关系双进度
label.en: Independent goals and dual relationship progress

label.zh: 作者选择与原有人设事实

title.en: How to Write a Fake-Dating Romance with Real Stakes
title.zh: 假恋爱怎么写出真感情：让约定制造压力和选择

seo_title.en: Write a Fake-Dating Romance
seo_title.zh: 假恋爱故事怎么写

description.zh: 把公开表演、私人好感与真实确认分开，让假恋爱约定产生具体压力。附原创家宴、婚礼与看展全例及失败修法。
description.en: Separate public performance, private attraction, and real agreement. Includes an original family, wedding, and exhibition example with revision checks.

answer.zh: 先写双方为什么愿意假扮、约定在哪些场合有效以及何时结束。公众眼中的关系和真实好感可以错位，但合作表演不等于同意真实亲密。让人物在约定之外重新认识对方，再以明确邀请和回答确认真感情；到期或中止的安排及对外说法也要处理。
answer.en: Define why both agree to pretend, where the arrangement applies, and when it ends. Public status can differ from genuine attraction, but performed romance does not establish willingness for real intimacy. Let contact outside the arrangement change understanding, then confirm through an invitation and reply. Address expiry or withdrawal and what is told to others.

heading.zh: 约定制造故事条件，不替人物决定感情
heading.en: The Arrangement Creates Conditions, Not Feelings

body.zh:
本页将题材卡中的契约、公开身份与分寸，关系方法中的双进度、独立目标，以及对白议程组合使用。源卡讨论豪门婚恋，并没有独立的原生“假恋爱公式”；这里是作者可按自己故事调整的编辑方法，不要求财富、婚约或纸面合同。

| 记录 | 具体写什么 |
|---|---|
| 为什么接受 | 双方各要解决什么，为什么这一次愿意合演？ |
| 哪些场合 | 谁面前称恋人，在哪些场合不扮演？ |
| 有哪些界限 | 公开哪些事、接触到哪里，变更如何商量？ |
| 何时结束 | 到期、退出或真实情况改变后怎样回应？ |

这些是虚构情节的编辑问题，按本故事安排。小说里可以有不明智的选择，也可以写失约和控制；关键是写出它们造成的影响，不把已发生的伤害改叫“其实是爱”。
body.en:
This page combines the genre card’s arrangement, public identity, and boundaries with dual relationship progress, independent goals, and dialogue agendas. The source card concerns wealthy relationship drama; it contains no native fake-dating formula. This is an adaptable editorial approach without mandatory wealth, marriage, or written contract.

| Record | Specify |
|---|---|
| Reason to accept | What does each want, and why agree to this performance? |
| Audience and setting | Who hears the dating claim, and where is there no performance? |
| Limits | What is disclosed, what contact is agreed, and how are changes discussed? |
| Ending | What happens at expiry, withdrawal, or changed circumstances? |

These are editorial questions for fictional story conditions. A novel may include unwise decisions, broken promises, or control. Show their effects instead of renaming harm as hidden love.

heading.zh: 原创全例：角色演完以后，谁还愿意留下
heading.en: Complete Example: Who Wants to Stay After the Role Ends?

body.zh:
苏澄和贺川是成年邻居。苏澄筹备第一场插画展，家人常把谈工作转成相亲；贺川的哥哥婚礼将近，亲友也一直撮合他。两人已试过直接拒绝，仍不断被安排，于是自愿作出并不高明的假恋爱选择：一个月内，他陪她去一次家宴，她陪他参加哥哥婚礼。两人只在这些亲友面前称恋人，不替对方答应同住、工作改变或其他安排；谁不愿继续都能说。

家宴有人问何时同住，贺川只回答两人目前没有这个安排，没有替苏澄改住处。婚礼有人要他们当众亲吻，苏澄说不参加这个玩笑，贺川一起拒绝。表演中的默契让两人放松，却没有自动授予私人亲密。

展览前，苏澄另问贺川愿不愿来。他问：“这回还要扮吗？”她回答：“不用。我是希望你看我的画。”他接受，实际来过，也认真谈起一张画里她画出的旧街道。这里的靠近来自约定之外的认识，不是演员按角色完成任务。

一个月结束，两人按原约定停止假扮。苏澄向自己的家人说明先前称恋人并不真实，贺川也向婚礼上相关亲友说明。她母亲生气，需要后续相处；他哥哥要求以后别拿自己的婚礼挡话题。澄清没有自动换来所有人谅解，也没有让他们的展示或职业目标归对方决定。

> 贺川说：“约定结束了。我现在想认真约你。”
>
> “不是再替谁演一场？”
>
> “不是。你不愿意，我们就停在这里。”
>
> 苏澄想起那天他问的画面，问得很慢，没拿她的工作当挡箭牌。“我愿意。周六吃饭吧。”

两人实际在周六见面，确认愿意交往；苏澄继续办展，贺川照常工作。真实关系由这次表达和回答确认，之前两场扮演不追认成已经恋爱。没有声称亲友的情绪已全部解决，也不把新关系变成必须履行原表演动作的义务。
body.en:
Su Cheng and He Chuan are adult neighbors. Su is preparing her first illustration exhibition while family conversations repeatedly turn into matchmaking. He faces similar pressure around his brother’s wedding. Direct refusals have not stopped the arrangements, so they voluntarily choose a less-than-wise pretense: during one month he attends her family dinner, and she joins the wedding. They use the dating claim only with these relatives, promise no shared housing or changed work for the other, and may withdraw.

At dinner, He says there is no current plan to live together instead of arranging Su’s housing. At the wedding, guests request a public kiss. Su declines the joke, and He joins her refusal. Their performed ease does not automatically permit private intimacy.

Before the exhibition Su separately asks him to come. He asks whether he should still pretend. She says no: she wants him to see her pictures. He accepts, actually attends, and thoughtfully discusses the old street in one image. This contact supplies understanding beyond the assigned role.

At the month’s end both stop pretending. Su tells her family the earlier dating claim was untrue; He tells the relevant wedding relatives. Her mother is angry and needs later contact. His brother asks not to use his wedding to deflect questions again. Clarification produces no automatic forgiveness and transfers no control of either career.

> “The arrangement is over,” He said. “Now I want to ask you out for real.”
>
> “Not another performance for someone?”
>
> “No. If you don’t want to, we stop here.”
>
> Su remembered how carefully he had asked about the picture, without using her work as a shield. “I’d like that. Dinner Saturday?”

They actually meet Saturday and agree to begin a relationship. Su continues the exhibition and He continues work. The present declaration and reply establish romance; the earlier performances are not retroactively declared real dating. Relatives’ feelings remain unresolved, and dating does not require every performed gesture to continue.

heading.zh: 同一个举动，为什么后来有不同意义
heading.en: Explain the Changed Meaning of a Similar Act

body.zh:
| 本例 | 由什么得到意义 |
|---|---|
| 家宴陪同 | 已同意的公开角色，不能独自证明真心。 |
| 婚礼共同拒绝玩笑 | 相互支持界限，仍可以是合作与友情。 |
| 不扮演时实际看展 | 他主动认识她在意的事，她明确希望他来。 |
| 到期结束与对外说明 | 原约定确实结束，不用假角色拖住对方。 |
| 私下说清并接受 | 两人自己的真实关系，不由围观者决定。 |

不用把所有帮助改成爱意暗号。读者可以先发现变化，人物也可以迟一些才理解；不同知情层次不能变成某一方已经同意的证据。
body.en:
| Detail | Basis for Its Meaning |
|---|---|
| Attending dinner | An agreed public role, not proof of genuine love alone. |
| Declining the wedding joke together | Support for limits, still compatible with cooperation or friendship. |
| Actually attending outside the role | He learns about what matters to her; she wants him there. |
| Ending and explaining the arrangement | The pretense ends instead of keeping the other person bound to a role. |
| Declaring and accepting privately | Their own relationship, not a crowd’s decision. |

Every favor need not become a love signal. Readers may recognize change before characters do; different knowledge levels do not establish either person’s agreement.

heading.zh: 哪些写法会让假戏真做显得强推
heading.en: Repair Forced Transitions from Pretending to Dating

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 只有协议，没有各自理由 | 给两方独立需要，也允许拒绝和退出。 |
| 当众拥抱就被写成真爱 | 分清表演内容与私人意愿，接真实回答。 |
| 约定之外只有巧合亲密 | 增加真正认识对方的相处，不强迫事故或救援。 |
| 到期假装忘记 | 按已有日期处理结束或双方明确延期。 |
| 亲友知道真相却立刻全祝福 | 按已有知情与关系写回应，可以理解、祝福或生气，不自动取消已经造成的影响。 |
| 一方吃醋就强迫继续演 | 让对方选择，若越界就保留后果，不能自动合理化。 |

作者也可选择分开、仍做朋友或继续相处但暂不确认。每场不必新添条款或代价；温暖可以来自认真听完一件事。
body.en:
| Problem | Repair |
|---|---|
| An agreement without reasons | Give both independent needs and meaningful refusal or withdrawal. |
| A public embrace is declared real love | Separate performance from private willingness and answer the real question. |
| Only accidental intimacy outside the role | Add genuine understanding without compulsory accidents or rescues. |
| Expiry is conveniently forgotten | Honor the date or show both explicitly extending it. |
| Everyone instantly celebrates disclosure | Use established knowledge and relationships for understanding, celebration, or anger without automatically erasing actual effects. |
| Jealousy forces continued acting | Leave a choice; preserve consequences for overreach rather than justifying it. |

The author may choose separation, friendship, or continued contact without commitment. Every scene needs no new term or cost; warmth may come from listening carefully.

q.zh: 假恋爱一定要有正式合同吗？
q.en: Does fake dating need a formal contract?

a.zh: 不必。双方明确同意的口头约定也能提供故事条件。只写本例需要的内容，不把现实法律效力当作本页方法，也不让约定替对方决定感情。
a.en: No. An explicit mutual understanding can supply story conditions. Include what this example needs without claiming legal effect or letting the agreement decide feelings.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 审阅假恋爱片段，附双方接受理由、公众知情、约定范围和结束日期。区分角色表演、私人好感与真实确认，检查退出、到期和后续回应。按作者文风与选定结局，只改请求范围。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to review this fake-dating passage with reasons, audience knowledge, scope, and expiry. Separate performed roles, private attraction, and real confirmation; check withdrawal, ending, and replies. Follow the author’s voice and chosen ending; revise only the requested scope.

label.zh: 作者选择优先于题材默认值

title.zh: 经营文收入和利润怎么写：让数字影响下一笔生意
title.en: Writing Business Fiction: Revenue, Costs, and Working Cash

seo_title.zh: 经营文收入和利润怎么写：让数字影响下一笔生意
seo_title.en: Writing Business Fiction: Revenue, Costs, and Working Cash

description.zh: 分清卖出收入、已发生成本与可用现金，把数字写进接单和扩张选择。附饭团摊两天演算、复购场景和常见算错修法。
description.en: Separate sales, incurred costs, and available cash when writing business fiction. Includes a two-day stall example, repeat customers, and revision checks.

answer.zh: 经营文不只写“赚了一百多”。先明确卖出多少、已花多少、哪些钱还不能动，再让这些数字限制备货、接单或扩张。未来订单不是已收到收入，收款也不等于净利润。把顾客实际购买、评价与复购写出来，让数字与人的体验一起推动下一轮。
answer.en: Business fiction needs more than “she made over a hundred.” Establish sales, spending, and money still reserved, then let them constrain stock, orders, or expansion. Future orders are not received revenue, and receipts are not net profit. Show actual purchases, feedback, and repeat visits alongside the numbers.

heading.zh: 先分清四种数字，不把收入全部叫利润
heading.en: Distinguish Four Amounts Instead of Calling Every Receipt Profit

body.zh:
都市种田题材卡把选品、试卖、口碑、复购与扩张写成经营循环；数字方法要求金额回到人物能用掉的东西。本页专门检查现金与成本的连续性，区别于种田篇的接单过程和家庭分工。

| 数字 | 写作时核对 |
|---|---|
| 收入 | 实际卖出并收到多少，不把询价或未来订单算进来。 |
| 成本 | 本轮已经发生的支出，包含未卖完产品已经耗掉的材料。 |
| 现金 | 原有现金、实际支出、实际收款之后还剩多少。 |
| 下一笔可用钱 | 从现金里再分开已保留的用途，别把同一笔钱承诺两次。 |

这些是作者检查项，不是 skill 的原生财务表。例子只计算列出的现金收支，没有完整核算工资、折旧等，所以称“本轮现金结余”，不宣称完整会计净利润。用多少数字由本场需要决定，不必每章报账。
body.en:
The urban-farming prose card organizes product choice, trial sales, reputation, repeat custom, and expansion into a business loop. The number method returns amounts to what a character can use. This page checks cash and cost continuity, distinct from the farming article’s order process and household roles.

| Amount | Check in the Story |
|---|---|
| Revenue | Actual sales and receipts, excluding inquiries and future orders. |
| Costs | Incurred spending, including materials consumed by unsold products. |
| Cash | Starting money minus actual spending plus actual receipts. |
| Money for the next action | Separate reserved uses instead of promising the same money twice. |

These are editorial checks, not a native financial table. The example computes listed cash movements without fully accounting for labor, depreciation, and other items. It therefore calls the result a cash surplus, not complete accounting net profit. Use the numbers this scene needs without reporting accounts in every chapter.

heading.zh: 原创饭团摊：卖了144元，为什么不能马上扩张
heading.en: Original Stall: Why 144 in Sales Does Not Immediately Fund Expansion

body.zh:
叶棠想把小摊做成能稳定经营的生意。以下全是虚构故事的简化数字。她有启动现金200元，已知道下周费用需要留100元；现有设备与营业时间只允许一早卖一批，最多30份；她看的备选设备在本故事设定中能同一营业时间做40份，价格80元。

第一天做30份，每份材料和包装合计2元，当日摊费30元、燃料10元，售价6元。实际卖24份，收到144元；剩下6份按本例已定处理方式不再卖，材料钱已经花掉。

| 第一日记录 | 计算与含义 |
|---|---|
| 生产与当日支出 | 30×2＋30＋10＝100元。不能只按卖出的24份扣材料。 |
| 实际收入 | 24×6＝144元。 |
| 本轮现金结余 | 144－100＝44元，不是赚144元。 |
| 日末现金 | 200－100＋144＝244元，包含原有启动钱。 |
| 假设扩到40份 | 设备80元；40份材料包装80元，加当天固定40元。总需200元，244－200只剩44元，达不到留100元的目标。 |

买得起80元设备，不等于还供得起下一批。若只写设备价就宣布能接大单，生产钱与已保留用途会同时落空。

第二天她先缩为24份，材料包装48元，加当日固定40元，共88元。实际卖18份收108元，未卖的6份材料仍已用掉：本日现金结余20元，日末现金244－88＋108＝264元。它不是持续收入上涨的爽点，但说明她按需求收缩了试卖。

有位第一天买过的顾客再次来，带同事买两份，说味道喜欢，但昨日包装拿着容易散。叶棠这次用同样的包装材料调整包法，对方拿起后确认好拿了；这两份计在当天已售18份内。顾客随后问读书会能否订40份。问询还不是成交，也不能让叶棠立刻拥有40份的材料钱。
body.en:
Ye Tang wants a sustainable small stall. These are simplified fictional figures. She starts with 200 and needs to keep 100 for next week’s fee. Existing equipment and trading time allow one morning batch of at most 30 portions. In this fictional setup the alternative equipment she considers can make 40 in the same trading window and costs 80.

On day one she makes 30. Materials and packaging cost 2 each; the daily stall fee is 30 and fuel 10. Price is 6. She actually sells 24 and receives 144. Under this example’s established handling, the remaining six are no longer sold; their materials have already been paid.

| Day 1 | Calculation |
|---|---|
| Production and daily spending | 30×2 + 30 + 10 = 100. Do not charge materials only for the 24 sold. |
| Actual revenue | 24×6 = 144. |
| Cash surplus for this batch | 144 − 100 = 44, not 144 earned. |
| End-of-day cash | 200 − 100 + 144 = 244, including starting capital. |
| Hypothetical 40-portion expansion | Equipment costs 80. Materials and packaging cost 80, plus daily fixed spending of 40. The total is 200, leaving only 44 instead of the intended 100 reserve. |

Being able to buy equipment costing 80 does not fund the next batch. Counting only that price loses both production money and the reserved use.

On day two she reduces production to 24: 48 for materials and packaging plus 40 fixed spending, totaling 88. She sells 18 for 108; six unsold portions still consumed materials. The day’s cash surplus is 20 and ending cash is 244 − 88 + 108 = 264. This is not uninterrupted revenue growth; she has narrowed trial production to demand.

A day-one customer returns with a colleague and buys two, praising the flavor but saying yesterday’s wrapping came loose. Ye changes the wrapping method using the same materials; the customer lifts it and confirms it holds better. These two purchases are included in the day’s 18 sold. They ask about 40 portions for a reading event. An inquiry is not a completed order, nor does it instantly provide production money.

heading.zh: 把演算落到谈判和体验，不把正文写成表格
heading.en: Turn the Calculation into a Choice and a Scene

body.zh:
对方的读书会分两天进行，问40份能否同一天送到。叶棠知道新设备加40份生产需200元；今天264元扣后剩64元，仍达不到保留100元的目标。她可以另找已经成立的资金或产能来源，也可以改变订单安排。本例选后者，不临时送她一笔无出处的贷款。

> “一早四十份，我现在接不了。”叶棠说，“要是两天各二十份，我可以按时间送。”
>
> 顾客看了活动安排。“两天都要点心。第一天八点半，第二天也是，行吗？”
>
> “这个数量行。口味和包装按今天这批？”
>
> “按今天的。数量就二十加二十，我把联系人发你。”

双方实际确认数量、两天时间和联络方式。叶棠把每次20份排入现有产能，第一批所需材料包装40元，加固定40元，共80元；264元扣80元仍有184元，可保留100元。后一天生产要继续按届时实际现金核对；订单此刻尚未付款和交付，不把两天240元收入提前加进来。

正文可以只给一两处必要金额：叶棠先差一点想买设备，想到下周那100元，才改为问能否分两天。顾客不是只负责夸她，真实反馈改变了包法，也给出能接受的安排。母亲看她在账页上分别标出第一批80元与下周100元，知道她没有为这一单请求自己补缺口，才安心听她谈下一轮。

本轮回报是两天实际售出、顾客复来、包装改进和一个被对方接受的订单安排。订单最终交付留给后续，不能在这个停点就宣布创业成功。
body.en:
The reading event runs over two days, but the customer asks whether all 40 can arrive on one morning. New equipment and production would cost 200. With 264 now, that leaves 64, below the 100 reserve. Ye could use an established funding or capacity source, or change the order. This example chooses the latter instead of inventing a convenient loan.

> “I can’t take forty for one morning yet,” Ye said. “Twenty each day, I can deliver on time.”
>
> The customer checked the program. “We need snacks both days. Eight-thirty the first day, same the second. Can you do that?”
>
> “For that quantity, yes. Today’s flavors and wrapping?”
>
> “Today’s. Twenty plus twenty. I’ll send the contact.”

Both actually confirm quantities, the two times, and contact. Ye schedules 20 within existing capacity. The first batch costs 40 in materials and packaging plus 40 fixed spending: 80. Taking 80 from 264 leaves 184, preserving 100. The second day’s production still depends on actual cash then. The order has not yet been paid or delivered; do not add the future 240 now.

Prose may show just one or two necessary amounts: Ye almost buys equipment, remembers the reserved 100, then asks about separate days. The customer contributes a real criticism and an acceptable alternative rather than automatic praise. Her mother sees 80 marked for first production and 100 for next week on the page, understands that this order brings no request for her to cover a gap, and listens more easily to the next plan.

This unit’s payoff is actual sales on two days, a returning customer, better wrapping, and an accepted order arrangement. Delivery belongs later; this stopping point does not establish entrepreneurial success.

heading.zh: 经营数字写乱，按这几处修
heading.en: Repair Confused Business Numbers

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 收入一到账就全叫利润 | 写已发生支出，并注明例子实际算的是什么。 |
| 没卖的产品不扣材料 | 保留已消耗成本，库存能否留用按故事已定条件。 |
| 原有现金和本轮收益混算 | 先标起点，再加减实际收支。 |
| 把询价、大单或未来回款算成现钱 | 分开询价、确认、付款、交付，按实际状态写。 |
| 扩张只扣设备费 | 连下一批耗材、当日支出与保留用途一起核对。 |
| 钱涨了，人物和顾客没变 | 给取舍、劳动、反馈或生活体验，不必全员夸。 |

先检查影响当前选择的数字，不给所有小说添复杂账本。经营循环可以是缩量、稳住、改品或拒单；不是每次都要扩大，更不需要用突然争霸替代日常。
body.en:
| Problem | Repair |
|---|---|
| Every receipt is called profit | Include incurred spending and name what the example computes. |
| Unsold products lose their material cost | Retain consumed costs; reusable stock follows established conditions. |
| Starting cash is confused with new gain | Mark the starting point, then actual receipts and spending. |
| Inquiries, orders, or future payments become cash | Separate inquiry, agreement, payment, and delivery. |
| Expansion deducts equipment only | Include next production, daily spending, and reserved uses. |
| Money rises while people remain unchanged | Add choice, work, feedback, or lived experience without universal praise. |

Check amounts affecting the present choice rather than attaching complex accounts to every novel. The loop can narrow, stabilize, improve a product, or decline an order. It need not expand every time or replace daily life with sudden domination.

q.zh: 经营文每一轮都要赚更多吗？
q.en: Must each business-fiction unit earn more?

a.zh: 不必。源卡有经营推进的默认建议，本轮也可以试错、缩量、留住顾客或确认不能扩张。把读者期待的具体体验兑现，不用数字上涨替代人物选择。
a.en: No. The source card offers progression defaults. A unit may learn, narrow production, retain a customer, or recognize that expansion is not possible. Deliver the promised experience instead of replacing choices with rising numbers.

text.zh: 用 $story-long-write 检查经营场景，附初始现金、已发生收支、库存、产能和保留用途。标出收入被当利润、未来订单被当现钱或同一笔钱用两次的位置；检查顾客真实反馈和人物取舍。只修当前片段，不把编辑简表当完整财务核算，也不强迫每轮扩大。
text.en: Use $story-long-write to inspect this business scene with starting cash, incurred spending and receipts, stock, capacity, and reserved uses. Find revenue called profit, future orders called cash, or money spent twice; check customer feedback and choices. Revise only this passage without treating the editorial table as complete accounting or requiring expansion every unit.

金额回到人物能用的东西
label.en: Amounts tied to what a character can use
